rol ba'i khro mo sgeg cing lang tsho rol ba dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis zhugs pa'o// shar phyogs la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su lugs las ldog pas khra gdong ma 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma phag gdong rnams phyogs kyi mdog can 'jigs pa'i cha byadaṭwāṃ ga g.yas gri gug dang ḍa ma ru gzhan sngar dang 'dra ste dpral bar rdo rje phyed pas brgyan pa zhabs gnyis rkyang skum gyi nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la zhugs pa'o// de nas 'bras bu sngon du gyur pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lha de dang der snang yang*/ lha re re zhing byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs par dag pa'i gzugs rab tu mi gnas pa la goms par bya'o// de nas rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor lus la sgom pa ni/ mgo bo la sogs par g.yon pa'i srin lag reg la/ sum dzang oṃ oṃ ghaur Zེ maṃ gaṃ o ḍi ko kaṃ laṃ ka hi pri ghi sau su naṃ si naṃ si maṃ skuṃ zhes rjes su nga ro dang bcas nas mgo bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir bsam nas/ 'od du zhu ba las 'od kyi khang ba 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad gyur par lnga'o { lta'o } // de nas snying khar chu skyes 'dab brgyad kyi snying por/ nyi ma la yud tsam gyi rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa sku rtse sor bzhi pa tsam dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la bde chen gyi 'khor lo sku mthe bong tsam pa bsam/ de'i 'od kyis lus thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ mgo la sogs pa'i 'od gang gi nang du/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs sku mthe bong Z rar/ sna ba g.yas pa u rgyan/ ltag pa arbu tar gnas sa rab tu dga' ba/ sna ba g.yon pa/ gho ta ba rir/ smin mtshams ra me shwa ra/ mig gnyis Z{ laṃ pa ka ra } / tstsha vོ ha dang*/ sa sbyang dka'o// snying ga kañdzir/ mtshan rtse tstshavོ hi mā la yar/ nye ba'i tstsavghri ha de bar 'du ba can dang*/ sa ring du song ba/ brla gnyis saur Wra/ byin pa gnyis su waÇ dāe wa/

nye ba'i 'du ba can/ sa mi g.yo ba sor na ga rar/ bol gong sin Zà gdong ma/ bshang ba'i lam du phag gdong ma/ sna ba g.yas par sreg ma/ g.yon par pho nya mo/ mig g.yas par mche ba can ma/ g.yon du 'joms pa mo/ lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyang gtso la gzigs pa'i tshul du ltas la/ thams cad las 'od zer byung nas lus thams cad la khyab par byas te/ rlung brtan pas bde ba cung zad sgom par bya'o// de la oṃ ā hūṃ sarba £ི ra yo gi ni ka ya wa ga tsi$ badzra swa £ wa ad ma ko ±haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuK/ sarba Zrma badzra shuKོ ±ba'i thor tsugs dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yon ser ba/ g.yas dmar ba/ g.yon dril bu thod pa kha ṭwāV gar dbang*/ phrag pa gnyis la bo ṣa ḍa he mthing kha las he ru ka/ mig gnyis la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ tshig thams cad la phaṭa hūṃ las don yod grub pa ljang khu ste/ dpa' bo lnga po de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas thams cad 'khor lo paVla dmar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ g.yas ser ba/ phyag g.yon thod pa kha ṭwāṇḍi ka ste/ dpa' mo lnga po de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga g.yas gri gug dang ḍa ma ru bsnams pa'o// sku mthe bong tshad tsam pa g.yas brkyang bas nyi ma la zhugs par ltas la/ slar sngags de dang des byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar sbrel mdud byas la/ gung mo rtse sprad mthe bong rdo rje brtanapo ltar kha sbyar bas dpral ba'i dbyings su bzhag ste/ g.yas dang g.yon du skor bas mig gyacad kyis rig pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs pa mdzad cing*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bar chad sel/ rigs kyi yum rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad g.yo ba dang bcas pas/

ji ltar ltam pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a £ི ṣe ka ta ye shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas/ shes bya'i sgrib pa bag la nyal ba dang bcas pa dag nas/ lus dga' bde ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang nas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du bsam par bya'o// chu lhag ma las gtso bo las mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang bde chen la rin 'byung*/ thugs la mi skyod pa/ gsung la snang mtha'/ sku la rnam snang*/ dam tshig la don yod grub pa/ sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par bya'o// de nas sku gsung thugs brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas gsum du oṃ ā hūṃ gsum bsam la/ de las 'od zer 'phros te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs skul nas khams gsum gyi dug gsum sbyangs nas/ slar de dag gi yon tan thams cad yi ge gsum gyi tshul du gnas gsum la bcug la/ bcug pas yi ge gsum 'od zhu nas/ rnam snang mtha' yas mi skyod pa yum dang bcas par bsam la/ de'i 'od kyis lus thams cad khyab pas bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur par ltas la/ rlung cung zad brtan pas sgom par bya'o// de nas bde stong dbyer med par rtolas ldog pa ste/ sngags de dag kyang kha dog dmar po 'od 'phreng ba du mas 'khrigs pas/ yab yum gnyis ka'i lus ji ltar 'khor bar bsam la/ a lī rtsam £ི ni byas pas dga' ba'i mchod pa brtsam par bya'o// phyi rol du yang dag pa'i bzang po de nyid/ de las bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes skyed par byas la sgom par bya'o// de la phyi nang gi lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ na ma £ ga wa te aṃ wa ri shwa ra huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa ghi saṃ £ ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzā ḍa ma sku ḍa rko ṭa yā huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ ḍaW ka ra lo tra £ི ṣa ṇa mu kha ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sa ha £à dza £ su ra ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ri shuK/ sho4 ta shu la kha ṭaṃ ga Z ri ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ £ ga dzi na ma ra ya sa ra ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ha Zà na meṭha na ka ra wa ṣa ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab a na ma £ ga wa te badzra £ hi be huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo a4 a pa ra rtsi te trai lo kya ma te ma ha bi4 sha ri huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba £à Z ya ba he ma ha badzra huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra a sa na a dzī te pa shaṃ ka tri ne tra £ ma ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo £ sha ṣo ṣi ro ṣa ni kro ta ka ru lo ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo tra sa ni ma ra na su pra £ེ ta ni a pa ra dzā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo dzā ye £ི dzā ye dza² ni rtaṃ pa ni mo ha ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra £ ra hi bāṃ ma ha yo gi ni ka lo sha ri kha ghe huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yum zhes pa bstod par bsam pa ni thun mong gi'o// oṃ badzra shrī he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzwa la saṃ £ ra swa hā/ oṃ hri ha ha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba buZ ḍā ki ni ye badzra waÇ ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra £ཻ ro tsa ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ la me ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ru bi ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba £ོ Zི tsi ta huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇḍa ka pa la pra tsaṇḍa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā kaṃ pa la tsaṇḍa kṣi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ £na Z £na Z kaṃ ka la pra £ི ta ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya bi ka ṭa daṃ W ni ma hā na sa ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣo £ ya kṣo £ ya/ su ri ba ra na bī ra ma ti ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ a mi ta kha ba ri ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hraṃ hraṃ badzra pra £ wa laṃ ka sho ri ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ pheṃ pheṃ badzra de ha badrud ma tsha ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa aṃ ku ri ka e ra bā ti e huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badzra dzī ti la ma hā £ེ ra £ ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā bi ra ba yu £ེ ga yo huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ £ kṣa £ kṣa ba sa Zà Zི ra na ma laṃ £ laṃ bā ni badzra hūṃ ka ra su ra £ kṣi ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ghri ~ ghri ~ sa pa ta sa pa ta la ga ta bu dzī ga sarba pa ta rdza ya swa £ £ tra Oེ ma de £ི ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a gaZ a gaZ badzra £ tra swa £ tra ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hri hri pa ha £ེ ra bā ta ya karne huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzño dzño sa £ su ba kṣa kha ka ni na huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣaṃ kṣaṃ ma hā ba la tsakra bang ge huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hri hri rang badzra khaṇḍa ro hāe huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hiṃ hiṃ ƒ ghi ba ṣo tri ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ a ka ra sha ga2/ tsakra sarba ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li sha ki li shi he ru ka/ su £ི ri huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ma si li si li paV nir ti sho ra ma hā £ le huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li £ཻ ra tsa na tsakra wa ra ti ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ Zི li Zི li ṣiṃ ha ru ka ma hā bi4 ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ka uཻ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ lu ka uཻ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sho na ka uཻ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shu ka re uཻ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃWི ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃWི ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pas lha so so'i sngags kyi bstod pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'o// de nas dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar paV dang zla ba la de dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar paV dang zla ba la hūṃ yig ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de'i thig le las sangs rgyas kyi tshogs kyi 'od zer la gnas pa'i tshogs shin tu phra ba'i bde mchog gi dal gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par bsgom par bya'o// de las 'od zer rnam par 'phros te snod bcud thams cad dal du byas na slar de nyid la rab tu bcug nas/

phra ba'i mtshan ma 'od zer dang bcas pa'i dal gyi 'khor lo la rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtags sngon sum du mthon gyi bar la bsgom par bya'o// de brtan pa dang 'og sgo'i sna rtse'i thig le nyung 'bru tsam pa gcig la/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i dal dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs te rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya'o// yang na smin mtshams kyi thig le shin tu phra ba'i nang du gzugs brnyan ltar bsam par bya'o// de lta bu'i sbyor ba de la skyo bar gyur na/ thun mong gi dngos grub myur bar bya ba'i phyir bzlas pa byas te/ de kho na nyid las bzlas brjod kyi sngags 'od zer dang bcas pas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi paVra/ yum gyi zhal nas rang gi zhal du rgyud de/ oṃ gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ gis thig le'i thugs dang*/ swā hā phaṭa kyi zhabs kyi nas 'don pa'i 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa ni phreng ba lta bu'i bzlas pa'o// 'byung ba dang 'jug pa dang gnas pa gsum las yi ge 'bru gsum kha dog dang bcas pa/ rnam rtog gzhan 'brel ba'i skyon spangs pa'i bzlas pa ni sems ni dben no// nor bu'i rtse mor thig le'i tshul par rnam par bsgoms nas rtog pa med pa'i sems kyis lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i tshul du nyams su myong nas 'gro 'ong dang rnam par bral nas/ gzung 'dzin spong bar gnas pa ni gsang ba 'gog pa'i bzlas pa'o// de la dub par gyur na rang gi sna bug g.yas pa nas/ ā li dang kā li 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs spros te/ sa gsum po thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin du byas te/ thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang ro mnyam par sna bug g.yon nas zhugs nas lte ba'i thad du phyin pa dang*/ ā li kā li las zla ba las dmar mdangs chags pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs las hūṃ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par lta'o// de nyid yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/

phag mo dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam nam mkha'i ri mo ltas la/ de ā li dang tsum £ི ni nas rtsa srub sbyor byas pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dam pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba dang*/ dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sgras dam tshig sems dpa' gtso bo yab yum nas las brtsams te dal dur khrod dang bcas pa thams cad skul nas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ dur khrod nas rim gyis lte ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa la thim par lta'o/ de dag lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin thig le dkar dmar du mkha' gsang gi rtse mor bzhugs par lta'o// de nyid yongs su gyur pa las zla ba la hūṃ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du bsam mo// de yang bzlas pa hūṃ la bsdu zhing*/ hūṃ yang zhabs kyu nas rim bzhin na da'i bar du bsdus la/ na da bde ba chen po'i ngo bor dmigs par bya'o// de yang je chung dang je phra la yal te/ rten dang dmigs pa dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ zag bcas rten dang dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i mtshon du med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// de ltar bde stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ma rnyed kyi bar du btsal/ de la skyo bar gyur pa dang na da las hūṃ du ltas la de las skad cig gis sngar bzhin dal du ldang bar bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma sbyin pa'i cho ga ni/ zas la sogs pa mdun du bzhag ste swa £ was dag par byas te/ yaṃ las rlung gi dal gzhu'i dbyibs can/ g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa raṃ las me'i dal zur gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu/ a las paV'i snod kyi nang du/ ma bi mu ra shu go ku ha na las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma sngar byas la/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las sna bug g.yas pa'i 'od zer gyis skul bas rlung skyod/

me sbar rdzas rnams khol ba las nyi ma'i kha dog lta bu bsam par bya'o// de'i steng du dngul chu lta bu'i kha ṭwākhod nas snyoms par bzhugs pas/ zhu bar gyur pa so so rang rang gi sa bon la rab tu zhugs so// de'i rjes la sa bon yang zhu ste 'dres pas bdud rtsir lta'o// de nas ā li kā li las lag pa g.yon g.yas bzung ba dang nyi ma bsam pa'i dbus/ bar du hūṃ ltas la/ oṃ ā ‚ོ na/ a na ra ga ta sarba Zrma aWj a nu pra baW/ sarba Zrma hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ hūṃ nyi zla dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i dbus su gtor snod bzhag par bsams la/ gtor ma bdag gir bya ba'i don du/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de yis gsungs pa'i chos ni tshad ma ste// bden pa 'di yis mdun bskyed lha mo rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod la/ oṃ ā ra lis/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum dang bde chen gyi 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra la sogs pa thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la phul la/ pi wang ma la sogs pas mchod la/ srid dang zhi ba snyoms par sbyor kyang kun rtog rlabs bcom pas// nam mkha' bzhin du dngos kun ma lus de nyid kho na mkhyen pa rnams// shin tu phul du phyin pa'i thugs rje'i chu yis thugs kyi paV rgyas pa'i mgon// lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes su rtser dgongs mdzod// zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas dur khrod la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong la sogs pa la/ oṃ khā khā la sogs pas gtor ma sbyin pas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyas par bsam/ 'phrin las bcol la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha skang ngo*// de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo nas dur khrod kyi bar khyab par gyur pa dang*/ de dag 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa bdag nyid la 'dus te/

de yang thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la bsdus la/ oṃ yo ga shud Zོ sogs pa brjod cing paV bskor ba'i phyag rgyar blta bar byas te mngon par mkhyen pa'i lta stangs kyis bsdus la/ bdag nyid thugs ka'i hūṃ la bsdus la/ de la thun mtshams kyi he ru kar bzhengs la/ khams dpa' bo rnam par dag pa dang*/ phyag rgya sngags su rnam par dag pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga ni rnam par dag par bya ste/ go che chen pos bsrungs la/ snang grags dran rtog he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par shar ba la 'bad par bya'o// //

zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag yab dang 'grel ba'i dal rgyas par sgom pa'i lam thun mong ma yin pa/ mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin bla ma'i bka' lung ma nyams par kha che'i paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po nā ro pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis/ pu a ha ri'i dgon pa ru zhus shing gtan la phab pa'o// slad nas bsod snyoms pa mi bskyod pas kyang legs par bcos pa'o// 082) ༄// snyan brgyud kyi yab bka'i bum dbang gi dkyil chog rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// ༄// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra si Mṇḍi ta 'jigs med grags pas jo bo chen po tai lo pa 'tshol du byon pa dang*/ dka' ba chen pos btsal bas rnyed nas brda bcu gsum bstan/ de nas dbang gi mthongs dbye ba las rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po tai lo pa de dur khrod chen po zhig na/ lus spang la phur pa btab pa ltar 'gyur med du bzhugs/ ngag lkugs pa ltar smra med du bzhugs so// sems dbugs bral ltar rtog med du bzhugs pa las/ nā ro pa des maṇḍal phul/ phyag dang bskor ba byas nas bdag rjes su 'dzin par zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ tai los gsungs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ ces pa nas/ smin lam yid bzhin nor bu ltos// ces gsungs pas/ nā ro pas ma go ste/ dmus long bdag gis ji ltar lta/ ces byas pas/ tai los/ smin lam yid bzhin nor bu la// blta ru med pa'i tshul gyis ltos// ces gsungs pas/ nā ros/ smin lam la ltar med du bltas pas grol med du grol te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya mtsho rgyud la skyes so// dus der tai los gsungs pa/ mthong du med pa'i ngang nyid las// don mthong rnal 'byor rang grol 'gyur// ces pa la brten nas smin lam 'di la lnga ste/ thabs gtso bor byas te phyi rdul tshon la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba dang*/

shes rab gtso bor byas te nang sivä ra rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas yum gyi byin rlabs bya ba dang*/ dbang don mdud pa 'grol tshul dang*/ grol ba ngo sprad tshul dang*/ smin grol mthar phyin par byed pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bskor tshul lo// dang po la bzhi ste/ dam tshig mi nyams pa'i phyir brtag pa dang*/ brtag pa de nyid slob mar bzung ba dang*/ lha mnyes nas dngos grub myur bar bya ba'i don du bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ smin par bya ba'i don du dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gsum/ gang gis bya na/ brgyud pa dang ldan zhing nyams su myong ba la sogs pas bya/ gang la bya na/ sangs rgyas rang rgyud la tshol nus pa la sogs pa la bya/ dus nam bya na/ shis pa'i dus yar mar gyi tshes bcu dang*/ dgos pa sgrub pa'i dus nam 'dzoms pa la bya'o// gnyis pa la drug ste/ 'byor ba brtag pa/ gsol ba btab pa/ spro ba dri ba/ chos bshad pa/ sdig pa sbyang ba/ srung ba bya ba'o// dang po ni/ lus dang srog la mi lta zhing cha rkyen tshang ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs tshad bshams la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lha// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// rdo rje bla ma mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa ni/ lan gnyis khas mi len/ gsum pa la/ ma bsgral ba rnams sgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung phyir// bdag la bla mar spro lags sam// zhes dri'o// bzhi pa ni/ rten dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dka'/ de bas kyang rten gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa shin tu rnyed par dka' ba gsum gyi chos rgyas par phye la bshad do// lnga pa slob ma'i snying gar kaṃ nag po las sdig pa gnag la rid pa bsam/ rkang mthil du yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i raṃ las me sbar/ des de rjes nas rdo rje gnod sbyin 'brangs te zos par bsam/

oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā baṃ dā ha na £ miṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rdo rje gdab bo// drug pa bsrung bar bya ba ni/ slob bu paṃ las kun bzang du bskyed/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la rgya gram du bsam mo// gsum pa bsnyen pa la bzhi ste/ dang po bgegs bsal ba ni yi ge brgya pa mang du bskyal lo// rab rtags kyi bsnyen pa la lha rtags byung byung*/ 'bring grangs kyi bsnyen pa la gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor la khri khri'o// tha ma dus kyi bsnyen pa la bdun nam bcu'am nyer gcig bya'o// bzhi ba smin par bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur ba la bzhi/ nub dang po la sa chog gnyis pa la sta gon/ gsum pa dngos gzhi/ bzhi pa la gtang rag go dang po la gsum/ gsol ba btab pa dang*/ dngos/ gtor tshogs mchod pa'i 'bul tshul lo// dang po ni/ kyai rdo rje slob dpon dgongs// sa ni mi dger gnas pa la// mi dge spangs la dge ba ru// sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa la gnyis/ nan tan du brtag sbyang dgos pa dang*/ mi dgos pa'o/ dang po la lnga ste/ sa brtag pa dang*/ blang ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ mngon par 'du bya zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sa srung zhing bzung ba'o// dang po la lnga/ phyogs brtag pa dang*/ kha dog skyon/ bltas/ lto 'phye brtag pa'o/ dang po grong khyer la sogs pa'i shar du byas na bdag po 'chi/ lhor yul mi la 'tshe ba 'byung*/ nub tu byas na slob ma'i nad pa 'chi/ byang du byas na lkugs par 'gyur ro// mer char mi 'ong*/ bden bral du me 'a*/ tsha sgo dang*/ bseg ma dang*/ rdo dang*/ bong ba dang*/ skra dang*/ srin bu dang*/ grog sbur dang*/ sdom sdig la sogs pa med pa'o// dbyibs kyi yon tan shar dang lho zhol ba/ byang dang nub mtho dma' mnyam pa// skra dang gyo dum dang srog chags la sogs pa med pa/ sa gtsang ba dang*/ thal ba dang tsha sgo med pas snum bag dang ldan pa/

dgra rkun gyi 'tshe ba med pa/ zug rngu bskyed pa'i nyes pa sa'i ro lnga dang bral ba/ chu shing 'dzom zhing ljon shing bzang pos brgyan pas sgrub pa po'i 'jug sgo'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'o// bzhi pa la gsum las/ dang po sa sas brtag pa ni/ der spus nub tsam bskos la/ de nyid kyis bskangs te/ lhag na bzang*/ khengs na 'bring*/ ma khengs na ngan no// gnyis pa sa chus brtag pa ni/ der mtho gang tsam bskos la/ ba'i rnam lngas byugs la chus bskang ste/ me tog dkar po la sogs pa dor la/ shar du gom pa brgyad phyin la skam ma skam dang me tog g.yas su 'khor mi 'khor gyi bye brag brtag go /gsum pa rmi ltas kyis sa brtag pa ni/ gnas der byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro bas/na du bya dgos te/ de yang stod mi la smad sbrul du yod pa/ gzhog g.yon pa 'og tu bcug nas g.yas bskor du bskor ba ste/ de yang dgun zla gsum mgo lhor kha nub tu bltas nas nyal ba ste/ rang nyid kha shar du bltas la bsko/ de bzhin du dpyid gsum mgo bo nub kha byang du bltas la/ dbyar gsum la mgo bo byang shar du/ ston zla gsum la mgo bo shar kha lhor bstan nas nyal ba la/ rang nyid byang nas lhor bltas la/ lto ba nas rgyu ma 'brud par bsam la bsko bar bya'o// de las gzhan du mgo bltas nas bskos na pha ma bu tsha la sogs snying brtse ba rnams 'chi la/ rgyab nas bskos na yul 'khor 'chor ba'am/ yang na bdag nyid la 'ong*/ mjug ma nas bskos na ba lang la sogs pa'i sgo phyugs brlag par 'gyur ro// gsum pa sa blang ba la gnyis/ snang ba la blang ba dang*/ mi snang ba la blang ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyal po la zhus te blang ba dang*/ yul gyi bdag po la bya dga' phran tshags byin te re zhig blang bar bya'o// mi snang ba la blang ba ni bzhi las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod gsol ba btab la blang ba dang*/ phyogaṇḍal phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri// zhes brjod la snang ba byin par bsam la/

ye shes kyi lha mo bar snang la bzhugs par bsam la/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// gsum pa sa sbyang ba la gnyis/ kun rdzob kyi dang*/ don dam pa'i sbyang tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ las su bya bas dang*/ sbyin sreg gis dang*/ gsang gtor gyis sbyong ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ sbyang bar mi nus pas dang*/ sbyang bar nus pas sbyang tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'khyags pa'i sa bong la sogs kyis bkag nas zug rngur dbyung ba'i ro lnga dbyung bar ma nus na swa £É wa'i sngags brjod cing sa'i nyes skyon stong par bsam na byang bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar brtag cing sbyang ba'i sa de la dngos grub rab 'bring gsum gyi dbye bas lto 'phye'i kha blta phyogs dang bstun nas lto ba dang mchu so dang*/ pus mo nub pa tsam dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa ji tsam bya bar 'dod pas khru gang bas che bar sngags bzlas shing brkos pas sa'i ro legs par bsam la/ sa bong brdungs la thal bar bcags te kun nas legs par snyoms par byas te/ ba'i rnam pa lnga dang*/ spos dri zhim pos khyab par byugs la/ phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar rin po che dang 'bru sna la sogs pa bzhug de yang rdo bsal bas skran mi 'ong*/ rus pas gzer nad mi 'ong*/ bseg mas rlung nad mi 'ong*/ gyo mas lkugs nad mi 'ong*/ thal ba bsal bas rims nad mi 'ong*/ sdong dum bsal bas rnam par rmongs pa mi 'ong*/ skra shad rtsa shing bsal bas nye bar 'tshe ba mi 'ong*/ gnyis pa zhi ba'i thab khung du dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa bcug la/ mar sbrang rtsi 'o ma la sogs pa'i bsreg blugs nyer gcig byas pas sbyangs par 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni/ ba'i rnam lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas la gtor zhing nyes skyon thams cad dag par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ sa phyogs nyes skyon thams cad sems/ sems rang rig rang stong pa/ stong pa spros bral du bsam mo// gnyis pa la gnyis/

sa'i yon tan gyi dang*/ las kyi bye brag gi nan tan tu brtag sbyang mi di dgos so// bzhi pa la gnyis/ sa mngon par 'du bya ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ khang pa mngon par 'du bya ba dang*/ sa steng mngon par 'du bya ba'o// dang po ni/ brtag sbyang byas pa'i sa'i gnas der rmang nas brtan pa rtsig legs pa/ phyogs phyed la bsil drod snyoms pa/ bkod pa legs pa/ sgo shar ram byang du bstan pa/ 'jam zhal dang dri bzang po'i brkyang nul gyis mdzes par byas pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ tshad dang dbyibs kyi mtshan nyid skyon yon dang bcas pa'o// dang po 'byor pa che chung dang*/ khang pa yangs dog dang*/ spros pa la dga' mi dga'i bye brag gis dpag tshad dang khru gang gi bar te/ steng 'og tu tshad ma gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ me long gi ngos ltar ther ther ba ste/ dbus dma' na sgrub pa po'i srog 'jig byang mthos na 'chi ba'am nor 'joms/ shar mthos na rigs rgyud chad/ des na shar dang byang du zhol ba bya zhing*/ dbus mtho ba rgyal rigs dang rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro// byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dngos so// dang po ni/ bla mas phyag rgya drug dang ldan pas stegs kyi steng du mngon par rtogs pa rgyas par bsgoms la/ las kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ shar mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis spos kyi reng bu dang bcas pas/ hūṃ) de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas gzugs can ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ hūṃ) sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// nub nas dum skyes ma yi nga rgyal gyis/ hūṃ) zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes ོda pa rnam sbyong ba'i// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog

/dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// byang nas la ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ hūṃ) mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs shing*// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs/ kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ zhes pa'o// dngos gzhi la gsum/ de bzhin nyid kyi rdo rje'i sar// bkra shis bde legs 'phel bar gsol ba btab pas byin gyis brlab pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dod pa lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ £à khaṃ zhes pas sa gzhi nam mkha'i chos kyi dbyings su bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ zhes pas/ de yang rdo rje'i rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med du bsam mo// gsum pa ni/ der dris byugs la me tog bkram/ de la mchod bstod byas la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūṃ) bcom ldan khrag 'thung rdo rje can// rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dgongs su gsol// slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang*// mgon po lhan cig 'byung ba yi// dkyil 'khor dri bar 'tshal lags kyis// gang dag gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams kun// bdag gi bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i phyir// dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes so// lnga pa la gnyis/ sa srung ba dang*/ sa bdag gir bzung ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ kun rdzob kyis dang*/ don dam pas srung tshul lo// dang po la gsum ste/ sbyor ba bka' bsgo ba dang*/ dngos gzhi bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ rjes mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir ra gur sgom pa'o// dang po ni/ bgegs rnams dbang ldan du bsogs la/ hūṃ) nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang yang rung*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// gal te bsgo ba su zhig 'da'// rdo rje bdag po'i sku yis ni// lus srul la sogs 'gas byas te// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// zhes pa dang*/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas slob ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi sa la dgod pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod pa'i phyir/ sa phyogs nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa 'dir dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'di 'bri yis/ gang su yang rung pa sa phyogs 'di na gnas pe dag ni/ nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgya 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes pa dang*/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bskrad do// gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka ma thob pa bgegs kyis lan snyam du bsam la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha nam mkha' la btegs la/ rkang pa gnyis hūṃ las rdo rje/ ma dang ṭa las mig gnyis nyi zlar bsam la/ oṃ badzra ti¿ hūṃ brjod cing*/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bas/ hūṃ ring 'don pas dbang ldan nas brtsam la lan gsum bskor te/ shar du g.yas brkyang/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu zlum po/ byang du sog kha/ shar lhor mnyam pa/ lho nub tu mi mnyam pa/ nub byang du rus sbal 'gros/ byang shar du bung ba'i 'phur 'jigs bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas phur bu btab la rdo rje'i ra gur la sogs pa gzhung ltar bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ bar du gcod bya'i yul/ gcod byed kyi bdag po/ bar chad rang gi ngo bo rang gi rang blo spros bral gyi ngo bor khong du chud par bya'o// gnyis pa bzung ba la bzhi/ mchod pa bshams te rdzas kyis bzung ba dang*/ rten bkrams te rten gyis bzung ba dang*/ ye shes kyi rten dang brten par bcas par bskyed de ting nge 'dzin gyis bzung ba/ blos bdag gir bzung ste yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la gsol ba btab pa'o// gsum pa gtor tshogs mchod pa'i 'bul tshul ni/ man ngag ltar mchod la/ mar me sos la u rgyan du kha ltas la nyal lo// nub gnyis pa'i sta gon la lnga/

snga dro bum pa sta gon/ phyi dro sa'i lha mo'i sta gon/ srod la lha sta gon/ gung la slob ma sta gon/ tho rangs gtor tshogs mchod pa'i 'bul tshul lo// dang po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa rab drug cu rtsa gnyis/ 'bring dgu'am lnga/ tha ma gnyis gu gul gyis bdugs la yungs dkar gyis brab la rtsa sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ kha rgyan dang mgul chings bya/ oṃ pa £ེ ṣa a haṃ/ sman lnga/ oṃ pa ra* a haṃ/ rin po che lnga/ oṃ pa bre ṣa a haṃ/ 'bru lnga/ oṃ pa ga2 a haṃ/ snying po lnga/ oṃ pa a mṛ tu a haṃ/ zhes pas bdud rtsi lnga gzhug go /gtso bo'i bum pa'i steng du bdud rtsis bskang ba'i ka pā la bzhag de'i khar rdo rje gzungs thag bzhag gtso bo'i bum pa la rdo rje'i rgya gram dang gri gug 'bri/ bde chen la rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug 'bri/ thugs la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'bri/ gsung la paVsa mtshan pa'i gri gug 'bri/ sku la 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug 'bri/ dam tshig la rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i gri gug 'bri/ de rnams mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang bcas pa'i mdun du/ gtso bo'i bum par ¨áཾ dang sa bon las gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa bskyed la rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ mchod bstod byas te/ bdud rtsir gyur pa dang sngar gyi sar bzhugs so// gzhan thams cad la des mtshungs so// phyi 'phred sa'i lha mo'i sta gon ni/ ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa can bya/ sa'i lha mo bskyed/ bar snang gi lha mo ye shes par gzhug mchod bstod bya/ hūṃ) dbul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dri chus gru bzhir byugs/ oṃ shri badzra he he sogs brjod/ slob mas/ shrī badzra he sogs brjod cing me tog dgod/ bla mas dri chus byugs shing sarba buK brjod/ bus badzra waÇ brjod cing me tog dgod/ de ltar dam tshig gi 'khor lo sgom pa'i bar du bla mas sngags brjod cing dris byugs/

slob bus me tog dgod do// de la ye shes pa gzhug go /gnyis pa mchod bstod ni ji tsam nus pa bya/ gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūṃ) gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag ye shes bdag nyid can// ston pa rdo rje khrag 'thung dpal// rdo rje phag mor yang dag bcas// gang zhig phyogs kyi dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di bzhes pa'i// sang ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyi// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs la// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces brjod do/ nam gung la slob ma sta gon la bcu gnyis te/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ gnang ba byin pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro dbog pa/ so thar dbog sems skyed dbog dam tshig dbog lha dgod/ so shing dang*/ skyur chu sbyin/ srung skud gdags pa/ spro ba skyed pa/ rmi lam brtag pa'o// dang po ni/ slob ma khrus byas/ dris byugs/ me tog thogs la/ hūṃ) dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i// mgon po chen po bdag la gsol// gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsam nas// sdom pa gsum po bdag la gsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag nyid gzhug tu gsol// ces brjod/ gnyis pa snang ba sbyi'adi mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med do// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru ka// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces brjod do// gsum pa skyabs 'gro dbog pa ni/ hūṃ) rkang gnyis zhi ba tshogs kyi mchog /sku gsum rnam dag phyir mi ldog /yon tan ldan pa'i skyes mchog la// gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo gsang sogs mkha' 'gro ma// dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag po la// yang dag nyid du skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med dang*// khyad par du yang bla ma la// gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi// ces brjod la bslab bya bshad do// bzhi pa so thar dbog pa ni/ hūṃ)jug pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bcom ldan gyis// sdom pa la gnas de bzhin du// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// pha rol phyin pa la sogs kyis// mthar gyis bslab cing mthar gyis bsgrub// brtson dang brtson pa'i sems bskyed la// thams cad sgral phyir 'jug sems bskyed// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma dgrol ba rnams sgrol bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces brjod do// drug pa dam tshig dbog pa ni/ hūṃ) sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi btang ngo*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yis// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// paV'i rigs mchog chen po la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// gzhan yang dam tshig sbyin pa ni// bla ma mchod dang de bzhin byams// sangs rgyas la gus 'gro la ba)

dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par// mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni// dus gsum nyid du bde bar mdzod// ces brjod cing me tog la sogs pa dbul lo// brgyad pa so shing sbyin pa ni/ ya yo med pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa drang zhing skyon med pa/ me tog gi kha rgyan can yum gyi snying pos sngags pa byin la/ de nyid mdud pa dang bcas pas paV 'dab brgyad kyi maṇḍal steng du dor ba dang*/ shar du bltas na zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ mtshams phran tshags/ rang lta gyen sgreng bzang*/ mthur du tshud na sa 'og ma tshud na bskyar ro// dgu pa skyur chu sbyin pa ni/ de nas yi ge hūṃ las byung zhing de nyid gsum bzlas pa'i skyur chu/ oṃ hri bi shuK sarba Zrma pa paṃ ni tsa saṃ sho^ sarba bi kalpa a pa ‚ེ hūṃ/ zhes pas sbyin no// bcu pa srung skud gdags pa ni/ de nas skud pa sum sgril mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa yab kyi snying pos sngags la zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyi gdags so// bcu gcig pa chos bshad cing spro ba bskyed pa ni/ hūṃ)ུna 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kyis// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// legs par bskyed par gyur pa yin// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// gang phyir khyed rnams dong bas ni// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes brjod la don bshad do// bcu gnyis pa rmi bltas brtag pa ni/ yi ge bdun pas sngags pa'i ku sha rngas dang gdan du byin la/ seng ge'i nyal thabs kyis nyal la rmi lam brtag ste/ rten gsum dang*// rgyal po dang*/ ri'i steng dang*/ nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa dang*/ seng ge glang chen gos rgyan bzang po gon pa/

khrus dang chu rgal ba dang*/ dung rnga la sogs pa'i sgra bsgrags pa rmis na bzang*/ g.yang dang ri rtse nas lhung la khad pa dang*/ chus khyer ba la sogs pa dang*/ bong bu zhon spri'us khrid nas lhor phyin pa rmis na ngan te bzlog pa sogs bya'o// de nas gtor tshogs mchod pa bzang du dbul lo// lha tshogs bar snang la btegs te der bzhugs par bltas te dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar nyal lo// nub gsum pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ nyin mo nas srod kyi bar dkyil 'khor du bzhug pa/ nam phyed nas dbang bskur ba/ tho rangs ji ltar bya ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ sngo dro thig gdab/ gung la tshon bkye/ phyi 'phred nas srod la dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// dang po la bcu ste/ de la thig skud rgyu ni ras bal lam srin bal gtsang ma'o// gnyis pa 'khal mkhan bu mo gtsang ma'o// gsum pa ring thung dkyil 'khor gyi nyams 'gyur pa sbom du sgo'i nyi shu cha bzhi pa gdab sa me long ngos lta bu/ lnga ba gdab dus snga dro'o/ drug pa nges tshig mi 'dres pa'i phyir ni thig go /bdun pa dbye na sa thig gnam thig rgyud thig go /brgyad pa thig skud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ kha dog lngar bsgyur la/ hūṃ oṃ traṃ hriḥ.a lnga las de las phyag mtshan/ de las rigs lngar gyur par ltas la mchod bstod byas la slar thig skud kyi ngo bor bsam mo// dgu pa gdab thabs bla mas dza dza brjod cing*/ shar nub tu bltas nas gnam thig gdab bo// sa thig srad bus rang rang gi man ngag ltar gdab pa'o/ rgyud thig ting nge 'dzin gyis gdab bo// bcu pa skyon ni/ thig skud chad na bla ma 'chi/ ring thung byung na nad thebs/ phyogs 'phras byung na smyo 'bog 'ong*/ phan yon ni/ thig ma nor bar legs par thebs na sang ni tshon 'bri bas bsod nams che'o// gnyis pa dgung la tshon bgyi ba la bcu ste/ dang po tshon gyi rgyu ni rab rin po che lnga/ 'bring 'bru lnga/

tha ma rus phye sa tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba'o// gnyis pa 'bri mkhan sngags pa'o// gsum pa bris ni legs par thebs pa'o/ bzhi pa 'bri dus gung la'o/ lnga pa nges tshig bsgyur ba dang gsal ba'i phyir na tshon no// drug pa tshon byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūṃ sngon po las mi bskyod pa/ oṃ dkar po las rnam snang*/ traṃ ser po las rin 'byung*/ hrīḥdamar po las snang mtha'/ a ljang gu don yod grub tu bsam la mchod bstod byas la slar tshon rtsi'i ngo bor lta'o// bdun pa 'bri thabs ni/ bla ma'i lag pa g.yon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pas/ hūṃ) 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ sems can khams dag sgrol mdzad pa'i// mi bskyod pa ni rgyal po che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// ces pa dang*/ byang shar gyi mtshams nas rtsigs pa nang ma sngon pos 'bri'o// de nas ljang gu blangs te/ hūṃ) 'di ni bya grub dag pa ste/ sems can khams rnams sgrol mdzad pa// don yod grub pa rgyal po che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// de'i phyi ma 'bri/ de nas dmar po blangs la/ hūṃ) 'di ni kun rtog dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams sgrol mdzad pa// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal po che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// de'i phyi ma 'bri/ de nas ser po blangs te/ hūṃ) 'di ni mnyam nyid dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams sgrol mdzad pa// rin chen 'byung ldan rgyal po che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// ces de'i phyi ma 'bri'o// de nas dkar po blangs te/ hūṃ) 'di ni me long dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams sgrol mdzad pa// rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// ces phyi ma 'bri'o// de la snod bkab la pra brtag go /de nas dbus kyi ye shes 'khor lo nag po ze 'bru sna tshogs pa dang ldan par 'bri/ bde chen paV 'dab brgyad phyogs tshon 'bri/

mtshams bzhi phyed/ gong ras ser po/ mu khyud sna tshogs/ rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba'o/ thugs kyi sngon po/ gsung gi dmar po/ sku'i dkar po/ gong ras mdzes tshon mu khyud rim pa ltar rdo rje dang paV dang 'khor lo bskor ba'o// dam tshig dkyil 'khor phyogs tshon/ 'dod yon dmar/ phu gu ser/ drwa phyed gzhi gnag rgyan dkar/ ka ma shi sha ljang*/ ba ku la dkar/ rta babs mdzes tshon/ rdo rje ra ba dang dur khrod gzhi nag po la gzugs dkar por bya/ lha gnas tsaka li 'god do// brgyad pa dbye na/ ra ga dang gzhi tshon no// dgu pa skyon yon ni sboms na nad 'byung*/ phra na nor 'dzad/ yang na mdza' bshes dang 'bral/ g.yon bskor du bris na sdug bsngal thob bo// bcu pa yon tan ni/ g.yas bskor du bris na phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob bo// phyi 'phred dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la bzhi/ phyi 'phred dkyil 'khor snang bas sgrub cing mchod pa bya ba dang*// srod dang po bsgom bzlas kyis bsgrub cing mchod bstod bya ba dang*/ gung la rdo rje shugs kyis bsgrub cing rang nyid kyis dbang blang ba dang*/ tha ma la slob ma 'jug pas bsgrub cing gnad du rung bar bya'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor de nyid legs par bltas te/ skyon dang ma tshang ba med par bltas te/ rdo rje dril bu thogs la yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bskor ba drangs bka' brgyud bzhugs tshul/ mnyes byed snying po bgrang tshul/ gsol 'debs dngos grub blang tshul/ byin rlabs mchod bstod dbul tshul/ nyams grib sdig pa bshags tshul lo// dang po 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug la rang lhar bskyed/ skad cig gis dkyil 'khor gyi lha rang rang gi gnas su rdzus skyes su bltas/ sta gon gyi lha bar snang la bzhugs pa bya don gyi dbang ni/ rang gis ma zhus par gzhan la bskur bar mi nus pas/ me tog thogs la shar gyi khwa gdong ma la sgo phye byas pas sgo phye nas phyin pas/

yang sku gsung thugs bde chen du rtsangs phyin te/ bu la ji tsam bskur ba rang gi gtso bo yab yum la me tog dor te/ hūṃ bdag slob ma 'di rnams la dbang 'di rnams bskur bas bdag la khyed kyis gnang du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ gtso bo yab yum gyis me tog gcig mgo bo la bcings te/ hūṃ don dam dbang phyug smra ba'i seng ge zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed pa'i gti mug 'joms mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid bdag sgrub mdzod// ces gsungs nas thob par bsam mo// mtshon byed tshig gi dbang ni/ dga' chen khyed bdag ston pa ste// zhes pa la sogs pa brjod cing*/ brjod du bcug la ci tsam bskur ba rdzogs par blang ngo*// srod tha ma la 'jug pa la gnyis te/ thun mong phyi 'jug dang*/ khyad par nang 'jug go /dang po la dgu ste/ dri ma sbyang du yod pa'i brdar khrus bya ba dang*/ nyon mongs pas gos pa'i brdar mig dar gyis dkri ba dang*/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i brdar dri zhing lan gdab pa/ snod dang ldan pa'i brdar bzhugs par gsol ba gdab pa/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i brdar sgo bzhi nas phyag byed du bzhugs pa/ dag pa'i brdar sngags kyi sems bskyed pa/ 'jigs pa dang mun pa yod pa'i brdar lha'i dam tshig sbyin pa/ dam tshig la mi 'da' ba'i brdar mna' chu blud pa/ gus pa bskyed pa'i brdar bla mas dam tshig bsgrag pa'o// dang po ni/ las kun byed kyi bum pas khrus bya'o// gnyis pa dar dmar po la sngags btab la mig la dkri/ gsum pa las kyi rdo rjes yol ba'i nang du khrid la/ bla mas khyod su yin ci la dga' dri/ des kyang bde chen skal ldan bdag lags so// bdag ni bde ba che la dga'/ ces bya'o/ bzhi pa las kun byed kyi chus gtor/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug go

/sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dang*// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// ces brjod/ bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po 'byung ba'i da la du// bdag gi slob ma bzhugs par bgyi// ces bya/ lnga pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te phyag byas la/ 'di brjod do/ hūṃ) mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba'i// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yis// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi mchog /dpal ldan sku la skyabs su mchi// dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgo nas zhugs te phyag byas la/ hūṃ) mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba'i// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun gcod pa'i// chos kyi 'khor lo skor mdzad pa// bde chen 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /bde chen sku la skyabs su mchi// dkyil 'khor gyi nub sgo nas zhugs te phyag byas la/ hūṃ) mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba'i// sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// ma ma ma gcig rje btsun ma// dpal ldan sku la skyabs su mchi// dkyil 'khor gyi byang sgo nas zhugs te phyag byas la/ hūṃ)dzra yo ga tsi$ u pa ta ya mi/ su ra ta sa ma ya nཾ/ bo Zི tsi$ badzrar ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o// smras na dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes pa'o// brgyad pa dam tshig las mi 'da' ba'i brdar mna' chu blud pa ni/ ka pā la bdud rtsi blugs pa nas byin la/ hūṃ) 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pa a mṛ ta hūṃ/

dgu pa ni/ deng khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas ji skad bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod nga la brnyas par ma byed cig mi'i bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas/ rdo rje dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ gnyis pa nang 'jug la bdun las/ sangs rgyas rigs su skyes pa'i brdar ye shes dbab pa/ dngo/ dang po la gsum ste/ ye shes dbab thabs/ phebs pa'i rtags/ ma phebs na spog chog bya'o// dang po la gnyis te/ gsol ba btab pa ni/ hūṃ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlob la/ bdag la dpal he ru ka dbab tu gsol/ zhes bya'o// dbab thabs dngos la gnyis las/ slob ma'i byed pa la brten pa chos bshad pa ni ེsa dbab pa ni/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du byas te/ bdud rtsi lnga dang byi la'i brun dang*/ gu gul/ bud med kyi zhabs ma dang mngal khrag gnyis brdungs la/ bsregs te sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od bu'i snying ga'i lha la phog 'od du zhu bar bsam/ oṃ ti¿ ma hā kro ta a £ེ sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he biWÉ ra dza yā Zི ma ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo drag tu dkrol lo// phebs pa'i rtags ni/ dus der mkhur ba sbos kyi dbyangs kyis/ hūṃ) mkha' 'gro ma yi ye shes che// phebs te phebs na gang la phebs// lus la phebs na 'dar sogs 'byung*// ngag la phebs na smra sogs 'byung*// sems la phebs na gnyis med 'byung*// mkha' 'gro ma yi ye shes yin// ces lan gsum bya'o// de nas rdo rje'i glu blangs te/ hūṃ) ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// sems nyid kun gyi ngo bo ni// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du gcod// ces brjod cing don la lta'o// spog chog ni/ bu'i snying gar 'od phog pas bu 'od du zhu/

dmar mo re re 'dar khri li li 'dug par bsam mo// des phebs so// gnyis pa me tog dor ba ni/ chas bdun rus pa'i phreng ba dar gyi cod paṇa can dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar phyin la/ hūṃ) 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// 'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi'i snod du 'gyur// de bzhin du ni 'bab par shog /pra ti tstsha badzra) he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni phye bar 'gyur// oṃ badzra nai tra ya a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hriḥzhes pas gdong g.yogs bsal la/ hūṃ) dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma'i rigs kyi// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// dngos grub bu khyod skal ldan 'gyur// zhes bstan to// lnga pa dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dur khrod dang bcas pa nas bzung ste gtso bo'i bar du bstan no// drug pa lha'i rnam dag byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun dang sbyar la bstan no// bdun pa yongs su dag pa ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma las byung bar bshad la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang bas lhag par bshad do/ gnyis pa nam phyed nas dbang bskur ba la brgyad de/ rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ rig sbyor gyi dbang gsum bskur ba/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba/ rdo rje slob dpon rab 'byams kyi dbang*/ dbang lam khyer/ bdud kyi 'joms tshul/ gtor tshogs mchod pa'i dbul tshul/ dbang gong ma gsum bskur tshul lo// dang po la bzhi las/ gsol ba gdab tshul/ dbang bskur ba dngos/ rtags kyi 'char tshul/ lta sgom dam tshig bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ hūṃ) mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba'i// bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /khyod nyid kyis ni bka' drin skyongs// bla na med pa'i byang chub thob// de phyir bum pa dag gi dbang*// mgon pos rjes su bzung bar mdzod// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lha// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// rdo rje bla ma mdzad du gsol// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// ji ltar mchod chen stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bsrung ba'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces brjod do// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la lnga/

chu'i dbang ni slob ma mi bskyod par bskyed la/ bum pa thams cad nas las thams ) dbang skur ba ni bdud rtsi mchog /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis// sangs rgyas kun gyi chu dbang sbyin// a sarba ta tha ga ta u ta ka a £ི ṣi tu maṃ/ hūṃ) ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// ces pa nas khrus kyi bar brjod cing bkru'o/ hūṃ) rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa'i// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes nyid// zhe sdang rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i// dpal ldan chu yi dbang bskur ro// ces so// gnyis pa dbu rgyan de traṃ las rin 'byung du bskyed la/ sa bon las 'od 'phros bde mchog bstims/ mchod bstod byas/ hūṃ) gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis// sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// dbu rgyan dam pa khyod kyis longs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ra* mu ku ṭa a £ི ṣi tu maṃ/ hūṃ) tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa'i// mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje 'di// nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyis// cod paṇa gyis ni dbang bskur ro// ces ngo sprad do// gsum pa rdo rje mi dmigs pa las hrīḥlas snang mthar skyed/ gsung gi 'khor lo bkug la mchod bstod bya/ hūṃ) sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// sangs rgyas sku ni rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bzung*// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra a ba Zི ti¿ a £ི ṣi tu maṃ/ ti¿ badzra sa ma ya nཾ/ hūṃ) 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa'i// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis// 'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas kyis// rdo rje yi ni dbang bskur ro// ces ngo sprad do// bzhi pa dril bu a las don yod grub tu bskyed la/ phrin las 'khor lo bde mchog bkug la bstim/ hūṃ) 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a Zི pa ti a £ི ṣi tu maṃ/

badzra sa ma ya nཾཾ/ hūṃ) 'du shes phung po rnam dag pas// bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis// phrag dog don yod grub pa yis// dril bu 'di yi dbang bskur ro// ces ngo sprad do// lnga pa ming dbang sbyin pa ni/ oṃ las 'khor lo rnam snang du skyed la/ rdo rje dril bu thogs la/ hūṃ) sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas sku ni rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka a Zི pa ti nཾ/ a £ི ṣe maṃ/ shrī he ru ka na ma a Zི ṣe ka ta/ ces me tog phog pa'i lha la drangs nas/ ye shes rdo rje nas dam tshig rdo rje'i bar du ming btags so// ming nas lan gsum gsum pa'o// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis// gti mug rnam dag rnam snang gi /dpal ldan ming gi dbang bskur ro// de lta bus dbang bskur rus rgyan sbyin no// gsung ngo*// gsum pa dbang bskur rtags kyi 'char tshul ni/ lha sku sgyu mar 'char ba yin// bzhi pa lta sgom dam tshig bstan pa ni// lta ba snang ba sems su thag bcad/ sgom pa lha sku sgyu ma lta bu/ ོda pa kun bzang sdom pa la gnas pa yin/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi bsten pa'o// sdom pa tha mal sdom pa yin no// gnyis pa rig sbyor gyi dbang gsum ni/ sku'i dbang*/ gsung gi dbang*/ thugs kyi dbang ngo*// dang po skye med kyi brdar sku'i dbang ni/ kha ṭwāṃ ga rnam snang du skyed la gtad/ hūṃ) srid pa shin tu bde ba'i sku// sdug bsngal chen po zhi byed pa// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig rtag tu srung bar bya// yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces byar brjod// ces sbyin no// rab brjod med kyi brdar gsung ni/ dril bu snang mthar bskyed la/ hūṃ) srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag

/ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// ces so/ rtog med kyi brdar thugs byin la/ rdo rje mi bskyod par bskyed la/ hūṃ) thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces sbyin no/ gsum pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dngos so// dang po ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon gtan 'byung nas sogs// de bzhin bdag la'ang de stsol zhig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur// ces so// dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi ste/ chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba'i brdar dbang rtags rtsigs pa dang*/ 'jigs bral nyam dang bral ba'i brdar he ru ka'i chas su bzhug pa dang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi chos mtshon pa'i brdar rus rgyan sbyin pa dang*/ don rtogs mtshon pa'i brdar phyag mtshan gyi dbang sbyin pa'o// dang po dbang stegs ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar du/ rin po che'i khri seng ge'i rkang rten can/ ro mang po gdan du bting ba der bshams la/ der bu bzhag gdugs phub/ rol mo bya/ bkra shis bya/ hūṃ) bar tshil chen thig le byas la/ hūṃ) khrag ris dmar po snying rje'i rgyan/ thal chen tshom bu byams pa'i rgyan// thig le byams dang snying rje ste// snang stong gnyis med rgyan du khyer// yang zhing chen rgyab tu byin la/ hūṃ) dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis// na bza' chos nyid mi 'gyur ba// 'byung ba rnam bzhi gzhan don gos// zhing chen rtog med rgyan du khyer// ces so// de nas skra tshab skon la/ hūṃ) skra grol nyon mongs grol ba ste// gti mug rgyan ldan yid 'phrog pa'i// skra tshab pha rol phyin bcu'i spras// ye shes sgron ma rgyan du khyer// ces so// gsum pa rgyu 'bras kyi chos mtshon pa'i phyir rus rgyan/

hūṃ) rkang gdub 'khor ba snying po med// gzung 'dzin sbrul mdud rang sar grol// ces rkang rgyan skon la don bshad do/ hūṃ) sked rags byams dang snying rje ste// 'gro rnams thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung*// byams snying rje bshad do// des 'gre'o/ hūṃ) lag gdub mi rtag gar mkhan te// 'khor ba 'di la ma zhen mdzod// mi rtag pa bshad/ hūṃ) dpung rgyan rgyu 'bras khyad ma bsad// las 'bras gnyis la yid ches mdzod// las rgyu 'bras bshad/ des 'gre'o/ hūṃ) ) ) rna g.yon dug gsum sbrul mdud khrol// rna g.yas rang sems me long ltos// snang sems dbyer med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) de steng 'khor lo rtsibs drug ni// drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen te// 'dod yon zhen med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) de bar chun 'phyang drug po ni// pha rol phyin pa drug po ste// mngon shes drug ldan rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) de steng mi mgo drug pa ni// 'gro ba rigs drug 'dren pa ste// bsdu ba rnam bzhi rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) de steng rdo rje rgya gram ni// ye shes nyi mas ma rig bsal// phrin las dbyer med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) de steng rdo rje rtse gsum ni// dang po smon lam sprul sku'i rtse// gnyis pa tshogs gnyis longs sku'i rtse// gsum pa stong nyid chos sku'i rtse// sku gsum dbyer med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) de steng gdugs dkar yu ba can// bdag med gnyis kyi rtsibs ma la// byams dang snying rje'i skud ris can// rtog nyid chos nyid chos sku la// longs sku ras dkar sprin du bstibs// sprul sku sham bu'i char rgyun gyis// 'gro ba'i lo thog smin par mdzod// ces so// bzhi pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang la lnga/ rdo rje dril bu/ kha ṭwāṃ ga cang te'u/ g.yer kha/ gri gug gi'o// dang po la/ hūṃ) rdo rje thabs ldan bde bas te// dril bu shes rab stong pa nyid// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje dril bu rgyan du khyer// ces so// gnyis pa ni/

he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma dpal ḍa ma ru// dpa' bo dpa' mo g.yer kha ste/ kha ṭwāṃ cang te'u rgyan du khyer// ces so// gsum pa ni/ hūṃ) g.yer kha gling bu ting ting shags// dril bu cang te ḍa ma ru// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// sgra skad ka la ping ka'i dbyangs// ḍa ma ru sogs rgyan du khyer// ces so// bzhi ba ni/ hūṃ) g.yas na dam nyams gcod kyi gri /g.yon na bdud rtsi ka pā la// mkha' 'gro mnyes byed gzar bu dang*// tshangs skud la sogs rgyan du khyer// ces so// lnga ba brjod pa tshig gi dbang ni/ hūṃ) 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// he ru ka yi phyag na bsnams// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs bstan// kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru// he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rje bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭwāṃ cang te pad snod sogs// dpa' bo chen pos bcang bar gyis// he ru ka yi phyag rgya ni// phyi rol nang na yang dag gnas// ces brjod do// bzhi pa rdo rje slob dpon rab 'byams la dbang bcu gsum ste/ dang po nor bu btad la/ hūṃ) sprul sku bla ma yid bzhin gyis// nor bu rin chen gtsug gi rgyan// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che// bka' brgyud bla ma rgyan du khyer// ces so// gnyis pa gser thur btad la/ hūṃ) ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// ces so// gsum pa me long gtad la/ hūṃ) chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ru// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med pas gnas med pa// de ltar chos 'di shes par gyis// sems can don ni mnyam med kyis// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma rig skyes// ces so// bzhi pa dung gtad la/

hūṃ) ga pa dung dang po ti gtad la/ gsang sngags theg pa'i tshul dang lugs// 'jig rten rnams la rtag tu ston// des ni sangs rgyas dran shes shing*// phan par mdzad pa'i nyid du gsungs// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyis kyang*// khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad// hūṃ) 'gro rnams don du chos kyi rnga brdung dung yang 'bud// chos kyi char gyis 'gro rnams smin par gyis// chos kyi sman gyis 'gro rnams zug rngu dbyung*// ces so// bdun pa skas gtad la/ hūṃ) dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// longs sku smin lam byang chub lam// gzhan don thar lam bgrod gyi skas// smin lam nor bu rgyan du khyer// ces so/ brgyad pa gri gug gtad la/ hūṃ) dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// chos sku rnam grol rnam par grol// 'khor 'das rgyun thag gcod par mtshon// grol lam nor bu rgyan du khyer// ces so// dgu ba zas kyis bskang ba'i thod pa gtad la/ hūṃ) mkha' 'gro mnyes byed tshogs kyis ni// 'khor lo 'bral med rgyan du khyer// ces so// bcu ba sbrul gtad la/ hūṃ) gdug pa dug sbrul reg pa 'joms// mi dge bcu spang mtho ris lam// bya bral byar med skyes bu yis// sdig pa chung yang spang bar mdzod// ces so// bcu gcig pa ma gzugs byin te/ hūṃ) dge ba ma ltar byams pa ste// 'dod yon zhen med byang chub grogs// bya ba don ldan skyes bu yis// bde ba chung yang sgrub par gyis// ces so// bcu gnyis pa nyi ma gtad la/ hūṃ) nyi 'od lta bur dbyer med kyis// sdig pa dran med yid la ni// mi bya spang du med pa ste// dge ba dmigs med blo las 'das// sgrub tu ci yang med pa ste// dgag sgrub gnyis med rgyan du khyer// ces so// bcu gsum pa mtsho gtad la/ hūṃ) Z2á ta ni ltag pa nyid// go ta wa ri rna ba g.yon// ra mi shwa ra smin ma'i dbus// de bi ko ṭa mig gnyis te// ma la £ེ ni phrag pa gnyis// ka ma ru pa mchan khung ste// o ṭe nu mar grags pa yin// tri sha ko ni lte ba ste// ko sa la ni sna nyid do// ka ling ka ni kha zhes brjod// laṃ pa ka ni mgrin pa'i dbus// ki snying khar yang dag gnas// hi ma la yā 'doms 'bras te// pri ta pu ri mtshan mar ro// ghṛ ha de wa gshang lam nyid// sau raW brla gnyis la// su waÇ de byin pa gnyis// nā ga ra ni sor mo ste// sin Zà rkang pa'i bol du'o// ma ro tse ni mthe bong la// ku lu ta ni pus mo ste// nyi shu rtsa bzhi nang gi ni// 'khor lo lnga dang lus gnas pa'i// steng na gnyis med bzhugs pa yis// rtsa khams tshul gyis 'gyings bcas pa'i// dpa' bo dpa' mo rgyan du khyer// ces so// lnga pa dbang lam 'khyer la gsum/

dbang gnyis med du ngo sprod tshul/ rjes gnang sbyin tshul/ dbang gi mtha' brten no// dang po la lnga ste/ hūṃ) mos pa tsam gyis bka' brgyud 'du// bka' brgyud bla ma bde chen sku// byin rlabs bla ma'i rnam par snang*// snang tsam nyid nas bde ba yin// bde tsam nyid nas stong pa yin// bde stong gnyis med sems kyi rgyan// bla ma 'bral med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) dran pa tsam gyis yi dam 'du// yi dam dkyil 'khor bde chen sku// byin rlabs yi dam rnam par snang*// snang tsam nyid nas bde ba yin// bde tsam nyid nas stong pa yin// bde stong gnyis med sems kyi rgyan// yi dam 'bral med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) thos pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro 'du// sku gsum mkha' 'gro bde chen sku// byin rlabs mkha' 'gro'i rnam par snang*// snang tsam nyid nas bde ba yin// bde tsam nyid nas stong pa yin// bde stong gnyis med sems kyi rgyan// mkha' 'gro 'bral med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) tshogs pa tsam gyis dngos grub 'byung*// dngos grub dam tshig bde chen sku// byin rlabs dngos grub rnam par snang*// snang tsam nyid nas bde ba yin// bde tsam nyid nas stong pa yin// bde stong gnyis med sems kyi rgyan// dngos grub dam tshig gi rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) sgom pa tsam gyis nyams myong 'du// snyan brgyud nyams myong bde chen sku// byin rlabs nyams myong rnam par snang*// snang tsam nyid nas bde ba yin// bde tsam nyid nas stong pa yin// bde stong gnyis med sems kyi rgyan// snyan brgyud 'bral med rgyan du khyer// hūṃ) skye med sku la brjod med gsung*// rtog med thugs dang ldan pa yis// sku gsum 'bral med rgyan du khyer// gnyis pa rjes gnang sbyin pa la bcu gcig ste/ dang po lha sgom pa'i rjes gnang ni/ dpag bsam gyi shing nor bus brgyan pa byin la/

hūṃ) ) nyi shu rtsa gnyis yi ge mchog /bdag gis bcom ldan 'dir bzung lags// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes pa dang lan gsum bzlas so// gsum pa rdzogs rim sgom pa'i rjes gnang ni/ paV gtad la/ hūṃ) ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams// 'dam skyes skyon med paV yis// rnam par thar pa ji lta bar// rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par gyis// ces bstan no// bzhi pa chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ tsakra gtad la/ hūṃ) byang chub snying po mthar thug par// ji ltar dus gsum 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med// kun nas rab tu skor bar gyis// ces so// lnga pa bdud las rgyal ba'i rjes gnang ni/ mda' gzhu byin la/ hūṃ) chos nyid gzhu la ye shes mda'// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'phongs// bdud sogs bcom la de bzhin gshegs// thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis// ces so// drug pa mchod rjes gnang me tog byin la/ hūṃ) dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// yar ngo mar gyi tshes bcu la// 'bad pas dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*// mkha' 'gro la sogs mchod par gyis// ces so// bdun pa phrin las kyi rjes gnang ni// hūṃ) zhi dang rgyas dang dbang drag dang*// dgug dang sdang dang mnan la sogs// bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de// las de rnams dang sgrub par gyis// ces so// brgyad pa thun mong dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ni/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lham dang ni ril bu dang*// rnal 'byor ba yi dngos grub rnams// de dag ci dgar sgrub par gyis// ces so// dgu pa grags pa'i rjes gnang dung gtad la// hūṃ) ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba ltar// snyan pas phyogs rnams sgrog pa yi// 'bud dung g.yas su 'khyil ba 'di// 'di ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis// ces so// bcu pa mi brjed pa'i rjes gnang phreng ba gtad la/ hūṃ) sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'chang*// sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma// deng nas 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// phreng ba 'di ni khyed kyis bcang*// ces so// bcu gcig pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad rin po che sna bdun byin la thun mong ltar ro// gsum pa dbang gi mtha' rten la gsum ste/

lung bstan pa/ dbugs dbyung ba/ khas blang ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ ngan 'gro spong bar lung bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par lung bstan pa'o// dang po ni gos seng ge'i rna ba ltar byas/ g.yon pa phyar la 'dzin du bcug g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir// srid dang ngan 'gro kun las ston// shrī he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta siZི sa ma ya nཾ/ £à ra £à ba swa/ gnyis pa ni/ hūṃ) khyod ni 'khor lo gsum dbang phyug /sangs rgyas kyi ni rang bzhin nyid// he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba// de bzhin gshegs pa rang lung bstan// ces pa dang don bshad do// gnyis pa dbugs dbyung ba la gsum/ sdig pa 'byang bar dbugs dbyung ba/ 'khor bas mi gos par dbugs dbyung ba/ phyir mi ldog pas dbugs dbyung ba'o// dang po ni/ hūṃ) theg pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mchog tu rab zhugs mthong bas na// deng khyod sdig pa thams cad las// rnam grol bzang por 'gyur bar gsungs// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ hūṃ) mnar med pa yi sems can la// mgon po khyed kyis bsgral nas kyang*// deng du bdag ni paV ltar// nyes pa kun las rnam par grol// ces so// gsum pa ni/ hūṃ) bag chags thams cad spangs pa yis// byang chub dam pa bdag 'tshal bas// khyod zhabs lam gyi bka' drin gyis// rdzogs pa nyid du da gyur to// ces so/ gsum pa ni de rnams kyi don bshad do// bzhi pa khas blang ba ni/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ hūṃ) joms so// bdun pa the ras gtor tshogs mchod pa'i 'bul tshul ni/ de nas gtang rag gi tshul du mchod pa dang*/ tshogs dang gtor ma dang yo byad 'byor tshad dbul lo// bkra shis yi ge'i 'don tshul ni/ bkra shis gsol/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang*/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/

lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos chos thams cad ma skyes pa'o zhes pas shar sgo nas brtsams te rdo rje'i rtse mos dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ sa stegs dri bzang pos brkyang nul bya/ rdul tshon don du gnyer ba la byin pa dang*/ chu bor dor ba'o// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pas mkha' 'gro'i gsang*// rdo rje theg pa'i dgos pa yid bzhin nor// snod bcud mtshan ldan brda yi de nyid mtshon// skal ldan rdo rje 'chang la sbyor thabs mchog /tshul lugs bzang por bdag gis spros pa yis// 'gro rnams dbang gi don mthong des grol nas// nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul gyi bdag por shog /

phyi rdul tshon la brten nas bum pa'i dbang bskur rin po che gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i phyag bzhes la sgro bskur gyi mtha' spangs te/ lho brag chu khyer gro bo lung du mar pa £à tis sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //083) ༄// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog las byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa las rtsa ba drug yan lag so dgu'i 'khrul 'khor dang gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad/ ༄// na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni/ rtsa mdud 'grol dang gegs sel gnad kyi mchog /lus kyi nad gdon ma lus sel bar byed// sems kyi ye shes ngo bo 'phrod par byed// rdzu 'phrul yon tan ma lus ster bar byed// bde chen thig le'i lus su 'gyur ba'i phyir// rdo rje'i tshig rkang legs par gsung ba'i don// rtsa ba drug ni bstan par bya// chos sku de bzhin nyid ni phra ba'i zhing*// 'dzam gling rlung gi rkyal pa 'bud par bya// srog rtsol mnan la thur sel gyen la 'then// ro snyoms gar gyi 'phrul 'khor skor ba ni// bde chen rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor rnam drug la// bde chen rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor rnam drug༈ seng ge rtse ba dsems dkyil dkyil krung bca'// lag gnyis snol la rkang la dlong 'bur mtshams la 'jus// gyen la dgru mo gnyis mkhal ma la brdab cing 'then la dmar lhod btang nas yar la 'then no glod par bya// de yis thig le 'dzin par byed// glang chen 'gying pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang gnyis bar la mkhyid gang bzhag dsgor nas/ /lag g.yon steng du lag g.yas bzhag /gyen du 'then la lan dgu d'phongs rting pa'i khar brdab// thig le gyen du 'dren par byed// rma bya 'phur ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// lag gnyis rkang pa'i dsgor mo byas la mthe bong bzung*// 'phongs dang rting pa re mos dsa la brdung*// thig le lus la khrems par byed// stag mo skyug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// dkyil krung bar du lag gnyis

dkha sbub bcug /ro stod dyar sangs byed bsnyegs shing skyug tshul dgu /de yis thig le 'dzin par byed// rus sbal bskum pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang gnyis bar du khru gang bzhag /lag gnyis brla yi nang nas ni// phyir la bstan la rkang mtheb bzung*// thig le gyen du 'dren par byed// bya rgod 'phur ba'i 'phrul 'khor ni// rkang pa 'theng 'gros re mos byed// lag pa phyogs bcur sprug cing 'khrab// de yis thig le khrems par byed// 'khrul 'khor de rnams byed pa'i tshe// chu mig gyen zlog dar chen 'phyar// rgya mtsho dlto ba brag dsgal pa gtad ri rab dsgal tshigs pa 'then no snyeng*// bar bar dag tu seng drlung sprug byed sprug bya// ngal bso mnyam bzhag phyag rgya bya// de yis thig le brtan par 'gyur// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa yi// nad rnams ma lus 'byung mi 'gyur// rtsa mdud rang sar grol bar byed// thig le gdon gyis 'dzag pa dang*// nad kyis 'dzag dang rkyen gyis 'dzag /rang bzhin 'dzag pa gcod par byed// las dang nyams grib ma gtogs pa// thig le thur rgyug btsan thabs zlog /dmigs pa bla ma'i zhal las dris// nyin re ma chag nyams su longs// yan lag 'khrul 'khor so dgu༈ yan lag 'khrul 'khor so dgu la// rgyal mtshan 'khrud pa yan lag bzhis// khrus ltar byas la khyab par byug /spu lus rtse ba sel bar 'gyur// ri rab 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// 'phur mnyed mgo bo khrus ltar mnye// nyes gsum gang yin mgo nad sel// zo chun ske mjing g.yas g.yon skor// gre ba ske mjing nad rnams sel// so pa khrigs gnon ri rab ni// phyogs bzhir lan grangs gsum gsum gdab// mgo bo'i nad dang sna nad sel// chu mig phyogs bcur ther tshugs lta// mig nad rab rib mun pa sel// 'on long gag dang ro mi tshor// lba ba gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing*// mgo bo'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed// de rjes ljon shing 'khrul 'khor bzhi// ri gsum rkang pa mgo lag gsum// shed tshad

dmgo yang 'then gyen 'dren dpung khar ldog /rtsib logs gzer ba'i nad rnams sel// gru gu brkyang pa khu tshur bcang*// dpung pa g.yas g.yon re mos brdung*// dpung nad mdun rgyab gzer ba sel// dbang po dgang ba lag pa gnyis// mda' gzhu 'geng dang re mos kyis// lag pa mi theg na ba dang*// ro stod na ba sel bar byed// mthe bong rked pa lag pa g.yas// zhags pa 'phen ltar skor zhing sprug /g.yas pas rgyab tu khu tshur gsum// de bzhin g.yon la'ang shes par bya// lag pa'i rtsa nad tshigs nad sel// rna khrag 'dzag pa sel bar byed// zha rengs nad rnams sel bar 'gyur// ljon shing rtsa mdud grol bar byed// stod kyi 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// skar mda' skor ba lag pa gnyis// dpung gnyis 'jus la g.yas g.yon dro stod bskor ba yin gru khug brang nas phral la gcu// stod smad tsha grang nad rnams dang*// mdun rgyab gzer ba sel bar byed// li ri dg.yas la gcu g.yon la gcu'o gcu ba lag pa gnyis// gru mor 'jus la gyen la dgru khug gnyis pho khar brdab bcu rdeb// 'khrugs dang glo mchin nad rnams sel// ri rab bcar ba lag pa gnyis// rdo rje bsdam pa lag sgreng zhing*// nu ma g.yas g.yon bkan la dsbar mo 'dom pa'i lag mthil brdab// brang gi dkyil du lan gcig brdab// thur la lan gsum sprug par bya// mtsher nad rtsib logs gzer ba dang*// ro stod rgyas dang na ba sel// gling bu 'bud pa lag pa g.yon// pus mor bkab la lag pa g.yas// dpung steng bkab la zur la blangs// ro stod g.yas g.yon re mos gcu// blo nad 'khrugs nad ma lus sel// snying rlung mgo rlung ma lus sel// 'grams 'khrugs skran nad ma lus sel// stod kyi rtsa mdud grol bar byed// sked pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// rgya mtsho sprug cing lte ba bskor// ma zhu lte ba'i bad snab sel// sgeg mo dgye ba kog langs la// lag gnyis rgyab tu shed tshad brkyang*// sked pa dgye log ci shes bya// mkhal nad dpyi mig gzer ba sel pa'i nad// tsha grang nad rnams ma lus sel// sked pa'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed// smad kyi 'phrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// rdo rje'i bgros ni lag pa gnyis// sgyid khung nang du snol la 'phar// pang la lag gnyis mdun du

dskyil krung byas nas lag pa mnyam gzhag byed do bzhag /stod 'tshangs rlung gi nad rnams dang*// drag po srog 'dzin rengs pa sel// chu srin brkyang skum lag pa gnyis// brla yi phyi nas re mos gcu// rkang pa re mos sprug par bya// lus kun na dang gyogs po dang*// rkang nad tshigs nad ma lus sel// sbal 'gros 'phag cing sgab sgab 'gro /chu ser skya rbab skem par byed// gzhi ni rdo rje dkyil krung yin// smad kyi nad rnams sel bar byed// rags dang phra ba'i rtsa mdud grol// thig le bu ga dgu rnams nas// 'dzag srung 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi mchog /tshe ring yon tan bsam mi khyab// rjes la bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs bya// nyin re ma chag nyams su blang*// 'di ni lag len mdor bsdus yin// rlung gegs sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bcu gcig dang*// seng ge rnam grol gzhan nas shes// nā ro paṇa chen phyag len bzhin// kho bo mar pa lo tsā yis// snod ldan don du yi ger bkod// snyan brgyud 'chal du mi 'jug cing*// nyams khrid rdzogs par ma thob par// gal te 'di nyid bsten gyur na// nag po che dang za byed dang*// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mgo bo khos// mchog dang thun mong tshe 'dir ster bar byed pa 'khrul 'khor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba rdzogs so// gser zho re yi maṇḍal med par mi gnang ba bla ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya yod// gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad/ ༈ gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad la// lag len gsal ba yi ger bkod// rlung skyon sbyong ba'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi// lus gnad sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi// btsan thabs drod dbab 'khrul 'khor gnyis// bying rgod sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis// mtshan mo nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor gcig /'gro ba'i dus kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis// gegs sel gnad kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis// thig le 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi// dril bas rkang grangs bco brgyad la// rlung skyon sbyong ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// mdun snol 'khor lo ltar skor ba// rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung bca'// lag pa mthe bong snol byas la// srin lag mnan la khu tshur sbyar// gcu zhing gcu zhing lan dgu 'then// rlung ni 'jam la ring bar 'bud// de yis rlung skyon sel bar byed// sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// dkyil krung tai lo'i chos bdun bya// rnam snang chos bdun zhes kyang bya// rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung bca'// drod ni shugs la skye ba yin// lag gnyis lte 'og sor bzhi ru// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya dam du bca'// rtsa kha 'byed cing bde ba skye// sgal tshigs drang por srang ba yi// rlung rnams rang gnas tshud pa yin// mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar du dgug

/snying rtse gyen log mi rtog skye// dpung mgo rgod gshog bzhin du brkyang*// dgos pa rlung nad chun pa yin// mig ni rna yi rtse mor lta// dmigs pa dag ni gsal ba yin// lus sems li ri ltar du sgrim// bde drod myur du skye ba yin// rgya mdud chings kyi 'khrul 'khor ni// gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la// rkang snol tsog pu pus 'khyud bzhugs// yon tan gong dang 'dra ba la// 'dis ni myur du drod skye 'gyur// ljon shing bsnol ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang pa re'u mig bzhin du bsnol// lag pa mkhrig ma'i mtshams nas bzung*// pus mo gnyis la bkan pa yin// grang ba'i nad rnams 'phral du 'joms// sku gsum snol ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang pa g.yon pa'i bol gong steng*// g.yas pa'i rgyu ma khug bzhag la// pus mo gnyis la 'khyud la bsdams// rtsa rnams yo ba srang ba dang*// rlung nad srang du tshud pa yin// 'phrul 'khor bzhi po'i gdams pa la// rgya mdud chings ni drod myur ro// btsan thabs dbab pa'i 'khrul 'khor la// gar gyi 'khrul 'khor drug chings ni// rkang pa re'u mig bzhin du bsnol// lag gnyis brla yi phyi nas bsnol// rkang mtheb gnyis bzung g.yas g.yon bskor// drod tshan me ltar 'bar ba dang*// ma zhu skran nad thal bar rlog /gangs la gcer nyal byas kyang tshugs// stobs chen seng ge lta bur 'gyur// sbrul bzhi bya khyung gnad la bor// mthe bong bzhi ni sa la gzug /mgo bo pus mo'i bar la gzhug /lus kyi 'gul skyod ci shes bya// yon tan gong dang 'dra ba la// chu kha snyi ba sdom par byed// bying rgod sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// bying na bya rgod mkha' la 'phur// lag gnyis gdeng la mkha' la sprug /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig ga g.yas mkhal ma'i steng du bkab// pus brang sprad la g.yon pas bsdam// bde drod lus la 'bar ba dang*// nub gos ras kyis chog par 'gyur// 'gro ba'i dus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni// mkhar ltar dbab pa zhes bya ste// gan rkyal byas la 'phar zhing sprug

/chu ser rengs pa skem par byed// thig le khrems par the tshom med// lus ni lhun sdug mdzes par byed// ne le res 'jog 'phrul 'khor ni// thur sel drag po ma brjed bzung*// rlung gi lha mo gshog pa can// gnyis kyis mchan 'og 'degs par bsam// rkang 'og rlung gi dal la ni// gzhu yi dbyibs can mchog ma nas// ba dan hur hur skyod par bsam// lag gnyis khu tshur bcang ba dang*// lag g.yas rkang g.yas gdong la bor// lag g.yon rkang g.yon rting la bor// mi gcig nyin bdun phyin pa'i sar// nyi ma gcig la sleb par 'gyur// gegs sel gnad kyi 'khrul 'khor ni// seng ge rtsal sprug ces bya ba// dkyil krung pus steng lag gnyis bkab// lus kyis dgang sprug yang yang bya// rlung gzhil thig le khrems par byed// ro stod seng ge bzhin du 'gyu'aphrul 'khor ni// rkang pa'i mthil ni sprad byas la// langs la pus mo lag pas bkan// mgo sogs smad la gyen du drangs// hig ka hig ni drag tu brjod// seng ge gan log sbyor ba ni// rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung bca'// lag gnyis dkyil krung bar du btsug /hig ka hig ka drag tu brjod// rjes la seng ge rtsal sprug bya// de rjes mnyam bzhag ngang du klod// 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams byed pa'i tshe// chu mig gyen log dar chen 'phyar// rgya mtsho brag gtad ri rab snyeng*// 'og rlung drangs la gling bzhi bsdu// 'khrul 'khor 'di la brtson gyur na// sba ba sbubs nub thig le 'ching*// phra dang rags pa'i rtsa mdud grol// lus ni bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan// tshe ring skra dkar med par 'gyur// mdog snum gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing*// gzhon nu mdzes ldan lhun sdug 'gyur// nang rtags mkha' 'gro dam can 'du// 'khrul 'khor re res grub thob glo bur byed pa'i gnad// gtum mo 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba// rje mar pa lo tsās mdzad pa snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gdams pa rdzogs so//

// 084) ༄// snyan brgyud las rje mar pas mdzad pa'i mchog dbang gsum dngos su bskur ba'i lag len no// ༄// na mo gu ru de wa ḍākka ba dang*/ gang la bskur ba dang*/ gang du bskur ba dang*/ dus nam bskur ba dang*/ thabs gang gis bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ dam tshig dang ldan zhing dbang gsum pos rgyud grol ba gcig gis so// gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyis rgyud yongs su dag cing rtog pa med pa la'o// gsum pa ni/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba dang*/ skye bo'i rgyu 'grul gyis dben pa pa'o// bzhi ba ni/ na tshod dar la bab pa/ bum dbang thob pa/ nyi zla gzas zin pa'i dus su'o// lnga ba thabs gang gis bskur ba la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing mchod rdzas 'god pa dang*/ brten pa dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang bo la gsum ste/ rten bskyed cing brten pa bzhugs pa dang*/ byin rlabs mchod bstod dbul ba dang*/ nyams grib sdig pa bshags pa gsum gzhan dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa brten pa dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa dang*/ dam tshig bsgrag pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po la gsum ste/ slob dpon bdag 'jug bya ba dang*/ slob ma gzhan 'jug bya ba dang*/ mtshams bsrung ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ gsol 'debs dngos grub blang ba dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi 'jug pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gis mchod pa bshams te/ phyag dang bskor ba byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bum dbang yan chad gsal btab bo// gnyis pa ni/ ka pā lar bdud rtsi sbyar la bla ma bka' brgyud la gsol ba drag tu btab bo// de nas rang gi thugs kha'as pa slob ma gzhan 'jug bya ba la gsum ste/ khrus byas te maṇḍal phul ba dang*/ gdong g.yogs te nang du bzhugs pa dang*/ skor ba byas te gsol ba gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ yol ba'i phyi rol du gnas pas yan lag rnam lnga la khrus byas la maṇḍal phul te/ skad cig gis bde mchog tu bsam la gsol ba drag tu btab bo// gnyis pa ni/

slob ma dar gyis gdong g.yogs la las kyi rdo rje la 'jus te nang du 'ong ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ e ma bla ma e sangs rgyas// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// zab pa chos 'byung dkyil 'khor du// rang byung ye shes blta 'dod dam// zhes brjod pa dang*/ slob bu des/ de ltar 'tshal lags so// zhes brjod do// de nas lho nub mtshams su ro'i gdan la bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ skor ba gsum bya/ phyag gsum/ mchod pa gsum byas la/ gsol ba gdab pa grol lam gyi skabs bzhin sbyar te/ de'i thams cad la bya'o// gsum pa mtshams bsrung ba ni/ khang pa'i phyi rol thams cad nyul/ sgo dam du gcad de mis ma tshor bar bya ba dang*/ gnas dbang bsrung ba la sogs pa bya'o// gsum pa dam tshig bsgrag pa la gsum ste/ gsang ba'i dbang la ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig sgrag pa dang*/ gsum pa la sring mo rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig sgrag pa dang*/ bzhi pa la sems nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig sgrag pa'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba dngos la gsum ste/ gsang dbang ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong byed sems rang rig tu dang*/ shes rab ye shes yid kyi sgrib pa sbyong byed rang rig bde chen du dang*/ tshig dbang sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong byed bde chen spros bral du ngo sprad de dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ lta sgom dam tshig dbog pa'o// dang po ni/ gdong g.yogs bsal te/ lho'i thig le dkyil 'khor drung du bla ma yi dam tha dad med pa la dmigs te/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes ni// zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba gdab/ khyad par gsang dbang zhes pa bzhug go /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ slob ma'i bya ba dang*/ bla ma'i bya ba dang*/ ngo sprad de sgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mtshan ldan gyi rig ma rgyan dang bcas te bla ma la dbul ba dang*/
