sku// ma btsal bzhag na sgom pa ste/ btsal zhing sgom pa 'khrul ba'i blo// mkha' dang cho 'phrul ji lta ba// sgom dang mi sgom gnyis med par// bral dang ma bral ga la yod// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dge dang sdig pa'i las rnams kun// de nyid shes pas grol bar 'gyur// nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste// nags la me bzhin rnal 'byor grogs// 'gro dang 'dug pa ga la yod// dgon par phyin nas bsam gtan ci// de nyid ma rtogs gang gis kyang*// gnas skabs tsam las grol mi 'gyur// de nyid rtogs na gang gis 'ching*// ngang las ma yengs gnas pa la// lus ngag bcos shing sgom du med*// mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag ces// gnyen pos bcos zhing bsgom du med// 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// cir snang rang bzhin med par shes// snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// rtog pa rang grol ye shes che// gnyis med mnyam pa chos kyi sku// chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab ltar// gang ltar gnas kyang don dang ldan// 'di ni rtag tu sangs rgyas nyid// 'khor ba yul med bde chen por// chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong*// stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag

/blo bral yid la byar med pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// skal pa rab tu gyur pa la// bdag gis snying gtam tshig tu bsdus/ 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa// phyag rgya cha la gnas par shog /phyag rgya chen po'i tshig bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po nā ro pas bod kyi mar pa lo tsā la gnang ba rdzogs so// //

102)༄// sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i snyan gyi shog dril las phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus mchan 'grel/ ༈ snyan gyi shog ril 'di la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug gi don no// dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan dang*/ phyag dang*/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'i don rnams kyi dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra sa na tsa mi tha/ bod skad du dyul dbus kyi mi rnams kyis ngos 'dzin gyi phyag rgya chen po'i dye shes kyis rgyas btab pa tshig bsdus pa/ gnyis pa phyag ni zag med c bde chen ngang la phyag 'tshal nas// gsum pa dam bca' ba ni chos can la chos nyid kyis c phyag rgya chen po drgyas btab pa'i don tshig tu brjod par bya// 'khor 'das kyi c chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems dlas gzhan du ma grub cing / phyi rol dgyi sems las gzhan du don mthong dba ni 'khrul ba'i blo/ yin te/ dper na c rmi lam dgyi snang ba bzhin te ngo bo dsems las gzhan gyi stong dngo / sems kyang dran rig 'gyu ba tsam dma gtogs par / dran rig 'byung ba de yang bden pa'i c rang bzhin ddu grub pa med de rlung gi rtsal drtsal yin ta ེ/ sems rang gi c ngo bo stong pa ddper na nam mkha' bzhin dno / de ltar phyi nang gi c chos kun nam mkha' ddang 'dra dzhing rang bzhin med pa mnyam dpar gnas dpa de la / lon btab pa ming phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gzhan med pa'i c phyag rgya chen zhes brjod pa yin dno / phyag rgya chen po c rang gi ngo bo bstan du med ddo / sems kyi rgyu mtshan c de'i phyir sems kyi dgnas lugs de bzhin dmed pa nyid do/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nyid las/ gang du yang ma bcos pa c de las dgzhan du bcos shing bsgyur du med dpa yin no / gang zag c gang gis dsngar rten pa'i tshul de nyid dphyag rgya chen por mthong dzhing rtogs na/ 'khor 'das c snang srid dkyi chos thams cad phyag rgya che/ chen po 'am/

chos sku brdal khyab chen po'o/ mthong ba'am rtogs pas so/ rang bzhin dgnas lugs de rnam rtog gis ma bcos dpar rnal mar bzhag dpar bya'o / de ltar c bsam du med pa d'i don chen chos kyi sku dyin la/ 'bras bu chos de las gzhan du c ma btsal dba de ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la cir yang snang ba bzhag na sgom pa dyin ste/ de las gzhan du c btsal zhing sgom pa dgnas lugs 'khrul pa'i blo dyin no / dper na nam c mkha' dang dsprin la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul ji lta ba dbzhin no/ de las rang bzhin cir yang 'char ro/ sgom dyang dag pa'i sgom pa dang mi sgom gnyis med par/ rtogs pa de la nyes skyon dang c bral dang dma bsgom pas ma bral ga la yod/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa c de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dpa de la/ dge dang sdig pa'i las rnams kun/ de dkho na nyid shes pas dla grol bar 'gyur/ 'dod chags la sogs c nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste/ pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa de bas na c nags la me bzhin rnal 'byor dpa'i grogs dyin no/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa de la c 'gro dang 'dug pa ga la yod dcing / dgon par phyin nas bsam gtan ci dzhig sgom du yod de med do / de dkho na nyid dkyi don ma rtogs dna dge ba gzhan gang gis kyang*/ gnas skabs dlha mi'i bde 'bras tsam las d'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol dbyang chub thob mi 'gyur dro/ chos thams cad kyi c de nyid rtogs na dlas gang ddang nyon mongs pa gis d'khor bar 'ching*/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i c ngang las ma yengs dpar gnas pa dtsam la/ lus ngag dyid kyis bcos shing sgom du med dla/ 'di ni c mnyam par bzhag dang d'di ni mnyam par ma bzhag dpa'o ces/ gnyen pos bcos zhing bsgom du med// de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs c 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// cir snang rang bzhin med par shes/ sna tshogs kyi c snang ba drang bzhin med par rtogs pas yul

rang grol chos kyi dbyings dyin no/ dran pa dang c rtog pa dci 'gyus med par shes pas yul can kyang rang bzhin rang grol ye shes chen dpo yin cing*/ rang bzhin gnyis med dpar yul yul can mnyam pa chos kyi sku dyin no/ de ltar rtogs pa de ni c chu bo chen po'i rgyun dma chad par 'bab dpa ltar/ c gang ltar gnas kyang don dang ldan dla/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ba c 'di ni rtag tu dye nas sangs rgyas dyin pa la nyid/ yin par rtogs pas c 'khor ba yul med dpa de rtsa ba nas rang bzhin med par bde chen por dshes pa la/ 'khor 'das kyi c chos rnams rang rang dgi ngo bos stong dpar rig cing / stong par 'dzin dpa'i blo dyang rang gis ngo bos stong par shes pas rang sar dag dla/ gnas lugs c blo bral yid la byar med pa d'i ngang gnas par rtogs / 'di ni ddus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyi lam dchen po yin no/ gang zag c skal pa rab dder mchog tu gyur pa la/ nā ro pa c bdag gis snying gtam tshig tu bsdus/ pa'i dge ba c 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ phyag rgya che dna po'i don la gnas par shog phyag rgya chen po'i tshig bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po nā ro pas bod kyi mar pa lo tsā la gnang ba rdzogs so// // 103) ༄// phyag rgya chen po'i tshig bsdus 'grel pa/ kyi yon tan dang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas gsol ba dung dung zhig gdab/ de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyu dang cung zad dros pa na/ lus mnyam gzhag tu bya zhing yi dam gyi lhar bskyed/ mig sna rtse'i thad ka'i nam mkhar mig 'bras ma 'gul par rtse gcig tu dril la ji ltar tsam tshugs tshugs su blta bar bya ste/ bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ mig ni mi btsum sems ni 'gags pa dang*// rlung 'gags pa ni dpal ldan bla mas rtogs/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de nyid kyis ngag rlung gi 'gyu ba yang bag gis chad par 'gyur mod kyi/

rtsol bas kyang cung zad bzung bar bya ste/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ me dang rlung dang dbang chen 'gags pa na// bdud rtsir rgyu ba'i dus su rlung nisems la 'jug gsungs la/ de nyid kyis rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyur ba sna tshogs shugs la 'gag par 'gyur mod kyi/ bzang ngan mtho dman re dogs kyi rtog pa gang yang yid la mi bya bar gal bo che zin pa'am/ thang chad pa ngal sos pa'am/ yid mthun gyi grogs dang 'phrad pa lta bur bde 'bol le/ shig ge lhan ne bzhag par bya ste/ de nyid kyis/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di/ glod na grol bar the tshom med/ gsungs so// gal te gang ltar byas kyang sems gnas su mi btub par chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du/ rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs su thol thol skye bar gyur na/ dang po rtog pa'i byung sa rtsad bcad pas/ 'di nas byung bya ba'i byung sa mi rnyed/ tha mar 'gro sa rtsad bcad pas/ 'dir 'gro ba'i 'gro sa ma rnyed/ bar du rang gi ngo bo dbyibs dang*/ kha dog gi dngos por ma grub ste/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong par shes pas/ dran rtog ci skyes/ yang dag par rnam par mi rtog pa chos kyi dbyings su grol bas phan gnod ma nus pa ni/ lbu ba chur zhi'am/ lho sprin nam mkhar thim pa lta bu ste/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ sems nyid me long nang du gzugs brnyan 'char ba de/ rkyen shar yin te bden par ma 'dzin kye/ zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ dran pa'i kha rlangs sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin// 'di la bdag po 'dug pa ngas ma mthong*// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bla mas ngo sprod cing 'phrod pa'i don la ma yengs par bskyang bar bya'o// mdor na phyag rgya chen po yang dag pa'i nyams len ni/ stong pa phyogs gcig blo yul du byed pa ma yin te/ gzhi snang stong dbyer med kyi steng du/ lam rig stong 'dzin med/ 'bras bu ched du byed pa blo'i dri ma gang yang med pa/

blo bral du lhan ne 'jog pa zhig yin te/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i don// 'bras bu gang du'ang re bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes gsungs so// //phyag rgya chen po'i zhal gdams 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngo sprod do// ´/ 104) ༄// snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ka Ç tal badzra pa da na ma/ bod skad du/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ho* sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba'i mchog /ye shes rgyal po thig le mchog gi lam// tshig tu brjod pa kun dang bral ba'i don// theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos/ rdo rje 'chang ngas skal ldan don du bshad// gus btud nas ni ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon// bslab gsum rgyan ldan nyams myong bla ma'i mchog dad brtson shes rab snying rje slob ma'o// nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btang*// thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la brten nas// drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi bskur// rdo rje phag mo sin Zà ra yi dbang*// lha mo bco lnga dbang bzhi brda yis mtshon// smin par byas nas thabs shes zung du sbrel// rgyal po blon sogs rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad// bsre ba ro snyoms dam tshig gsum la sbyar// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung*// lus gnad bdun ldan lha sku'i stong ra gnad// ZÓ ti la la ra sa 'khor lo bzhi// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag srog rtsol thur sel gcud// rdo rje bzlas pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom// zin dang brtan pa shes rab snyoms par 'jug /dga' bzhi goms pas rtsa rlung thig le 'dres// ZÓ tir rlung sems tshud pas mi rtog pa// nyon mongs rang zhi bde gsal rgyun mi 'chad// ngo bo mthong nas chos sku'i ngang du gnas// bogs 'don sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la// 'khor 'das thams cad sgyu mar shes byas te// sgyu ma'ang 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'o// da ltar snang ba dngos po'i chos rnams ni// bden cing brtag na 'gyur bar ga la rigs// 'khrul gzugs yin phyir don la grub pa med// gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams brag car ltos// gnyis 'dzin zhig pas chags sdang kun dang bral// de ltar shes pas sna tshogs zhen med ོda// 'ja' lus chos sku thob par 'gyur ro kye*

/mtshan dus rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs la// sgo gsum 'bad pa dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung*// 'dzin sbyangs spel bsgyur sprul cing gegs rnams sel// nyi zla zhon dang zhing khams mtha' dag bgrod// bzang ngan sgyu ma cir snang rang grol ltos// mthar phyin sa bcu non nas don chen thob// khyad par 'od gsal ma rig mun bral la// lus gnad thabs ldan ting 'dzin bzhi la sbyor// thig le gsum ldan dug gsum 'dzin med ltos// gnyid dang rmi lam rnam rtog bar nas bzung*// rim pa bzhi dang nyin mtshan bsre zhing goms// ma rtogs sbyang gzhi phyag rgya chen por blta// gsal stong 'dzin bral lhan skyes ye shes de// brjod du med pa 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad// 'pho ba gser 'gyur ma bsgoms sangs rgyas ni// 'chi ltas shar tshe dga' zhing zhen pa btang*// sgo dgu bkag la rdzas dang smon lam rgyan// hūṃ dang rlung sems dbyer med ZÓ/mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam bde ba chen po ni// bcu drug nyer lnga'i bar gyi rig ma ni/ paVlhan skyes ye shes rang bzhin dbyer med ston// snang srid thams cad zag med bde bar 'char// gsang dbang phyag rgya bdud rtsi ril bu'i phyir// thig le bcu drug phyed phyed bzhi cha sbyin// bzhi gsum 'khor lo dag la dgram par bya// bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos// don la nyams shing slar yang ngan song ltung*// de na rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med// phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed ni// sgo gsum g.yo med sgo lnga rang thad gzhag /bltas pas mthong med sems kyi mtshan nyid ltos// dmigs su med pas ma bcos rang sor gzhag /gzhan du ma tshol ngo bo rtogs par gyis// gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na// 'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i klong yangs su// skye shi med pa chos sku'i lus mthong 'gyur// phyi rol yul sems chos rnams ji snyed pa// rang sems yin phyir gzhan na grub pa med// 'khrul rtog gnyis 'dzin sna tshogs gang shar rnams// cir snang gzhi med rang byung rang brlag ltas// sems nyiung 'dzin mtha' dag bral// 'du shes blo dang 'khor 'das chos rnams zad// mkhyen tshad yon tan ji snyed rang la rdzogs// bsam brjod blo 'das sangs rgyas rang 'khrungs yin// bar do ngo sprod yang dag zab don bstan// skye shi rmi lam srid pa'i bar do gcod// bltar med bltas pas mthong med mthong ba'i mchog

/rang rig gsal stong mi rtog sgrib g.yogs bral// bde chen chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rang bzhin dbyer med sku gsum rang shar ltos// ma rtogs lus ldan bar do rnam gsum la// bskyed rim sgyu lus 'od gsal chos skur bsre// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rim gyis thim// brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te// dkar dmar sems gsum chu skyes nang du 'dzoms// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin ma bu dbyer med 'dres// chos sku sangs rgyas dbang po yang rab bo// de ma zin na rlung gsum rkyen gyis 'ching*// 'bring po chu la nya ltar longs skur 'gyur// rtsa lnga zer lnga dug gsum las kyi dbang*// chags snang gnyis kyis mngal du 'jug 'gyur bas// bsre ba lnga ldan lam khyadu bsnun// bya ོda thams cad tshogs su bsgyur bar bya// go rim ma nor nyams su blangs gyur na// skad cig bzhi la dga' ba gsum ston te// dngas ma yas byon 'gyu ba mas brten pa// rtsa mdud rim pas grol nas ZÓ tir 'gyur// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtsa ba lnga// rlung dang nyon mongs 'gags nas ye shes 'gyur// gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs// pūDgsang ba'i nges don mdzod// ces ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la gdams pa/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang rdzogs so// // mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal snga dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis pu a ha ri'i gnas chen du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// 105) ༄// rlung gi zhal gdams/ ༄// na mo gu ru de wa ḍa ki ni/ pa pra ma na/ sems can rnams kyi srog gyur pa// rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// 'di ni rnam shes zhon pa ste// lnga yis bdag nyid bcu yang yin// zhes pa'i don nyid rlung thabs log non ni// rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya// rtsa ba'i rlung dang yan lag rlung*// lnga lnga bcu ru shes par bya// rtsa ba'i rlung la rnam pa lnga// gnas dang las dang sgom thabs dang*// zin rtags log non rnam pa lnga// gnas ni thur sel sgrol la gnas// las ni gshang gcin thur la 'phen// sgom thabs a long 'byed 'dzum bya// bde ba 'dod na de ltar bsgom// zin rtags log non ma log zin// log par zin na na tsha 'ong*// ma log zin na yon tan skye/

log na na tsha 'byung lugs ni// rkang pa 'khril cing smad sgo na// dri chen dri chu sdom par byed// log non 'di ltar shes par bya// u rgyan sgo la byug pa bya// mgo mjug bzlog la ro smad sprug /rkang mthil gnyis su khu tshur brdung*// gzhug gu chung nas stong rus bar/ khu tshur rim gyis gdung bar bya// rkang pa brkyang bskum sna tshogs bya// dmigs pa u rgyan sgo na mar// rlung ni har har 'gro bar bsam// dang po dmigs pa

¨ mar gtad// res 'ga' lcags 'phyong thengs 'ga' bya// des ni mi sos mi srid do// gnas ni me mnyam lto bar gnas// las ni pho ba'i me drod skyed// zas skom gnyis po 'ju bar byed// sgom thabs rgya mtsho brag la gtad// sked pa g.yas g.yon skabs su gcu// drod chen 'dod na de ltar sgom// zin rtags log zin ma log zin// log par zin na na tsha 'ong*// ma log zin na yon tan skyed// log na na tsha 'byung lugs ni// sked pa gzer zhing mkhal ma na// pho ba sbos shing bshal ba dang*// zas mi tshud cing shes pa bying*// zas skom 'ju bar dka' ba'o// log non 'di ltar shes par bya// snum dugs chang gis kha spru btab// sked pa bskor zhing skye ba gcu// dmigs pa snying khar gtad par bya// rgya mtsho brag la gtad byas la// khu tshur gsus pa mnye bar bya// de yis mi sos mi srid do// srog 'dzin rlung ni snying khar gnas// las ni lus kyi srog kyang 'dzin// dbugs kyis 'gro 'ong byed pa yin/ sgom thabs rang thang shes pa glod// rtag tu mar la bstim tshul bya// bde bas lus la khyab 'dod na// de ltar yang yang bsgom par bya/ zin rtags log zin ma log zin// log pa zin na na tsha 'ong*// ma log zin na yon tan skye// log na na tsha 'byung lugs ni// snying ni 'chu zhing sprugs pa dang*// dran pa mi gsal snying rlung 'phyo// shes rgod smyo ba la sogs 'byung*// log non dang po sku mnye bya// rlung sdom sprugs shing ro stod gcu// stong dus ha yis gdab par bya// dmigs pa rdo rje nor bur gtad// chu snang nang du mchongs pa dang*/ phung po chu ru gzhugs pa dang*// chu yis sna la gtad par bya// dngangs skrag ci skye'i thabs yang bya// de yis sos par 'gyur ba yin/ gal te de yis ma sos na// snying gi nang du hūṃ bsam la// hūṃ ring mang du brjod par bya// de yis phyi ru 'thon par 'gyur// spra mar me btsa' gdab par bya// rkang pa'i mthil chen snying rtsa bsreg

/sman mar zhun chen la sogs btang*// snying dkyil nang du bla ma bsam/ de yis mi sos mi srid do// gyen rgyu'i rlung ni mgrin par gnas// las ni mchil snab gyen du 'dor// sgom thabs sna yi dbang po sdom/ rlung sems dpral ba nyid du gtad// stong nyid 'dod na de ltar sgom// zin rtags log zin ma log zin// log par zin na tsha 'byung*/ ma log zin na yon tan skye// log na na tsha 'byung lugs ni// lkug par 'gyur zhing mgrin pa na// lkog 'bras la sogs 'byung ba yod/ dbugs kyi 'byung rngub shin tu dka'// srog gi bar chad 'byung ba yod// log non 'di ltar shes par bya// dmigs pa lte bar gtad par bya// lus gnad cha nas sgrim par bya// chu mig bsgrad cing lus po 'dar// drung na yod pa'i grogs po yis/ rkang pa sa la ma reg par// 'dra ma dbus gnyis thal mo gdab// ro stod sang sang blangs la sprugs// sku mnye byas la sgal tshigs brdung*// lcags mchong yang yang bya bar gsungs// mgo mjing bskor zhing mgo bo sprugs// ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu zhing sprugs/ mgo bo g.yas g.yon 'then res bya// de yis mi sos mi srid do// khyab byed rlung ni tshigs na gnas// las ni 'gro 'dug 'khrul 'khor byed// sgom thabs seng ge rnam rol byed// lus gnad cha nas cha ru bsgrim// rdzu 'phrul 'dod na de ltar bsgom// zin rtags log zin ma logs zin// log par zin na na tsha 'ong*// ma log zin na yon tan skye// log zin na tsha 'byung lugs ni// rgal tshigs na zhing yan lag 'khums// yan lag brkyang bskum shin tu dka'// log non dang po sku mnye bya// sked pa bskor zhing zhags pa 'phang// na sar stong ra khrol tshags can// rtsa sna nyi shur dmigs pa gtam sked pa gcu// grogs kyis rkang pa sa la ma reg par// ro stod sang pas btab la yang yang du// ro smad drag tu sprug tu gzhug par bya// mgo bo phyed tshal du na na// ltag par 'then la mgo bo sprugs// mgo bo ljog 'gul mang du bya// mgo bo phyogs bzhir 'then res bya/

nang stong ra glang tshags lta bur bsam la// de na phar rlung nad tham tu bsgom par bya// chu shas che na lus po grang*// thig le drag tu nyams nas 'gro// de la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// thig les dgang ba shin tu gces// srin sdom rgya mtsho brag la gtad// me shas che na lus po tsha// kha sna skam zhing bde ba med// de la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// thig les dgang ba shin tu gces// srin po'i zhal ni legs par sdam// rlung shas che na rig pa rgod// mi rtog skye med bsgom pa dang*// srog rtsol drag tu bsgom par bya// shes pa glod pa shin tu gces// mkha' ltar rig pa yangs su gzhug /nam mkha' shes bya snang ba med// stong stong phyam phyam po ru 'gro// lha sku sgyu mar bsgom pa dang*// gsal ngar 'don pa shin tu gces// ltas stong 'thur du lta ba dang*// thad kar hrig ge lta ba'o// des ni 'byung ba ro snyoms nas// ting nge 'dzin gyis ro myang 'gyur// zas kyi ro snyoms zhal las shes// sa la zas ni rtsub pa btang*// chu la zas ni drod tshad btang*// me la zas ni bsil du btang*// rlung gi kha zas bcud ldan btang*// nam mkha' la ni ro snyoms btang*// lag len bla ma'i zhal las shes// mar pas mdzad pa'o// // ´/106) ༄// dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rnam gsum/ ༄// na mo ra * gu ru/ dman pa dbyibs la zab pa sngags/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros med do// sngags kyi rnal 'byor la gsum ste lus la sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ rlung la sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gsum ste 'khor lo gcig la brten pa dang*/ gnyis la brten dang bzhi la brten pa'o// rlung la gsum ste/ bgrang zhing brtsi ba la bslab pa dang*/ yan lag la bslab pa dang*/ bum pa can la bslab pa'o// de la gnyis te seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas dgag pa dang*/

dgag pa'i sbyor ba'o// thig le la gnyis te steng sgo rnam par grol ba dang*/ 'og sgo bde ba chen po la brten pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ steng gi sna rtse snying khar nyi zla kha sbyor/ 'og gi sna rtse gsang bar thig le nyag gcig lus kyi dbus su dkyil 'khor bzhi bsregs nas bde ba'i thig le bsgom pa'o// chos kyi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ thig le chos kyi rnal 'byor/ snang ba chos kyi rnal 'byor/ spros med kyi rnal 'byor ro// dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gyi tha mal gyi rtog pa spong*/ sprul pa'i sku 'thob/ zhi gnas las su rung*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed do// sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis sdug bsngal dang btang snyoms kyi rtogs pa spong*/ longs sku 'thob/ zhi gnas las su rung bar byed/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed do// chos kyi rnal 'byor gyis dngos por zhen pa spong*/ chos sku 'thob/ lhag mthong las su rung*/ bde ba chen po mngon du byed do// 'bras bu la gnyis/ gtso bo dang*/ zhar la sgrub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni sku gsum ye shes lnga'o// gnyis pa ni grub chen brgyad dang*/ las ram 'byams kyi tshogs so// de skad du yang*/ sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid// rnal 'byor rnam gsum shes byas nas// ye shes rnam pa gsum gyis ni// srid pa'i nyes pas gos mi 'gyur// zhes so// // ´/107) ༄// spros med ting 'dzin dbang gi shog dril/ ༈ rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ thugs rgyud man ngag 'di rnams kyi dbang lung ni rnam pa gnyis te/ spros bcas dang spros pa bsdu ba'i lugs so// de la spros bcas ni mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i lugs te/ pha rgyud ma rgyud rnams kyis dbang chu ltar bskur ba yin pas gzhung gzhan du shes par bya'o// 'dir rnal 'byor pa ku su lu pa'i lugs te spros pa bsdus te bstan pa zab mo'i lugs yin no// rnam pa gcig tu na blo rab sngon sbyangs las 'phro can la bdag 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zab mo 'di kho na yin phyir bka' rab tu gdams par bya'o// 'di ni rdo rje 'chang gis gsang ba'i bdag po la bskur// des rnal 'byor ma la bskur/

des tai lo pa la bskur/ des nā ro pa la bskur/ des mar chung bdag la pu a ha rir bskur/ bu chen gzhan la sems kyis ma khrel nas thugs rgyun man ngag skor gyi chos sgo dbang chog 'di nyid phyi ma'i dus su skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i rigs mchog bdag rdzus gcig dang 'phrad par shog/ // smon lam btab/ dud sol lha mo la gnyer du gtad nas sras mkhar nang du a daṃ rgya'o// ghu ƒཿ ´// ༈ rgya gar skad du/ badzraṇḍa drug mdzes// sku gsung thugs gnas 'bru gsum mtshan// gsang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa// nang hūṃ rtse las phaṭa kyis mtshan// yum gsang pa V/byang sems mgrin pa'i gnas su dbab// mchog dga'i nyams skyes gsang dbang ngo*// byang sems snying kha'i gnas su dbab// lhan cig skyes dga' ye shes dbang*// kye ho bde stong dbyer med byang chub sems// 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje// rang dang tha dad yod ma yin// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom dbang thob// de nas dri ma kun dag ste// bde stong dri med nyams dang ldan// de nyid dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs nas// rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du bsam// dbyer med phyag rgya chen por shes// dngos po'i gnas thabs rang byung la// lam mchog de yis smin grol nas// 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang nyid 'grub// de rjes chos bka' rim par gtad// sgo gsugs rgyud skor 'dis bstan pa gsol// grub thob brgyud pa gdon mi za// sras mkhar nang du a daṃ rgya'o// // ´/ zab zab/ rgya rgya// 108) ༄// 'dod chags rdo rje'i shog dril/ ༈ u rgyan gyi gdams pa// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi yang snying*// rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa// man ngag rin po che gser zhun dril ba lta bu yin te// dpal nā ro pa chen po'i bzhed kyis// lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad// sems kyi gnas thabs lta ba'i gdeng*// phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku// nang ni rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// zhes pa'i don// sgyu ma lta bu lha yi sku// sems nyid gnas thabs lta ba'i gdeng ni bskyed rdzogs

dtshig bsdus skyed rdzogs tshig bsdus ni slob dpon la ba pas bzhed pa/ tshig sde bzhi sum cu gnyis su bsdus pa ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo sprad pa dang*/ bral ba rang bzhin dri ma med pa/ mtshan nyid snang stong dbyer med/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'o// de rnams ni gzhi'i chos yin la/ lam gyi chos bzhi ni/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po gsal ba rang byung ba/ ma skyes pa lhun gyis grub pas mi rtog pa bde gsal mi rtog pa dbyer med zung du chud pa'o// 'bras bu'i chos bzhi ni/ sku gsum dbyer med pa bde ba chen po 'od gsal zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes so sor rang rig g.yo ba med pa'i bris/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das par dag pa'i mdzad pa'o// de la phyag rgya chen po'i don bsdus bzhi'o// 'di dag bdud rtsi chu rgyun las gsungs so// kyi skabs su ston la// lus kyi gnas thabs bsgom pa'i gnad la// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhis/ shes pa la// de yang dpal nā ro pa'i bzhed pa// rtsa rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag rlung rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag thig le rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag gsum 'dir bsdus nas ston pas/ chags grol gnyis kyi man ngag ces bya'o// de yang rgyal po mchog gsum de rab mchod// maṇa tra am̐ pa nga la dris/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha rgyal mchog /sngags kyi rgyal mchog gsum pa yin// de yang 'khor lo bzhi na sde pa bzhi gnas// sde bzhi lha yi pho brang bzhi// lha'i pho brang bzhi na lha bzhi gnas te/ lha bzhi re re la 'khor lo bzhi bzhi gnas so// rgyud saṃ £mkha'i lha mo pang na gnas// de ni 'byung ba gcig la dbang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni// chu yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// hūṃ las rdo rje mgon po bzhugs// baṃ gyi rang bzhin mā ma ki// rigs kyi dbu rgyan gong dang mtshungs// yum ni 'byung ba gcig la dbang*/

mgrin par mang pos bkur ba ni// me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// paV mgon po yi ge hrīḥ// ma yi rang bzhin gos dkar mo/ kun gyi dbu rgyan rnam snang mdzad// nam mkha'i lha mo pang na gnas// bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo ni// rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ khaṃ las las kyi mgon po bzhugs// ya yi rang bzhin sgrol mar grags// kun gyi phyogs na lha bzhi ste/ de ni 'byung ba bzhi la dbang*// rigs kyi bdag po gong dang 'dra// de ni lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi// nges pa kho na bstan pa'o// sngags kyi nges pa 'di lta ste// g.yas pa thabs kyi rtsa sgo nas// rlung kha dog lnga yi rang bzhin de// ye shes lnga yi ngo bor byas// yi ge hūṃ du gyur nas su// rlung dang yi ge tha dad med// hūm̐ dpag tu med pa phar la 'phros// 'od zer lnga yi nus pa las// nang bcud kyi sems can ma lus pa// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur// g.yon pa shes rab rtsa gnas su// 'byung lnga rlung gi rang bzhin te// tshur 'dus yi ge'i rang bzhin oṃ// rlung dang yi ge tha dad med// 'od zer lnga yi ngo bor byon/ brtan g.yo dbsnyen sgrub tshig rkang las/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rtsa ba'i rlung rnams kyang de dus sku gsung thugs bcas bzlas par gyur zhes ZÓ ti'i mar sna ru// sems dmigs yi ge a la gtad// rlung dang yi ge tha dad med// 'byung bzhi rlung gi rang bzhin te// nam mkha'i rlung du ro gcig na// 'jig rten khams kun mchod pa'i gnas// rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid 'gyur// sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag /khyab bdag nam mkha'i gzugs su 'gyur// de ni sngags kyi nges pa ste//ngag lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// de yang*/ rtsa gsum 'dus dbus me thab tu// rlung gis bskul ba'i ye shes me// shes rab stobs kyis rab 'bar te// lte bar gtum mo spar nas ni// de yi mthar yang rim bzhin bsregs// brgyad kyi mthar ni bcu pa ste// yi ge bcu yi 'du tshul dang*// nyon mongs lnga yi gnas tshul gnyizhin no// a ba ZÓ srub pa'i sbyor ba las// dga' ba bzhi po rim bzhin gnas// bde ba nyams su myong ba yang*// rdo rje reg sogs bskul nas kyang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis// zla re bcu phrag gnyis pa la// bco lnga la ni de rab mchod// dus mchod chen por 'dod pa yin// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lung las kyang*// lte bar gtum mo spar ba yis/sde tshan lnga bcu tham pa ni// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang*// rgyud sde bzhi dang sde snod gsum// bcu gnyis bar nas bzhi ston pas/

ri ri li li bzhi ston pas/ yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ shan ti pas zhal nas/ mdo sde dbyangs snyan lung du bstan// tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*// rtogs brjod de ltar byung ba dang*// skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa'i sde// rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'o// ces gsungs so// 'di yi ge la sbyar na dbyangs yig bcu drug nang nas ri rīi li lī bzhi ma gtogs gzhan a ā nas aṃ a bar yin no// gsang sngags rgyud du 'dod pa yin// sde tshan lnga ni mdo yi sde// mthar gnas lnga ni mngon pa la// de dbus yig 'bru 'dul ba dngos// brjod pa kun gyi thog mar ni// a ni khong nas 'byung ba yin/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med// tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed// rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum de la// rab tu gus pas phyag bgyid do// sde pa re la gnas brtan bzhi// thams cad 'dus na bcu drug yod// chos dpon nam mkha'i thig le byed// chos rnams skye med tshul du bshad// 'byung bzhi rlung ni bza' mi yin// gang la gnyer bab de las byed// gnas brtan bzhi la bza' mi ni// stong tsho gcig dang brgyad cu yod// de bzhin gnas brtan bcu drug la// bza' mi stong tsho bzhi dang ni// sum brgya nyi shu yod par 'do /gnyis po drug pa bsnan pas ni// brgyad po gnyis su 'dod pa yin// brgyad po gcig la chos dpon gyi// brang khang che chung tshad dang ldan// rtsa rnams khyim gyi tshul du yod// phyi sgo gnyis po steng nas sdom// nang sgo gnyis po nang nas sdom// mchod khang sgo ni dbus na de// phyed pa med de shin tu dka'// sde pa bzhi yi chos danyis// sde pa bzhi la dris na gsal// rtsa yi thun tshod brgyad po ni// yod par smra ba'i sde pas brtsi// rlung gi thun chen brgyad po yang*// 'pho ba gnyis la thun tshod gcig

/nyin mtshan gnyis la brgyad du 'dod// thig le'i thun tshod brgyad pa ni// 'khor lo bzhi na brgyad brgyad gnas// rtsa yi 'pho ba bcu drug ni// mgrin pa'i gnas na brtsi zhing yod// rlung gi 'pho ba bcu drug ni// thun tshod re la 'pho dus gnyis// nyin mtshan gnyis la bcu drug yod// thig le'i 'pho ba bcu drug ni// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// rtsa yi dbyu gu drug cu bzhi// gnas brtan pa'i khyim na brdeg /rlung gi dbyu gu drug cu bzhi// bzhi thun re la phyed du bgos// lnga brgya bzhi bcu 'ong ba yin// thig le dbyu gu drug cu bzhi// sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab pa dang*// bzhi la sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas// drug cu re bzhi de ru rdzogs// dus kyi rlung la khu byug bzhin// de tshos thams cad gsal bar gnas// 'byung bzhi phyi yi zhing sa la// skye mched bcu dang lhag ma gnyis// ston thog tshul du rtsi ba yin// bde ba chen po'i snod du sdud// zas skom gnyis po nang gi rdzas// rtsa gsum 'dus mdo rgya thab ste// mnyam gnas rlung gi phyag tshang pas// sde pa bzhi yi bza' mi gso// bza' mi gnas su ma tshud na// 'thab dang rtsod pa mang po 'byung// gnas brtan phyi ru 'thon pa na// nang gi sde pa nyams nas 'gro// gnas brtan bzhi na chos dpon re// sde pa bzhi la shin tu gces// bzhi stong sum brgya nyi shu po/ chos dpon bzhi la 'dus nas su// stong po brgyad cu dang mnyam na// rlung ni rdo rje thod pa la// sbyor ba'i man ngag 'di nas ston// gtum mo'i man ngag bsgom pa gces// sde pa bzhi na gnas brtan brgyad// thams cad bgros nas gnas brtan la// 'bab pa'i 'phrin las byed dus der// nye zho med par byon nas su// sngar gyi gnas brtan bzhugs nus na// thig le rdo rje thod pa la// sbyor ba'i man ngag 'di nas ston// chags lam bsgom pa shin tu gces// rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis po/

kun 'dar ma dang khyad med par// phyi dang shin tu gsal ba dang*// 'gyur ba shin tu bde ba ni// gzung 'dzin gnyis las grol ba ste// rtsa rnams rdo rje thod pa las// ZÓ ti'i nang du sbyor ba'o// zung 'jug sgom pa shin tu gces// rang lus thabs dang ldan pa las/ bdag gi rnam dag de yis shes// 'khor lo bzhi yi lte dbus na// lha yi rnam dag yang dag gnas// rlung gi 'byung 'jug phra mo ni// sngags kyi bzlas pa yin shes pas// g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi gzung 'dzin rlung*// ZÓ tir gnas pa ye shes yin// dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi// bzhi tshan gnyis po gtum mo dang*// chags lam gnyis la sbyor shes na// de ltar bsgoms pa'irtags rnams ni// gtum mo bka' dpe'i nang na gsal// brgyud pa 'di ga 'dzin pa yi// 'khrul 'khor bla ma'i zhal las shes/ rtsa gnas bzhi yi mdud pa de// sked pa g.yas skor g.yon skor gyis/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin// dpung ring g.yas 'gyings g.yon 'gyings kyis// snying kha'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin// g.yas skor g.yon skor dgye dgu yis// mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin// rkang lag brkyang bskum byed pa yi// tshigs kyis rtsa mdud grol ba yin// gnas pa rtsa yi man ngag dang*// g.yo ba rlung gi man ngag gnyis// bkod pa byang chub sems la sogs// man ngag 'di las gzhan gyis min// de phyir shin tu rnyed dka'o// brang gi snying dang dpral gyi mig /mchan gyi bu las gces med phyir// man ngag 'di nyid gtad sa ni// 'dod chags rdo rje nyid la'o// //´/109) ༄// 'pho ba ser sna rdo rje shog dril/

༈ u rgyan gyi gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi yang snying*/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa'i man ngag dpal nā ro ba chen po'i bzhed kyis/ sbyangs te 'pho ba'i man ngag gsum yin gsungs/ de la rtsa rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag rlung rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag thig le rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag dang gsum mo// de la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las// de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsags na// dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur// mya ngan 'das pa mi bzad mes// thal ba lus par mi 'gyur ro// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyal po mchog gsum de rab mchod// maṇa tra am̐ sa nga la dris// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha rgyal mchog /sngags kyi rgyal mchog gsum pa yin gsal// sbyang dang las la sbyar ba las// sbyang ba'i dus ni 'di bzhin bsgom// a ba ZÓ ti'i mar sna nas// ma las thob pa'i thig le gcig /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas// de las 'od byung phyi nang gi /dngos po ma lus bsregs par bsam// phyi yi snang ba dkar dmar dang*// nang gi rnam rtog ma lus pa// ye shes lnga yi kha dog dang*// yum gyi sa bon la sogs pa// skad cig nyid la bsregs par bsam// nyi ma'i ོra byon// a ba ZÓ ti'i yar sna na// pha las thob pa'i thig le gcig /zla ba'i tshul du gnas kyi yod// de las 'od byung chu rgyun gyis// phyi nang ma lus dag par bsam// lha rnams sku khrus gsol ba yis// shin tu mdangs dang ldan par bsam// sbyang ba'i dus ni thams cad du// sgyu lus phung po mi bsgom par// rang sems yi dam lhar gsal nas// dngos po kun la zhen pa dang*// chags pa'i mtshan ma cung zad kyis// 'ching bar yang ni mi nus te// sems nyid rtsal sbyong goms pa las// stong pa stong pa chen po dang*// gsum pa shin tu stong pa las// 'od gsal ba la gnas par bya// de yi bde ba chen po ni// rang dbang med pa'i 'pho ba yin// dkyil 'khor bzhi dang lha bzhi po// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha rgyal mchog

/go rim bzhin du 'dod pa yin// sngags kyi rgyal mchog yig 'bru dgu// sgo dgu 'gegs kyang 'di na gsal// yum gyis smad kyi sgo bkag la// yab kyis stod kyi sgo rnams bkag /shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag ni// las gyi sgron me'i nang du ltos// bya ba byed dang mi byed pa// cho ga thams cad de nas ston// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni// mgo bo byang phyogs dag tu bstan// ngos ni gsal ba 'og tu gzhag /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs la// bar chad med pa'i gsol ba gdab// phyi nang gsang gsum 'chi rtags rnams// go rim nges par 'byung bas na// a ba ZÓyum gnyis// me yis bsregs pa man ngag yin// 'od kha dog sngon po sran chung tsam// rnam snang thugs kar gong dang 'dra// sna yi dbang po 'gags tsa na// snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gnyis// me yis bsregs pa man ngag yin// 'od kha dog dmar po skyer 'bru tsam// rnam snang thugs kar gong dang 'dra/ lce yi dbang po 'gags dus der// don yod grub pa yab yum gnyis// me yis bsregs pa man ngag yin// 'od kha dog ljang khu byi sran tsam// rnam snang mdzad kyi thugs kar bstim// rtsa yi mtshan nyid shin tu gces// nyi ma'i 'od las me byung nas// rang nyid lha yi skur bsgoms pa// bsregs nas 'od du zhu ba ste// rnam snang mdzad kyi thugs kar bstim// thig le rdo rje thodanas su bsu// lce yi dbang po nyams pa yis// rnam par shes pa thim dus der// steng 'og rlung gi 'byung 'jug ni// las kyi sgron mes gsal bar byed// rlung ni rdo rje thod pa la// sbyor ba'i man ngag de nas ston// gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pas// nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes su// rin chen 'byung ldan 'tshang rgya'o// tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pas// zhe sdang me long ye shes su// rdo rje sems dpar 'tshang rgya'o// 'du shes phung po rnam dag pas// 'dod chags sor rtog ye shes su// snang ba mtha' yas 'tshang rgya'o// 'du byed phung po rnam dag pas// phrag dog bya ba'i ye shes su// don yod grub par 'tshang rgya'o// rnam shes phung po rnam dag pas// gti mug chos dbyings ye shes su// rnam par snang mdzad 'tshang rgya'o/

shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs dang*// bag la nyal rnams gtan nas spang*// rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen du// tshe 'di nyid du 'tshang rgya'o// gong gi 'chi rtags gang zhe na// phyi yi snang ba dkar dmar la// dgra dang 'dre yi 'du shes 'byung*// shin tu 'jigs pa'i 'du shes kyis/ spang bya'i dngos po mthong ba de// phyi yi 'chi ltas yin par gsungs// nang gi 'chi ltas gang zhe na// bu ga gnyis nas rgyu ba'i rlung*/ dza ra na ni 'gyu ba chad// ro hi ta nas rtag par ni// bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig tu// skad cig gcig kyang mi 'pho bar// rtag tu rgyu na 'phos nas 'chi// gzhan yang 'chi ltas 'di rnams 'byung ste g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i ngur sgra chad pa dang*/ glog lcam 'bar ba'i nga ro ral pa dang*/ ti se gangs kyi rlangs pa shor ba dang*/ rma bya'i mdongs ni yal ba dang*/ dbus kyi ka ba la btsan gyi brag pa bkye ba dang*/ rta mchog sngon mo'i sna chu skam pa sogs 'byung ngo*// gsang ba'i 'chi ltas/ nā ro pas/ 'chi ltas byung na rnal 'byor pas// mar la ma dbab yar la thong*/ zhes so// 'di bzhin 'ong*// rtag tu thig le 'dzag pa dang// thig le'i nang du nag po 'byung*// yang na khrag dang bcas nas 'dzag /rtsa rlung bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyis// bsrungs pas mi thub 'chi bar 'gyur// 'chi ba blus pas mi lhus te// tshe ni pha rol 'pho bar 'gyur// blu bar 'dod na 'di bzhin sgom// dang po 'chi rtags nges pa ste// de la man ngag 'di bzhin bya// nang bcud sems can ma lus pa// yi dam lha ru gsal btab la// byin rlabs dbang bskur rdzogs par bya// yi dam lha yi sbyor mtshams nas// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi gnyis// dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa// 'bri yi mar khu bskol lta bu// rang gi lce yis ldag par bsam// mid pas khog pa'i gnas su bstim// rtsa gsum rtsa bran thams cad du// bde ba dang bcas khyab 'gyur te/

ba spu'i bu ga'i sgo nyid du// yi ge hūṃ du gyur par bsam/ nang gi 'chi ltas nges pa la// blu ba'i man ngag 'di bzhin bsgom// lte ba'i 'og nyid sor bzhi'i gnas// rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gnas nyid du// rlung gi rdo rje rgya gram gcig /kha dog ljang khu gsal bar bsgom/ steng 'og rlung ni kha sbyar nas// drag tu gcun pas 'khor bar bsam// 'byung ba sa chu me la sogs// rlung gis gtor nas stong par bsam// gsang ba'i 'chi ltas nges pa la// las kyi phyag rgya mtshan ldan gcig /dben pa'i gnas su bkug nas ni// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen bsham// maṇḍa// 'jig rten khams su sgra byung ste// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// thugs kyi rgyud bskul byon nas su// rigs lnga'i rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams// 'khor lo bzhi la thim par bsam// rdo rje rigs dang rin chen rigs// pad ma las kyi mgon po rnams// de la sogs pa'i rigs tshogs kun// rigs bsdus bye brag so so yi// byon pa'i gnas nyid shes par bya// 'chi ba bzlog pa'i man ngag go /des kyang 'chi ba ma bzlog na// sngon las 'chi dus chen po yin// 'pho ba'i las la sbyor dus su// gang la'ang zhen pa med par gces// bla ma dkon mchog la sogs la// mchod pa bshams la gsol ba gdab// rnam snang mdzad kyi thugs ka ru// thig le kha dog go rim bzhin// ma yengs pa ni gnad yin no// steng 'og rlung gi kha sbyor te// rgyu zhabs sgal pa la sbyar nas// 'og sgo steng sgo las sgo las sbyor te/ sbyor ba gsum gyi man ngag bya// dus la bab na btang ba dang*// dus min lha rnams gsod par byed// steng nas thog ni babs pa las/ de la mkhas pas ci zhig bya// man ngag gnad kyi 'pho ba la// myur ba nyid du bzlog pa med// sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya// // 110) ༄// gti mug rdo rje'i shog dril bzhugs/ ༈ u rgyan gyi gdams pa/

mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi yang snying*// rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa// gser zhun dril ba lta bu'i man ngag /de yang dpal nā ro pa'i bzhed kyis// 'gro ba gang zhig gnyid log pa// gnyid log sad par mi byed do// bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// zhes pa'i lung yid ches kyis gte gces te// de la rtsa thod sbyor gyi man ngag rlung rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag /thig le rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag go /lung las kyang*/ rgyal po mchog gsum de rab mchod// maṇa tra aṃ sa nga la dris/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha rgyal mchog /sngags kyi rgyal mchog gsum pa yin// dang po dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni// bde bar gshegs pa mi bskyod pa// bzhugs pa'i pho brang dkyil 'khor yin// mi bskyod pa'i thugs ka ru// yi ge hūṃ zhig gsal bar sgom/ hūṃ gi yi ge nā da la// dmigs la mi rtog ngang la bzhag /nyin par nam mkha'i mthongs su bsgom// mtshan mo snying gi dkyil du sgom// nam gung yol nas tho rangs bar// thams cad yod smra'i sde pa ste// mi bskyod pa yi zhing du 'dod// bla ma mi bskyod lha tshogs la/ srod kyi bar du gsol ba gdab// srod nas nam ni ma phyed bar// gnyid mi nyal zhing sku khams gseng*// nam phyed dus na rang nyid kyi// snying gar dmigs pa gsal byas la// mgo bo shar phyogs dag tu bstan// ngos ni g.yas pa 'og tu gzhug /g.yon *// stong tsho gcig tu 'dod pa de// chos dpon nyid la 'dus nas su// thar lam nyams su len pa dang*// chos rnams spros dang bral ba yi// snang ba'i mtshan ma zad gyur nas// gnas brtan bzhi yi chos mdun la// chos med mdun ma zhig gyur na// tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya ba'i/ sangs rgyas tshul/ nā ro pa thar lam gyi lus 'di 'od gsal du thim nas sangs rgyas par 'dod/ mai tri pas/

gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ltar ram/ sbrul lpags rjes pa ltar sangs rgyas par 'dod// 'od gsal skye med 'byung ba'i gnas// thams cad yod smra'i sde pas shes// rtogs par 'dod na de bzhin bsgom// nyin par nam mkha'i mthong nyid du// yi ge hūṃ sngon rang mdog ldan// shin tu gsal bar dmigs nas su// de las 'od zer kha dog lnga// 'jig rten khams su 'phros pa las// brtan g.yo thams cad 'od du zhu// slar 'dus hūṃ la thim pa yis// hūṃ nyid shin tu gsal bar bsgom// mi rtog pa la blo bzhag pas// gnas par nus na de nyid bskyang*/ gal te gnas par ma nus na// ū yi rang bzhin don grub ste// yi ge ha la thim par bsam// snang ba mtha' yas ha de nyid// zla tshes rin chen 'byung ldan la// thim nas zla tshes thig le la// thim pas mi bskyod nyid du 'dod// shin tu phra ba de dbus nyid// nā da rnam snang mdzad yin te// phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa// thig ler dmigs la mi rtog sgom// nyin mo'i dus ni thams cad du// sna tshogs mtshan mas ma yengs par// stong pa nyid la gnas nus na// mi rtog ye shes skye bar 'gyur// spros pa can gyi rdzogs rim yin/ shin tu spros med rnal 'byor pa// snang ba sna tshogs gsal ba ni// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang*// chu nang zla ba ji bzhin du/ snang bar zad mod grub pa med// chags pa'i 'dzin pas ma gos shing*// tshogs drug yul gyis ma bcings pas// rang snang 'dzin med nyid du grol// nyin mo sgom pa'i lam de yin// lam gyi 'od gsal zhes bya'o// mtshan mo gnyid kyi 'od gsal ni// gong gi lus gnad dmigs pa la// mchog tu nan tan gtsor byas te// lha yi rgyal mchog mi bskyod pa// sngags kyi rgyal mchog hūṃ nyid yin// de yang nyal ba'i dus nyid du// snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros nas// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi// sdig sgrib ma lus dag nas su// bshang lam gnyis nas thon par bsam// gsang sngags rgyal po de nyid la// bsnyen pa brgya rtsa brgyad du bya// de nas gnyid du 'gro ba na/

hūṃ gi thig le nā da la// dmigs nas mi rtog sgom pa yin// drung du grogs po gcig bzhag la// gnyid du yun ring mi btang bar// thumadu gcod pa'i man ngag yin// grogs pos bslang ba'i dus de ru// 'od gsal zin nam ma zin pa// rang gis rang la dri ba gces// zin na gnyid kyi rang bzhin de// bde stong nyid du 'char ba dang*// sad pa'i dus der rang sems de// spros dang bral bar 'char ba yin// des kyang zin par ma nus na// bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa dang*// grogs po rtogs pa'i gdeng yod la// tshogs gsog shin tu rgya cher bya// ḍā ki rnams la tshogs gtor dang*// yi dam lha la gtor ma gcig /mi sha a mṛ ta yis brgyan// glo dkar gcig tu sbas bzhag la// mtshams kyi bar du rta ra bzung*// a ba ZÓ ti'i na nyid du// nam mkha'i mthong nyid gsal bar bya// tshangs pa'i bu ga'i 'og nyid du// thig le sngon po sran ma tsam// de la dmigs la gnyid du btang*// 'od gsal rtogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgya la rmi lam rmi na yang*// mtshan ma bzang po 'byung ba dang*// rang sems bde ba dang bcas te// skyon gyis gos par mi 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i mthong snang 'byung// de la nges shes skyes nas su// 'od gsal nyid du 'jug par 'gyur// zla phyed sgom pa shin tu gces// des kyang zin par ma gyur na// gsang ba smin mtshams bar de ru// nam dkar gcig la dmigs pa gtad// stong pa 'od gsal yin snyam du// dmigs la gnyid par byas pas zin// dran pas zin pa shin tu gces// de ltar zla ba phyed du sgom// tha mal gnyid ni spang bar bya// dang po rmi lam med pa'i nyams// gsal la rtog pa med par 'byung*// de ni lam gyi 'od gsal lo// brtan pa thob nas mngon gyur te// bde gsal chos sku 'byung bar nges// gnyid dang ma gnyid khyad par med// gnyis snang bag chags zad par 'gyur// sngon byung thub pa chen po yis// tshogs gnyis sngon du song ba las// 'od gsal rgyud la skyes dus der/

ting nge 'dzin la chags pa yis// 'od gsal rgyud la ma skyes pas// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus nas// de yi dus su dbang bskur te/ de dag thams cad mgrin gcig tu// 'od gsal la ni gnas gyis dang*// 'od gsal la ni gnas byas na// rab dga'i gzugs su ston par 'gyur// zhes pa'i gsung ni byung ba la// brten nas byang chub shing drung du// rtswa chag gang la bzhugs gdan byas/ rdo rje skyil krung ma bshig par// 'od gsal ba la gnas bya snyam// 'dun pa sngon du song ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin la zhen pa thongs// tshogs gnyis sngon du song ba dang*// srod la bdud kyi tshogs btul nas// tho rangs 'od gsal mtshan med thob// thub mchog dam pa dpa' chen pos// skyes bu kun gyi kha lo bsgyur// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid ni// 'od gsal chen po thob par 'gyur// don gnyis grub pa'i 'bras bu yin// bstan pa 'di nyid yongs bzung ste// bstan pa las byung phrin las 'di// 'od gsal chen po'i man ngag yin// gnyid kyi 'od gsal mi brtan zhing*// bar mtshams med par ma 'byongs na// brtan ུsa su lta// nyin par sgom pa'i man ngag yin// mtshan mo gnyid kyi 'od gsal te// rtag par rgyun du gnas 'dod na// dmigs pa du ma mi spo bar// a ba ZÓ ti'i nang nyid du// nam mkha' sngo skya sprin bral 'dod// mtshan ma dang bral skye med gnas// chos nyid mtshon pa'i rtsa de la// shes pa lhan gyis gtad la nyal// yid ni ZÓ ti'i dbus su blta// mtshan mo sgom pa'i man ngag yin// gang yang yid la ma byas shing*/ 'od gsal yid la ma byas na// nyin mtshan gnyis kyi 'khrul pa de// skye med spros dang bral bar 'char// rang nyid mtshams ni dam por bcad/ g.yog po gcig gis mthun rkyen sgrub// srod la g.yog po gnyid du btang*// tho rangs rang nyid nyal bar bya// g.yog po langs la rtsar bzhag la// skad ni mi che mi chung bar// chos rnams thams cad 'od gsal gyi// rang bzhin yin zhes zer du gzhug

/mi gcig zan za'i bar nyid du// gnyid du btang la grogs pos bslang*// dpal nā ro pa'i bzhed pa yis// gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar shed na/ gti mug 'od gsal gyi ngo bo can// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis thebs// skye med chos sku'i ngo bo can// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// 'khrul pa lam slongs 'di ngo mtshar che// slob dpon chen po la ba pas// lo ni bcu gnyis bar du ni// 'od gsal ba la gnyid log pas// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob// des na gsang sngags thabs lam che// lam gyi 'od gsal sa// dkyus su bkod par mi rigs kyang*// snying dang 'dra ba'i sras po la// mig dang 'dra ba'i man ngag sbyin// 'gro la phan dang gnas bya'i phyir// sku gsum thob pa'i man ngag yin// rtsod gzhi dus kyi snyigs ma la// lnga brgya tha mar bsnyen dus 'dir// log chos mu stegs dar ba dang*// nang pa'i bstan pa nyams dus 'dir// mi nad 'khrugsdmkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma dang*/ dud sol ma dang*/ dung skyes ma dang*/ mun pa'i mdog can ma la sogs pa'i ye shes

rnams kyi gnyan rgya dang*// zab mo'i gdams pa'i zab rgya gsum// rgya gsum gyis btab pa'i man ngag yin/ zab rgya/ gsang rgya/ gtad rgya/ sa ma ya ta pa ta/// / 111) ༄// nga rgyal rdo rje'i shog dril/ ༈ u rgyan gyi gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi yang snying*/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa/ gser zhun dril ba'i man ngag de yang dpal nā ro pa chen po'i bzhed kyis/ bcom ldan 'das gdan bzhi'i lung gtsor mdzad de/ de yang*/ gang zhig skye ba kun rdzob bden zhes te// 'chi ba'i ming yang don dam bden pa yin// rim gnyis de dag bla ma'i drin gyis ni// rnyed pa 'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin// zhes pa'i lung 'dir smos te// de yang rtsa rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag /rlung rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag /thig le rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag dang gsum yin te// de yang rgyal po mchog gsum de rab mchod// maṇa tra am̐ sa nga la dris// zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha rgyal mchog /sngags kyi rgyal mchog gsum pa yin// 'dir yang rdo rje'i lus 'di la// rang bzhin sde pa bzhi gnas te// de la lha bzhi gnas pa'o// de de rnams ni 'chi ba na// don dam kun rdzob bden pa'o// de la bar do 'byung ba ste// lus can thams cad 'chi ba'i tshe// snang ba'i mtshams ni 'di ltar sbyor// gzugs kyi phung po thim pas na// lus kyi nyams stobs chung du 'gro /mnyam nyid ye shes thim pas na// dbang chen dkyil 'khor nyid la'o// lus po sgul bskyod mi nus shing*// mig gi dbang po 'gags pa yin// rang lus mdangs dang bral bar 'gyur// yul gzugs thams cad mi gsal lo// rin chen mgon po'i rigs can gyi// lha rnams thams cad skad cig gis// don dam dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug /tshor ba'i phung po thim pa na// tshor ba nyams su mi myong ngo*// me long lta bu'i ye shes thim// chu yi dkyil 'khor nyid la'o// lus po skam par 'gyur ba yin// rna ba'i dbang po thim pas na// sgra mi thos shing sgra yul 'gag

/rdo rje mgon po'i rigs can gyis// lha rnams thams cad skad cig gis// don dam dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug /'du shes phung po thim pas na// sems can dran par mi 'gyur ro// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thim// 'gro ba rnams ni mi dran no// me yi dkyil 'khor nyid thim pas// kha zas thams cad mi 'ju zhing*// sna yi dbang po thim pa ste// steng rlung dal gyis 'gro bar 'gyur/ dri yul thim pas bro mi 'gyur// pa V mgon po'i rigs can gyis// lha rnams thams cad skad cig gis// don dam dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug /'du byed phung po thim pas na// lus kyi bya ba thams cad la// yid ni 'jug par mi 'gyur ro// bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes thim/ dgongs pa dran par mi 'gyur ro// rlung gi dkyil 'khor nyid thim pas// rlung bcu rang gi gnas su thim// lce yi dbang po thim pas ni/ thung dang rtsa ba sngon por 'gyur// ro yi yul rnams thim pas ni// ro drug nyams su myong mi 'gyur// las kyi mgon po'i rigs can gyis/ lha rnams thams cad skad cig gis// don dam dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni// snang mched thob gsum rim pa yis// gcig la gcig nyid thim pa na// 'od gsal mngon du byed par 'gyur// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni// de la bya ste spros dang bral// nam mkha'i khams kyi dkyil 'khor ni// 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid can// lus kyi dbang po thim pa ste/ stong nyid rdo rje'i sku thob pas// lus ni reg bya'i rtog dang bral// rnam snang mgon po'i rigs can gyi// lha rnams thams cad skad cig gis// don dam dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug /de ltar phung po lnga dang ni// ye shes lnga dang 'byung ba lnga// dbang po lnga dang yul lnga po/ de dag thams cad 'od gsal gyi// dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug pa la// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ces bya'o// dbang po rab kyi gang zag gis/

dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog 'od gsal gyis// bar do dang por 'tshang rgya ba'i// man ngag nā ro chen po'i gzhung*// chos kyi sku yi man ngag go /gnyis pa sgyu ma'i skur ldang ba// dag dang ma dag rnam gnyis so// dag pa rgyal ba'i zhing khams dang*// rang lus yi dam lhar gsal na// 'od gsal me yi dngos po yis// bag chags thams cad bsredu lhung*// dbang chen sa yi dkyil 'khor de// kho la dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char// rtogs na rin chen mgon po yin// yid gdungs pa yis skom pa dang*// sa la sdang zhing chu la chags// chags sdang gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas// chu rlung thur la log pa yis/ 'khyag nas me yi drung du phyin// nyon mongs rlung gi rang bzhin gyi// chags pas mi skyod 'jig rten khams// me yi rang bzhin nyid du 'phar// me rlung kho la phog pa yis// zhe sdang sdum gyi skye ba yin// dbang chen me yi dkyil 'khor de// rtogs na paV mgon po yin// khron pa chen po'i gting nyid du// rgya mtsho chen po'i snang ba 'byung*// skom pas yid gdungs chags pa dang*// rgya mtshor subs kyis dogs pa yis// sdug bsngal dpag med nyams su myong*// las ngan dbang gis lus de la// chu rlung phog pas grang ba yis// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong*// dbang chen chu yi dkyil 'khor de// kho la dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char// rtogs na rdo rje mgon po yin// 'khyags pas yid gdungs shin tu mnar// chu la sdang zhing me la chags// chags sdang gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas// me rlung thur la log pa yis// 'khyags nas me yi drung du phyin// nyon mongs rlung gi rang bzhin gyis// chags pa mi bskyod lo ka'i khams// me yi rang bzhin nyid du 'bar// me rlung kho la phog pa yis// zhe sdang rum gyis skye ba yin// dbang chen me yi dkyil 'khor de// kho la dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char// rtogs na pad ma mgon po yin// tsha bas yid gdungs shin tu mnar// me la sdang zhing rlung la chags// chags sdang gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas// rlung gis rlung nyid thur la log

/tsha nas rlung la phyar bas su/ chags pa rlung gi rang bzhin du// lo ka'i khams kun rlung du 'khrug /rlung gis bskyod pas rang dbang med// ngan song gsum du 'khyam dgos pas// dbang chen rlung gi dkyil 'khor de/ kho la dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char// rtogs na las kyi mgon po yin// 'khrul bas yid gdungs shin tu mnar// yi mug rang gi lus po la// gsod gcod mtshon cha'i las la sogs// lcib pa'i 'du shes byung tsa na/ phyogs kyi gshin rje chen po bzhis// skad cig nyid la slebs nas su// rang gis rang nyid ma gsod cig /de 'dra'i las la kho bdag mkhas// byed pa'i 'byung khungs 'di na yod// sta res gshog cing sog les 'dra// gsor gyis 'bigs shing tho bas brdung*// ral gri spu gri'i tshal gseb tu// khyod nyid dga' ba'i las bya'o// zer te yar 'drud mar bshal byed// duḥkha dpag med nyams su myong*/ mi zad rtsub pa'i las byas pas// bzod par dka' ba nyams su myong*// shin tu mi bzod cho nges 'debs// skyabs gnas skyel ma tur te dran// bla ma mchog la gus pa yis// gus pa'i yid kyis su/ gsol ba shin tu drag tu gdab// sdug bsngal grol 'gyur the tshom med// rgya mtsho che dang chu klung gi /chu rlung dgra ru shar ba na/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi bum pa la// mi bskyod pa'i pho brang du// bsams te btung dang khrus byas nas// kaṃ ka ni yi sngags bzlas shing*/ dad gus shin tu drag po yis// bar chod med pa'i gsol ba gdab// duḥkha che las grol bar 'gyur// me rlung drag pos bskyod pa dang*/ snang ba me ru byung ba na// dur khrod mgon po'i me de nyid// paV mgon po'i pho brang du// mos par bsams te rang nyid kyi// sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsam// dad gus shin tu drag po gces// tshe dpag med kyi sngags bzlas shing*// gsol ba yang nas yang du gdab// rlung 'tshub chen po byung dus su// dgra yi snang ba shar ba na// nang du rngub pa'i sbyor ba yis// phyi yi 'tshub ma zhi bar bsasu skye ba na// mi med byang thang stong ba la// nyi ma grang mor 'char ba dang*// zla ba tsha mor 'char ba 'byung*// mya ngam thang gi dkyil nyid du// chu med gram pa skam po krog

/skom pa chu yis yid gdungs te// zas kyi rnam pa mi myong zhing*// mtshon cha thogs pas bsrung ba dang*// dri dang rnag khrag nyid du mthong*// zas skom skabs su mthong na yang*// za dang 'thung ba mi shes shing*// 'khyigs pa bzhin du gsal ba 'ong*// lus po bkren dang rgud pa yi/ stobs nyid shin tu chung bar yong*// khog par lugs bsregs bcug 'dra 'byung*// kha nas dud pa 'thul ba dang*// rus mgo lpags kyis btums pa dang*// dur khrod keng rus 'dra ba'i mdog /rang lus gzhan lus de ltasgyu ma lta bur bstan pa'i blo// gang la zhen pa med par bya// sngon gti mug che la goms pa yis// dud 'gro nyid du skye bas na// zhag phyed dang bzhi yi phyi ma la// gar skye'i gnas su gyur nas 'gro /chu la gnas pa'i dud 'gro ru// gal te skye na chu de nyid// gzhal yas khang du mthong nas yong*// sa steng gnas pa'i dud 'gro ru// skye na dud 'gro pha mar mthong*// chags sdang gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas// khyo dang chung ma'i 'du shes 'byung*// dus der bla ma la ni gdams pa gces/ sngon yang 'di 'dras 'khor bar 'khyams// da ni gnas shig legs gdoms la// lam sbyong chos la yid 'jug go /rgyal rigs shing chen sā la sogs// sems can don byed nus pa yis/ 'gyur// bar do'i gdams pa de rnams kyang*// da lta nyid nas sbyang zhing bsgom// bar do gnyis kyi dus 'di ru// dran 'dun drag po yengs med gyis// gzhan la ma spel sbas pa'o// pua ha ri'i nā ro pa las rnyed pa'o// malོ*// gzhan ka kha la sogs pa ni pho'i yi ge nyin mo skyes pa'am thabs kyi yi ge zhes bya'o// ka kha la sogs bco brgyad/ ya sogs brgyad/ hūṃ dang nyer lnga'o/ ma ning gis bskyed sa bon ni/ zhes pa ni/ ri rī gnyis 'dus pa las hūṃ tha mar mi 'gyur ba bstan pa dang*/ li lī gnyis 'dus pa las am̐ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba'i yi ge'o// de la bsgrub bya lha'i yi ge dang po mthun nam mi mthun bltas la/

dngos grub 'grub mi 'grub blta'o zhes bshad do// // 112) ༄// phrag dog rdo rje kun bkur sde/ ༈ u rgyan gyi gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi yang snying*// rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa// gser zhun dril ba lta ba ß7Ü man ngag /rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje'i gzhung las// dang po sprin dang 'dra ba ste// gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur// nyal dang log pa'i khyad par gyis// sad la bye brag gzhan med par/ zhes pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pa'i bzhed pa/ khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// skye shi bar dor snang ba 'khrul// rmi lam bar dor bag chags 'khrul// srid pa bar dor las kyis 'khrul// srid pa gsum du 'khor bar 'khyams// da ni de las ldog par bya// ces dang*/ yang rmi lam dus kyi shes pa de// gnad mgrin pa oṃ gyi sa bon can/ zhes pas/ de la rtsa rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag rlung rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag /thig le rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag gsum gyis ston pas/ rgyal po mchog gsum de rab mchog /maṇa tra am̐ sa nga la dris/ zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha rgyal mchog /sngags kyi rgyal mchog gsum pa yin// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// zhing khams gcig na sde pa gcig /mang pos bkur ba yin par grags// mgrin pa mang pos bkur bas na// mang pos bkur ba zhes bya'o// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus na ni// pad ma dmar po 'dab bzhi la// snang ba mtha' yas mthe bong tsam// de yi mgrin pa'i dbus nyid du// thig le dmar po yungs dkar tsam// de la dmigs pa gsal ba zhig /nyin mo'i dus su sgom pa gces// ngag tu a nu ta ra oṃ// ci nus bsnyen pa bya ba dang*// phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa// snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams su/ dran 'dun drag po yang yang bya// 'dun pa bcu drug bskyed pa ni ngo shes pa'i// shes pa'i rting du lcags btab la// nub kyi pad ma'i 'dab ma la// yi ge dmar po ta bsam ste// de la dmigs pa gtad la nyal// sa ni sros nas nam phyed bar// pad ma mgon po'i zhing khams yin// mang pos bkur ba'i chos dpon dang*// gnas brtan bzhi yi 'dun ma byed// de dus rang nyid sgrub pa po'i// the tshom spros pa ma chod na/

gdams pa chos dpon bzhi la zhu// 'dun ma gnas brtan bzhi yis shes// bshes med phyogs kyi mgron po la// bza' mi sum brgya nyi shu dang*// stong tsho gcig gi gnyer res yin// yi ge ta yi rten 'brel gyis// lus po me yis tshig pa 'byung*// yi ge a las chu 'byung zhing*// lho byang yi ge gnyis po las// rbab dang rlung dmar 'byung ba yin// de la ngan par mi blta ste/ mgon po bzhi yi byin rlabs yin// khyi yis bzung dang dgra yis ded// chos 'phrul mang po byung ba na// de ni zin du 'gro ba'i rtags/ de ltar zhag grangs bdun bdun bsgom// des kyang zin par ma gyur na// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// nyin bar mthong thos la sogs pa// cir snang rmi lam yin snyam du// yang dang yang du sgom par bya// ngag tu rmi lam sgyu ma yin// zhes pa zhag bdun bar du bzlas// yang na ngag tu hūṃ bgrangs shing*// rmi lam yin no snyam du bsam// tho rangs smin mtshams haṃ la gtad// dran pa bdun pa dung nge bya// dad pa bar chad med pa dang*// sgrub pa bar chad med pa yin// myur du rmi lam zin par bya// de nas rmi lam zin pa na// dang po spel zhing sbyang ba dang*// ya nga spang zhing sgyu mar bslab// de la dang po spel ba ni// sangs rgyas zhing khams gcig nyid las// zhing khams mang po spel ba yin// shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing de ru// bcom ldan mi bskyod mgon po la// dam chos zhu bar 'dod pa na// mdun gyi a la dmigs la nyal// a ni mi bskyod mgon po'o// nu nyid rin chen 'byung ldan la// ta ni pad ma'i mgon po yin// ra ni las kyi mgon po yin// sgom pa'i man ngag gong dang mtshungs// zhag bdun dran 'dun drag po bya// sbyang ba'i man ngag 'og nas 'byung*// de ni ya nga spang ba ste// chu bo chen po mthong ba na// de ni mi bskyod rdo rje yin// su zhig 'di la 'jigs par byed// snyam du bsam la mchongs pa yin// me ni paV mgon po la// rlung dmar las kyi mgon po ste// ngam grog g.yang sa rin 'byung gi

/sprul pa nyid du 'dod pas na// de la 'jigs pa ga la skye// khyi dang dgra yi 'jigs pa yang*// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kyi// rnam 'phrul de ltar shar ba yin/ de la bdag nyid 'jigs pa na// sangs rgyas byang chub sems sogs la// bdag nyid 'jigs pa ci zhig ang*// bdag dang blun po byol song la// khyad med snyam du yi mug bsgom// snang srid rmi lam yin pa la// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa yin/ ji ltar bsam yang 'grub pa yin// phyin pas mi rtol cang srid dam// de ltar bsam zhing zla phyed sgom// ma gnyid dus su chu la ni/ pus mo nub tsam brgal ba yin// yang yang du ni bsam par bya// me rlung sa yang de dang mtshungs// da ni sgyu mar bslab dgos pas/ nyi zla gnyis kyi 'od zer la// 'jus la nyi zla'i steng du bsdad// rtsa gsum la sogs lha gnas blta// mgon po byams pa'i mdun nyid du/ thal sbyar la sogs mdun bdar te// mdo sde'i dgongs pa ma lus dri// lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyi/ khang bzang legs par blta ba dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung du// ar mo nig gi rdo leb blta// de sogs rdzu 'phrul mang po bya// mkha' la ོda dang sa la ོda// sa 'og la sogs gnas rnams su// skad cig ma la phyin gyur te/ snang srid sgyu mar rtogs pas su// sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul 'byung ba yin// u rgyan gnas dang rdo rje gdan// ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas rnams su// skad cig nyid la phyin gyur te// mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba yin// de yi rjes la sbyang ba'o// de ni man ngag 'di bzhin sgrub/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su// rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar sgom// zhing khams de yi sems can la// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bur bsam// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi// thams cad bde la bkod nas su// zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa yin// de la bde bar gshegs pa zer// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi bde gshegs ni/

tshogs gnyis kyi lam bde ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pa phyi yi bde gshegs dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i lam bde ba ni bde bar gshegs pa nang dang*/ yum gyi mkha' bde ba ni bde bar gshegs pa gsang ba dang*/ chos nyid kyi lam de kho na'i bde bar gshegs pa de kho na nyid kyi bde gshegs so// dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su// rang nyid rin 'byung nyid du bsgom// zhing khams de yi sems can la// mtho dman bde sdug la sogs pa// ro mnyam gcig tu bshad la bzhag /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis// thams cad bde la bkod la bzhag /pad ma can gyi zhing khams su/ rang nyid pad ma mgon por sgom// de la gnas pa'i sems can la// sems nyid spros dang bral bar bstan// yul lnga so sor mi rtog pa'i// ye shes yin zhes dam chos bshad// de rnams bde la bkod nas su// rnga sgra can du gshegs pa yin/ rang nyid las kyi mgon por bsgom// de na gnas pa'i sems can la// sems nyid gtan nas ma grub pas// las byas pas 'grub min zhes bshad// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis// sems can dpag med bde la bkod// zhing khams stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ rang nyid rnam snang mdzad du bsgom// zhing khams de yi sems can la// chos kun gdod nas rnam dag pas// gzung 'dzin dri ma med pa yi// sems can dpag med bde la bkod/ /zhing khams gzhan yang de ltar sbyar// nyin par dam chos bshad pa dang*// mtshan mo'i dus kyi rmi lam na// gzhan la dam chos bshad pa gnyis// sems kyis gnyis su brtag pa las// rang bzhin don la khyad par med// gzhan la phan pa'i dngos po yang*// rgyu 'bras tshul gyis de ltar brtag /de ni sbyangs pa'i dgos pa'o// de la zla ba phyed tsam bsgom// sngar gyi sgyu mar slob dus su// nyi zla'i steng du rang nyid kyis// gnas pa'i nus pa ma byung na// 'khor lo'i dbus kyi nyi zla gnyis// nyal khar rdog pa'i 'og tu mnan// mkha' la 'phur bar ma nus na/

nang na gnas pa'i nam mkha' la// yi ge hūṃ gis rtsal sbyong bya// me la mchong bar ma nus na// yi ge ta yi rang lus bsreg /chu la nyam nga byung ba'i tshe// chu yi glo la rmi lam bzung*// g.yang la mchong bar ma nus na// gad pa'i phugs su rtsal sbyong bya// nyi zla gnyis kyi 'od zer la// 'ju bar ma nus rang nyid kyis// lag pa'i mthil du nyi zla gnyis// g.yas su zla ba g.yon nyi ma// gsal bar bsgoms pas zin par 'gyur// zhing khams blta bar ma nus na// paV 'dab bzhi'i 'khor lo tsho// yi ge 'khor lo'i tshul du bskor// rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung du// dam chos zhu bar ma nus na// gnas pa rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sar/ mtheb gang ma yi man ngag bya// rje btsun ma yi tshogs dbus su// rang nyid gnas par nus 'dod na// lus la gnas pa'i rje btsun ma'i/ £ gar rjes chags dmigs la nyal// tshogs dang gtor ma rem la bya// de kho na nyid la gnas 'dod na// mchod khang sgo yi ya phug la/ nam mkha' sngon po gru gsum yod// de la dmigs la mi rtog bsgom// lus sems bag kyis dal ba dang*// sems nyid spros dang bral ba la// gong nas rgyun du sgom pa gces// de ltar zhag ni bdun bdun bsgom// ma nor lam mchog 'di nyid yin// gong gi dmigs pa du ma rnams// lam gyi rtsal sbyong bya bar 'dod// rmi lam rmis pa thams cad la// skye med rgya yis thebs pa na/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// stan thog gcig tu sgom nus pa'i// man ngag zab mo 'di na yod// rmi lam dus kyi snang ba de/ bar do'i sngon du 'gro bas na// rtsal sbyong bar do'i dus su byed// nyin par sgyu lus sgom pa de// rmi lam gyi ni sngon 'gro yin// rtsal sbyong lam gyi dus su byed/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud phyi ma las// rmi lam nub gcig zin gyur na// rnal 'byor zla phyed bar du bde// lha klu dri zas mchod cing bstod// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos su 'du// ngan song mchi las sgrol ba'i gru

/ces gsungs pas/ rmi lam gyi 'dzin sbyong sprul sgyur sogs 'byongs na phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs so// rmi lam dus kyi snang ba la// skye med rgya yis thebs pa na// rmi lam 'od gsal 'pho nus pas// dag pa chos nyid kyi bar do yin// dpal nā ro pa'i bzhed pa yis// rmi lam dus kyi shes pa de// bar do'i shes par bsre dgos te// rmi lam dnyin mtshan bar dor rgyas 'debs dang*/ bde gsal mi rtog lam 'khyer dang*/ thod rgal spel ma'i ting 'dzin gsum/ bsre ba gsum gyi man ngag yin/ ces gsungs so/

da par// dus ni rnam pa thams cad du// dran dang 'dun pa ma bral na// bsam gtan gnyid kyis 'tsho bar 'gyur// chos rnams dran pas zin pa gces// lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// nges par sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur// lar ni rnam pa thams cad du// rmi lam zin par mi nus shing*// brtan pa thob par mi nus na// lus ni gcer bur byas nas su// lung stong phyin la 'o dod 'bod// byang thang lus pa'i grogs bzhin du// yid kyis skyo shas drag po bya// lus ni phyi nang bzlog byas la// don snying phyi ru phra ler bsam// de yi mgrin pa'i dbus nyid du// yi ge a la drag tu gcun// rwa dung phyogs bzhir 'bud pa dang*// skabs su smyon pa'i brtul zhugs bya// yid la gcags pa'i rdzas rnams kun// rmi lam dus su 'byung ba bzhin// rtag tu dgos pa'i nor mchog 'di// rmi lam dus su cis mi zin// sangs rgyas dgongs pa rang la gnas// snying po'i don bsdus man ngag 'di// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bka' nan byas// gzhan la ma spel sbas pa'o// // 113) ༄// zhal gdams shog dril/ na mo pi wang bsnams ma/ dri ma ser mo dung chos bsnams pa/ ro ma dmar mo thod pa byang sems kyis bkang ba/ reg bya ma ljang gu lha'i na bzas pañdza kā ma bsnams pa sprul la yi dam gyi lha mchod par bzhes shig ces dbul/ de nas bdag nyid kyi snying gar yi ge hūṃ las 'od 'phros rigs kyi yum bzhi la phog pas/ mkha' 'gro ma lā ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma dang bzhis sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba'i thod pa thogs te mchod par bsam/ de nas yum la thim nas bde bas mchod par bsam/ phyi'i mchod pa ni me tog la sogs pa'o// snying ga'i hūṃ las thod par bsam/ de nas sdig pa bshags/ mdun gyi lha gshegs su gsol/ de nas hūṃ gi 'od zer nas swa £É was stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rang bzhin du gyur nas rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ la thim/

de gyur pa las bdag nyid he ru kar gyur par bsam// de yang rgyan cha lugs dang ldan par bsam mo// de nas rang nyid kyi ིna par oṃ/ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar ā bsam ste/ sngar bkod pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa'i dri ma dang yi ge bsregs par byas la/ haṃ las byang sems lte ba'i a la babs pas bde stong dbyer med du bsgom par bya'o// du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnyed nas/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid mngon du bya'o// ma goms pa'i dbang gis skyo bar gyur na/ dpal he ru ka 'ja' tshon lta bu la dmigs la bzlas pa bya'o// de nas gtor ma gtong na dang po byang sems bsgom/ de nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang nas yaṃ cig gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo gsum gyi sgyed pu/ de'i steng du a las thod pa bsam/ de'i dbus su baṃ las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ lhor ra las raca/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ shar lhor gho las rta'i sha/ lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha/ nub byang du da las ba glang gi sha/ byang shar ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de nas thod pa'i dbus kyi nam mkha' la oṃ/ de'i steng du āḥ/ de'i steng du hūṃ bsams la/ de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ bsam pa/ de oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas/ rlung gis me sbar/ thod pa dro/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ rdo rjes dkrugs pa de yang zhu bar bsam mo// de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun brjod pas zag med kyi bdud rtsi chen por bsam ste byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdzub mo mdud byas pas shes phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ a ra Dི ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya staṃ/ dṛ Oོཾ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yakṣa rakṣa sā £Ó ta pre tā pi sha tsa u ma da/ a sa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki ‚ da ya/ i maṃ ba ling ta gri ~ tu/ sa ma ya rakṣajà/ ma ma sarba siKི ´ེ pra ya tstshajà/

ya the baṃ/ ya the Wཾ/ £Ó dzaṃ tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra sad su kha bi shud Z sa ha ya gā £ wajàdong can/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bstod pas kyang bstod/ keng rus 'jigs su rung ba'i ri stengadu// bdud 'dul hūṃ las khro chen sku sprul ba// 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal rgya chen po// sku mdog mthing nag me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od// zhes pa la sogs pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gtsang sar spung ngo*// // 114) ༄// las kyi rdo rje'i shog dril bzhugs/ ༈ hūṃ ) he ru ka la na mo/ rgyal po chos nyid skye med la// blon po rigs gsum las byed yod// dmangs ni 'phrin las mthun sbyor gyis// dgos pa'i dus su bsam pas chog /blon po rigs gsum las byed la// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum// rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyis ni// las tshogs thams cad sgrub par byed// rtsa ni khyim dang 'dra bog por byung 'dra ba'i// gzhan gyis bkur ba'i gnas med do// 'phral du sdug la phugs su stong*// rlung dang thig le ma bsgoms na// rtsa yi rang bzhin bsgoms lags kyang*// khang stong gnyer byed med 'dra ba'i// bya dang bong bu khyi phag gi /gnas mal de la gzhan gyi ni// dgos 'dod 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// de la rtsa yi mtshan nyid ni// a wa ZÓོ ni// bcu drug rtsa yi 'dab ma de// kha dog dmar po pad ma'i dbyibs// sgyu mar rtogs pa'i gnas yod de// rmi lam dus kyi rdzogs rim yin// de dbus thig le dmar po'o// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na// rdo rje'i dbyibs la rtsa 'dab brgyad// kha dog sngon por 'dod pa yin// mi rtog skye ba'i gnas yin pas// 'od gsal dus kyi rdzoogs rim yin// de dbus hūṃ la dmigs pa bsgom// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo yi// rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi po// kha dog sna tshogs dra ba'i dbyibs// sna tshogs dngos grub de las 'byung*/

tha mal dus kyi rdzogs rim yin// dmigs pa'i 'phrin las gang byed gtso// rlung gi mtshan nyid drlung sna bug gang nas rgyu ba*/ grangs du rgyu ba/ 'byung ba gang gi rlung rgyu ba/ rlung rgyu ba dal brel/ rlung gi kha dog lha gang yin pa/ phyi nang du rgyu ba/ ring thung rnams kyi sbyar bshad yin no/ 'di bzhin gnas// nyin zhag gcig la thun chen brgyad// 'pho ba bcu drug dag tu 'dod// rtsa yi gnas na 'pho ba brgyad// rlung gi gnas na de bzhin te// go rim dag tu shes par bya// dgun zla 'bring po'i snga dro la// mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'byung ba'i khams// ro hi ta yi rlung rgyu ba// steng sgo g.yas nas 'byung ba'o// nyis brgya bdun cu tham pa dang*// dza ra na ni g.yon nas 'byung*// steng sgo g.yon nas 'byung ba la// grangs ni gong dang mtshungs par 'dod// gnyis ka nas ni sa 'byung ste// cha tsam cung zad dal bar rgyu// bu ga gnyis nas drag par ni// 'gyu ba rlung gi rlung du 'dod// grangs ni lnga brgya bcu bzhi las// de las gzhan pa mi 'dod do// 'gyu ba med pa nam mkha'i rlung*// bgrang du mi btub thun tshod gcig /thun tshod gnyis kyi dang po la// snying ga'i gnas nas 'byung ba'i khams// dang po chu rlung rgyu ba ste// kha dog sngon por rab tu brtag /de yi rjes la sa yi rlung*/ kha dog ser po mnyam du 'dod// rlung dang me yi kha dog ni// rlung ni kha dog ljang ba ste// me ni dmar po'i mtshan nyid can// phyir la rgyu bar 'dod pa ste// grangs ni stong tsho gcig dang ni// brgyad cu tham par 'dod pa yin// nam mkha'i rlung la kha dog med// gong ma tshar na shugs kyis 'byung*// thun tshod gsum pa'i dngos po la// lte ba'i gnas nas 'byung ba'i khams// sa yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// rin chen mgon po las byung ba'i// rlung gi dkyil 'khor nyid las ni// las kyi mgon po byon pa dang*// me dang chu yi dkyil 'khor las// pa

Vི// rtsa yi gtso bo brgyad yin te// g.yon ngos shar gyi 'dab ma nas// 'byung ba chu la dbang ba yi/ kha dog sngo skya'i thig le gnyis// 'pho dang gnas dang las kun byed// lho ngos mdun gyi 'dab ma la// 'byung ba sa la dbang ba ste// ser skya gsal ba'i thig le gnyis/ 'pho dang gnas dang las kun byed// g.yas kyi dang po me la dbang*/ nga sa phyogs bzhi// sngon la song ba tsho la dris// nam mkha'i thig le dbus na gnas// nam mkha' nam mkha' bzhin du 'jug /bcu drug brgyad du dril nas su// mgrin pa'i gnas nas snying gar babs// snying ga'i bo Zི tsi$ dang*// sngar gyi brgyad po gcig tu 'dres// 'byung bzhi lte ba'i thig le la// chu la chu nyid bzhag pa'am// mar la mar nyid bzhag pa bzhin// bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'dzag /thams cad mnyam du 'dres nas su// brgyad babs ZÓ ti'i mar sna la// bzhi gnas lus sems bde bas khyab// bzhi ni gsang ba'i rdo rjer byon// sa dang chu yi thig le gnyis// pad ma'i gnas su shor ba dang*// me dang rlung gi thig le gnyis// nor bu'i rtse mor skad cig gnas// skad cig bar mtshams de nyid la// nam mkha'i thig le rgyu ba ste// bde la mi rtog spros dang bral// lu byed// sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ni// sangs rgyas 'phrin las ma lus kun/ de las 'byung gi gzhan du min// rmi lam dbang gi man ngag la/ gang zag dbang po tha ma'i dbang du byas na/ yi dam gyi lha la brten nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste bum pa'i dbang bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas ni lus la bskur/ sgrib pa ni lus kyi sgrib pa byang*/ gdams ngag ni phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa ston/ dang po ni dga' ba nyams su myong ba las/ 'bras bu ni sprul pa'i sku thob/ phyag rgya ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang 'brel/ gang zag dbang po 'bring gi dbang du byas na/ mi'i bu mo la brten nas £ po rab kyi dbang du byas na/

byang sems khu ba'i rnam pa la brten nas a ba ZÓ ti'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye/ dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas ni sems la bskur/ sgrib pa ni sems kyi sgrib pa byang*/ gdams ngag ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i man ngag ston/ gsum pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba las/ 'bras bu ni chos sku thob bo// phyag rgya ni chos kyi phyag rgya dang 'brel/ gang zag dbang po yang rab kyi dbang du byas na/ tshogs drug gi yul la brten nas snang srid kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye/ dbang tshig dbang rin po che bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas lus ngag yid gsum la bskur/ sgrib pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa byang*/ gdams ngag ni lhun gyis grub pa'i gdams ngag ston/ bzhi ba dga' bral gyi dga' ba las/ 'bras bu ni sku gsum dbyer med pa'i 'bras bu thob/ phyag rgya ni phyag rgya chen po dang 'brel lo// las kyi phyag rgya lam du gang bslang bde ba bslangs/ rgya gang gis gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyas btab/ dbugs gang gis dbyung*/ de bzhin gshegs pas dbugs dbyung*/ lta ba gar sleb/ sems tsam gyi lta bar sleb/ 'bras bu gar smin/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu smin/ chos kyi phyag rgyas lam du bslang*/ chos nyid lam du bslangs/ rgya gang gis gdab/ rdo rje 'chang gis rgyas gdab/ dbugs gar dbyung*/ rdo rje 'chang gis dbugs dbyung*/ lta ba gar slebs dbu ma'i lta bar slebs/ 'bras bu gang smin rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu smin/ phyag rgya chen pos lam du gang bslang snang srid lam du bslangs/ rgya gang gis gdab// rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas gdab/ dbugs gang gis dbyung*/ rdo rje sems dpas dbyung*/ lta ba gar sleb/ zung du 'jug pa nam mkha' dang 'dra bar slebs/ 'bras bu gar smin dri ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu smin/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas lam du gang bslang*/ kun brtags lam du bslang*/ rgya gang gis gdab/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyas gdab/ dbugs gar dbyue'o// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ ces pa'o// de la las kyi phyag rgya la brten par 'dod na/ rig ma'i mtshan nyid rigs btsun pa/ lus mdzes shing yid 'ong ba/ skad mdangs 'jam zhing tshig btsun pa/ dri zhim mdangs dang ldan pa/ shes rab che zhing snod thub pa/ nyon mongs pa chung ba/ sbyor thabs la bzo ba/ 'dod chags che ba ngo tsha che ba gtsang sbra dang ldan pa/ brtse gdung che ba de lta bu'i rig ma ni dbang gi dus na bsten par bya ste/ yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pa las/ rdo rje nor bu'i grong gi dkyil 'khor du byang sems kyi khu ba'i rnam pa las 'di'i ngo bo nyams myong ste thig le rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag 'di ni dus tshod zin pa khu byug lta bu ste rtsa dang rlung bde ba'i dus tshod 'dzin pa'o// gzung ba'i man ngag la gsum las/ ting nge 'dzin gyis gzung ba dang*/ yi ge rab mchog gis gzung ba dang*/ zangs tshags can gyis gzung ba dang gsum mo// bzlog pa'i man ngag la gsum ste/ rlung gis bzlog pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bzlog pa dang*/ btsanas su oṃ āḥhūṃ bsgom pa'o// zangs tshags can ni/ rtsa thams cad zangs dung gyen la 'greng ba ltar bsgom pa'o// bzlog pa la steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung bsdams/ gling bzhi bsdu/ rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar/ lce yar rkan la gtad/ chu mig gyen la bzlog hig gis drag tu 'then/ g.yas g.yon du thebs gsum gsum drangs/ dbus su thebs gsum drangs/ lus thams cad la khyab par bya ba'i thabs la/ seng ge'i lta stangs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du phyi mig lta/ seng ge'i sprug stangs byas la lus drag tu sprug de rnams ni lus thams cad la khyab par bya ba'i man ngag go/ // pu a ha ri'i nā ro pa las rnyed/ gtsigs kyi rgya bdun dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rgya/ sdud pa po'i rgya/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rgya/

sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ bla ma rnams kyi rgya/ chos rnams kyi rgya'o/ bcas te dam par sbos/ sa ma ya siKི/ 115) ༄// sgyu lus kyi man ngag skor rdo rje'i shog dril/ ༈ u rgyan gyi gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi yang snying*// rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa// gser zhun dril ba lta bu'i man ngag /dpal nā ro pa chen po'i bzhed kyis// dus sbyor thun tshod brtsi ba dang*// mthun sdeb lto nang sbyor ba dang*// dmangs ni 'phrin las mthun sbyor gyi// man ngag 'di nas gsal bar ston// gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu// me long dri ma med pa la// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris te// de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs// zhes bya ba sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas rtogs par bya'o// de yang sgyu lus kyi man ngag bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim lnga las/ bdag la byin rlabs rim thob pa// gtso bo sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas ni// the tshom med par thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ a 4 de bas/ bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas su// thos pa'i pha rol song gyur kyang*// bdag byin brlabs pa'i phyir phyogs pa// de yis de nyid mthong mi 'gyur/ zhes so// pa 'di la don bzhi ste/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rnam grangs so/ sgyu ma'i nges tshig ni/ med pa glo bur du sgro btags te ming dang tha snyad du bzung ste don du snang ba'o// sgyu ma'i ngo bo ni/ glang po'i rus pa dang rnga mo'i spu dang shing bu dang rde'u las sgyu ma'i tshogs sprul ba dang 'dra bar/ pha ma'i khu khrag 'dus pa la/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs sgyu ma'i lus 'grub ste/ gsal bar snang ngo*// sgyu ma'i mkhan pos sgyu ma bshig tsa na/ sngar gyi rdzas su 'gyur ba bzhin/ rang gi lus kyang rkyen bag tsam zhig gis da lta rang sa rdor 'gro ste/ bdag gi lus sgyu mar rtogs par bya'o// dbye na bzhi las/
