de nas ro stod mar nem byas pas mda' de gyen la nar te song ba dang*/ tshangs bug gi haṃ mgo thur du bstan pa de la char de phog par bsam/ thig le sran ma tsam gsum phral te byung bas gcig gzhu'i 'chang ba la phog gnyis gzhu'i mchog ma re re la phog par bsam la/ rlung thub thang du bzung*/ ma thub na sna nas drag por btang ngo*// de lan gsum la sogs pa ci rigs par byas pas skyon las 'grol lo// de ltar byas pas ske 'gag pa 'am/ gre ba tsha ba 'am/ glo snying 'gags pa 'am/ skyigs bu la sogs pa byung na drags pa yin pas/ gong gi tsho bzhag la gzhu de lta bu'i 'og tu bsam ste/ de la dmigs pa gtad la bsgom/ rjes ro snyom mo// sa'i ting nge 'dzin la rdugs pa'i skyon bsal thabs so// skyon bsal ba'i yon tan la rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa thob par byed de/ gnyis pa chu rlung stobs su gyur pa 'byung ba gzhan rnams dang cha ma mnyam pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro snyom pa la lnga ste/ chu rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngoo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa dang*/ rdugs pa'i skyon dang*/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs dang*/ skyon sel ba'i yon tan no// dang po chu rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ gong ltar gtum mo bsgoms pas rlung ZÓ tir ma tshud pas/ chu rlung zin cing stobs su gyur pas 'byung ba gzhan rnams dbang du bsdus nas/ des lus ngag byin gyis brlabs pa'i nyams rnam pa bzhi 'byung ste/ lus nyams/ sems nyams/ gnyid nyams/ mthong nyams so// dang po lus nyams shin tu grang zhing bsil ba dang*/ phrum ser khyer ba tsug byas nas lus 'dar yed yed pa dang*/ khong pa nas grang sing nger song nas gos ci tsam gon yang mi dros pa dang*/ lus po la thig btab pa snyam byed pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// sems nyams 'bod pa snyam byed pa dang*/

'khyol nas 'gro ba snyam byed pa dang*/ ya shin tu nga ba dang*/ ci mthong yang grang sing sing pa 'am/ grang ting gis yod pa snyam byed pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// gnyid nyams chu bo chen po rmi ba dang*/ chu bo chen po la gru rdzings rdib pa dang*/ brgal ba dang*/ rkyal byed pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// mthong snang la snang srid thams cad chur mthong ba dang*/ lung pa chus khengs par snang ba dang*/ chu'i snang bar 'char ba dang*/ mig sgyu lta bur snang ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa ni/ lo zla ba du mar 'das nas dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa ni rdugs pa'o// zhag 'ga' 'ga' las ma byung na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang bas chog gsung ngo*// rdugs pa'i skyon ni rtags bcu yon tan brgyad skyes pa'i gegs su 'gyur ro// skyon de bsal ba'i thabs la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra'o// dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi gnad do// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung*/ lag pa pus mo la 'ju'o/ sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ lus la chu bur rdol ba lta bu'i sgo nas ye shes kyis drod btsan thabs su bskyed pa bya ba yin pas/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og tu chu'i dal me long chung shos tsam zhig bsam mo// rlung gi gnad ni/ steng rlung sna nas 'jam la ring bar rngubs pa dang*/ 'og rlung 'then byas gsus pa sgal pa la bcal byas la/ ro stod snyeng byas pas chu'i dal de'i dkyil nas chu 'bur bye'u sgo nga tsam zhig 'bur te rdol bar bsam/ yang 'og rlung drag por 'then byas pas de'i steng du yang chu 'bur gcig tol gyis rdol bar bsam/ yang 'og rlung drag tu 'then byas pas chu bur gcig thil te rdol bar bsam pas chu 'bur sum brtsegs su 'byung bar bsam mo// de nas rlung ma thub na 'og rlung mar la lhod byas pas chu 'bur de gsum chu'i dal la thim par bsam/

rlung kha nas sgra bcas su sangs kyis btang ngo*// yang 'og rlung lhod kyis glod pas chu'i dal mar la sgo na mar la byil gyis sa gting na mar la song bar bsam/ de lan bdun bdun byas la/ rjes ro snyom mo// des mi sel mi srid do// skyon sel ba'i yon tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thob par byed do// gsum pa me rlung stobs su gyur nas 'byung ba gzhan rnams dang cha ma snyoms pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro mnyam pa la lnga ste/ me rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa dang*/ rdugs pa'i skyon dang*/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs dang*/ skyon sel ba'i yon tan no// dang po me rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba ni/ gong ltar gtum mo bsgoms pas/ ZÓ tir ma chud par rlung sems drod gsum gcig tu 'dus pas khams 'dus te/ lus ngag yid byin gyis brlabs pas nyams rnam pa bzhi 'byung ste/ lus nyams/ sems nyams/ rmi nyams/ mthong nyams so// dang po lus nyams drod cher skyes pas lus tsha zhing 'brab pa dang*/ khyad par rked pa man chad du rngul chen po 'byung zhing dri mi zhim pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// 'o na gong du thig le'i dus su drod la brten nas rngul byung ba dang khyad ci yod zer na// thig le'i dus su drod brten nas rngul byung ba tsha 'brab med par 'byung la/ 'dir drod dang tsha 'brab dang bcas nas 'byung bas thig le'i dus dang mi 'dra gsung ngo*// sems nyams ni tshig pa shin tu za zhing shes pa 'khrugs pa dang*/ sa gzhi me 'bar ba la sogs pa'o// gnyid nyams la rmi lam du rang la me 'bar ba dang*/ grong par mes tshig pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// mthong nyams la me stag phro phro 'ong ba dang*/ snang ba thams cad me'i snang bar 'char ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa ni/

me rlung zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zin cing thogs nas lo zla ba'i bar du byung na rdugs pa yin no// dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa yin gsungs/ zhag 'ga' 'ga' las ma byung na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang bas chog gsung ngo*// rdugs pa'i skyon ni rtags bcu yon tan brgyad skye ba'i gegs su 'gyur ro// bzhi ba skyon de bsal ba'i thabs la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi gnad gsum las/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sprad/ lag pa gnyis pus mor 'ju'o// sems kyi dmigs pa drod dang bral ba'i thabs la/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram sngo skya zhig bsam/ de'i rwa gcig la yaṃ zhig btags pas/ de rnams kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa bsil ba'i ngo bor bsam mo// rlung gnad ni/ kha nas grang si li li bcug pa dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram de lte ba nas yar la sgo ro ro byung nas snying kha nas mgrin pa dang drod gang che sar byung nas grang si li li song bar bsam/ de nas rlung mi thub na phyir la btang la rdo rje rgya gram yang sgo ro ro mgrin pa snying kha lte ba nas mar la grang si li li song na lte ba na 'dug par bsam/ de lan ci rigs byas pa'i rjes la ro mnyam/ des cung ma sel na tsha ba sel ba bya ba yin te/ lga skya/ pi pi ling dang*/ thal kar rdo rje bsdus la mar rnying pa dang sbyar te drod dang tsha 'brab che sar byugs des nges par skyon las grol/ skyon bsal ba'i yon tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thob par byed de/ bzhi ba rlung gis stobs su gyur nas 'byung ba gzhan rnams cha ma snyoms pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro snyoms pa la lnga ste/ dang po rlung gis rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/

ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa dang*/ rdugs pa'i skyon dang*/ skyon bsal ba'i thabs dang*/ skyon sel ba'i yon tan no// dang po rlung gis rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ gong ltar gtum mo bsgoms pas/ ZÓ tir ma tshud pas rlung sems drod gsum gcig tu 'dus pas khams 'dus te/ lus ngag yid byin gyis brlabs pas nyams rnam pa bzhi 'byung ste/ lus nyams/ sems nyams/ gnyid nyams/ mthong nyams so// dang po lus nyams lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang*/ bang rta bas mgyogs pa snyam byed pa 'byung ngo*// sems nyams ni rig pa g.yer bag dang bcas pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// gnyid nyams rlung chen po yi gseb na 'dug pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams rlung gis khengs pa dang*/ rang nam mkhar rlung gis khyer ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// mthong snang la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rlung gis khengs par snang ba dang*/ rlung chen po yi sgra thos pa dang*/ rlung gis yed yed khyer bar 'dug pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa ni/ rlung gis rlung zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zin cing thogs pa lo zla ba'i bar byung na rdugs pa yin te/ dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa yin/ zhag 'ga' 'ga' las ma byung na nyams byung rgyal bskyangs pas chog gsung ngo*// rdugs pa'i skyon ni rtags bcu yon tan brgyad la sogs pa skye ba'i gegs su 'gyur ro*// skyon de bsal ba'i thabs la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra'o// dngos gzhi lus sems brdal lta bu'i gdams ngag la gsum ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi gnad do// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ dben pa'i sa phyogs su gos gting la gan rkyal du rkang lag brkyang la nyal/ lag pa gnyis kyis mtheb chen srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan no// sems kyi dmigs pa ni/

rig pa nam mkha'i 'dom gang tsam na yar btang la/ rig pa nam mkha' dang bsre'o// rlung gnad ni/ rlung kha nas bcug la steng 'og la sbyar te/ mi thub pa 'dra na kha nas sgra bcas su btang ngo*// de lan ci rigs pa dang rjes ro mnyam mo// skyon sel ba'i yon tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thob par byed do// lnga ba nam mkha'i rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la rdugs pa dang*/ rdugs pa'i skyon dang*/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs dang*/ skyon de sel ba'i yon tan no// dang po nam mkha'i rlung stobs su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba ni gong ltar/ gtum mo bsgoms pas ZÓ tir ma tshud pa rlung sems drod gsum gcig tu 'dus pas khams 'dus te/ lus ngag byin gyis brlabs pas/ nyams rnam pa bzhi 'byung ste/ lus nyams/ sems nyams/ gnyid nyams/ mthong nyams so// dang po lus nyams lus med pa snyam byed pa dang*/ nga yi lus 'di la na tsha yang mi 'dug snyam nas lus bde sang nge ba 'ong*/ da na tsha 'ong rgyu yang mi 'dug snyam pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// sems nyams nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu'i nyams 'char/ sa rdo ri brag dang khang pa la sogs pa la thogs pa med par phyin pas chog snyam pa 'byung ngo*// gnyid nyams nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang nam mkha' la 'dug pa la sogs 'byung ngo*// mthong snang la yang gsal ba stong pa/ dang sang nge bar snang ba dang sa rdo la sogs pa med par nam mkha' stong pa yad yud tsam du 'dug pa snyam pa 'byung ngo*// ting nge 'dzin de rdugs pa ni nam mkha'i rlung zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zin cing thogs nas lo zla ba'i bar du byung na rdugs pa yin te dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa yin gsung*/ zhag 'ga' 'ga' las ma byung na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang bas chog go /rdugs pa'i skyon ni rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mi skye ba'i gegs su 'gyur ro// skyon de bsal ba'i thabs la gsum ste/

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra'o// dngos gzhi gsal stong bye ba'i sgo nas rig pa nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phang ba la gsum ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi gnad do// dang bo lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rnam snang gi chos drug gam/ gtum mo'i lus gnad bya'o// sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ a wa ZÓ ti'i yar sna tshangs pa'i bu gar zug pa mar sna gnyer po cher zug par bsam/ lte ba'i 'og tu hūm̐ cha phra ba gcig tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar cer cer yod par bsam mo// rlung gi gnad ni sna nas nar gyis drangs la steng 'og kha sbyar te/ a wa ZÓ ti'i gsor thag 'then pa bzhin phar sgor tshur sgor 'dug par bsam/ des tshangs pa'i bu ga skya sang nge yod par bsam pa dang*/ rang gi rig pa hūm̐ du yod pa de tshangs bug nas yar rgyangs der thon nas nam mkha'i mthongs blos 'khyud tshad na yar song bar bsam la rlung bzung*/ mi thub pa 'dra na hūm̐ de rang gnas su phabs la rlung btang ngo*// de lta bu lan ci rigs pa byas pa'i rjes la ro mnyam mo// skyon de sel ba'i yon tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thob par byed do// de tshos 'byung ba lnga'i rlung stobs su gyur pa cha ma snyoms pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro mnyam mo//

rtsa yig 'bru rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa ro snyom tshul/'o// rtsa yig 'bru rlung sems drod gsum gcig tu 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro snyoms pa la lnga ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa dang*/ rdugs pa'i skyon dang*/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs dang*/ de sel ba'i yon tan no// dang bo ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba ni/ gong ltar gtum mo bsgoms pas rlung ZÓsa byol song gi gnas yug gcig skye gsung ngo*// mi'i sa bon ṇi kha dog sngon po yin te/ snying kha na gnas der rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pas mi'i snang ba 'char te 'phral du yang sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro// de'i mod la shi na mtshams sbyor des mi'i gnas su yug gcig skye gsung ngo*// lha ma yin gyi sa bon su kha dog ser po yin smin mtshams na gnas der rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pas lha ma yin gyi snang ba 'char te/ 'phral du yang sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ de'i mod la shii na mtshams sbyor des lha ma yin gyi gnas su yug gcig skye gsung ngo*// lha'i sa bon a yin de'i rtsa gnas kyang smin mtshams yin der rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pas lha'i snang ba 'char te/ 'phral du yang sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ de'i mod la shi na mtshams sbyor des lha'i gnas su yug gcig skye gsung ngo*// de tsho re rer snang ba 'char ba yang yod/ re mos 'ong ba yang yod/ gcig gnyis kyi snang ba 'char ba yang yod pas ma nges so// ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa ni/ khams 'dus pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la zla ba'i bar du byung na rdugs pa yin te/ dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa yin gsung*/ zhag 'ga' 'ga' las ma byung na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang bas chog go /rdugs pa'i skyon ni/ rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mi skye ba'i gegs su 'gyur ro// skyon de bsal ba'i thabs la gsum ste/

rten 'brel rdzas kyis bsal ba dang*/ yi ge rang gnas nas gdon pa dang*/ dug lnga lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro mnyam mo// dang po rten 'brel rdzas kyis bsal ba ni/ rigs drug gi rtsa yig 'brur rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa'i snang ba shar ba de'i sa bon gyi steng du tsan dan dkar dmar dang*/ bzang drug dang*/ ga bur dang*/ ghi waṃ la sogs pa'i khu bas rdo rje rgya gram gri gug bris la de'i steng du gcig thog tu gcig brtsegs pas grang sing gis ma song bar du bri'o// dmyal ba'i snang ba shar la bshang ba rkang mthil gnyis spos kyin bya/ de zab par 'dug gsung ngo*/ yi ge rang gnas nas gdon pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra'o// dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi gnad do// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung bca'/ lag pa gnyis brang khar snol la mtheb chen gnyis kyis srin lag gnyis rtsa ba mnan pa'i khu tshur bcang ngo*// sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ rigs drug gi snang ba gang shar ba'i rtsa gnas na/ sa bon yod pa de'i steng na hūṃ mthing nag cig bsam/ rlung gi gnad ni/ rlung sna nas rngub pa dang*/ hūm̐ mthing nag gi zhabs kyu sa bon de'i zhabs nas 'khyud nas hūm̐ dang sa bon gnyis tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar rgyangs kyi thon nas nam mkha' la 'phangs/ rlung mi thub pa 'dra na/ hūm̐ snying gar dbab/ rlung sna nas btang*/ de na tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thob par byed do// de tshos rigs drug gi rtsa yig 'brur rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro mnyam mo// rtsa gnas gzhan du rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro snyom pa la lnga ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba dang*/

ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa dang*/ rdugs pa'i skyon dang*/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs dang*/ skyon de sel ba'i yon tan no// dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i ngos bzung ba ni/ gong ltar gtum mo bsgoms pas/ rlung ZÓ tir ma tshud par rtsa gnas gzhan du rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa'i nyams de la 'jigs shing ya nga ba dang*/ bag tsha ba dang*/ stag dang seng ge mthong ba dang*/ dred dang srin po la sogs pa kun gyis bsdigs pa dang*/ mthong snang ngo mtshar can la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// ting nge 'dzin de la rdugs pa ni khams 'dus pa'i rtags de tsho/ lo zla ba'i bar du byung na rdugs pa yin te dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa yin gsung ngo*// zhag 'ga' 'ga' las ma byung na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang bas chog go /rdugs pa'i skyon ni/ rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mi skye ba'i gegs su 'gyur ro// skyon de bsal ba'i thabs la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi la gnyis/ 'khrul 'khor gyis bsal ba dang*/ skyon de nyid la la dor ba'o// dang po 'khrul 'khor gyis bsal ba ni/ rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la brang khar bsnol/ stobs bskyed la ngag tu hūm̐ drag po gyen la rlung thub thang du lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bgrang*/ rjes ro mnyam mo// skyon de nyid la la dor te bsal ba ni/ stag dang*/ seṅge dang*/ srin po la sogs pa de nyid 'jigs shing ya nga ba byung na/ slar de nyid mang du bsgoms pas zhi ba 'am/ yang na stag la sogs pa de las kyang mang du byung na dga' ste snyam du bsam pas/ sngar gyi de rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro// skyon de sel ba'i yon tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye bar byed do// des rtsa gnas gzhan du rlung sems drod gsum 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro mnyam pa'o// de tsho hril gyis dril ba rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang lnga'i sgo nas sgom skyon phyogs med du bsal zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ro mnyam pa'o//

//´//ngag non bsal ba ni/ yi dam gyi lhar bskyed/ lce ral gri gcig tu bsgom la/ de'i yu ba hūṃ zhig bsam/ hūṃ de las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas/ ngag la gnod de bsreg par bsam pa'i ngang las/ ngag tu/ āoṃ ā hūm̐ bdag gi ngag la rakṣa rakṣa ku ru yāai swāhā/ zab bo// rgya rgya rgya// 122) ༄// 'byung bzhi ro snyoms/ ི paṇḍi ta gcig tai lo pa la gdams pa zhus byas pas/ jo bo tai lo pa'i zhal nas 'di gsung*/ mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du bdag mnyes byas// sprul pa brgya phrag brgya yang byung*// rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang*// ā 4 de ba klu sgrub dang*// gzhan rnams dang yang nga gtam byas// nga yi rtogs pa kho la yod// phyi rabs sems can don gnyer rnams// rtogs pa 'dod na kho la 'dud/ zer nas tai lo pa bros nas song*/ de ltar lags pas tai lo pa'i slob ma nā ro pa/ de'i slob ma mar pa lo tsā ba/ de'i slob ma bla ma gzhung pa'o// de yang nā ro pa yan chad sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa lags so// 'byung ba ro snyoms pa la mos pa dang gus pa dang yid ches pa'i stobs bya/ sgom stobs kyi ro mnyam pa ni/ bsgom pa'i dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bya/ yul dphyi rol la mda' ltar dgzugs la sogs pa bsrang bas/ 'khor lo bzhir dbde ba chen po la sogs pa'i skor/ de nas lte ba lcags kyu ltar gzung*/ lus nam mkha' ltar yangs par bstod/ gzer na seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas non la rlung dus 'du btang rlung dang thig le 'gags na rnam shes drdo rje nor bu stong par bsgom stong ra bca'/ smad nas stod du 'gror ma btub cing kham 'khyil na seng ge'i sprug stangs dro stod rgyas par byas la g.yas g.yon gnyis su drag par ba bu res bya/ rdo rje'i dkyil du gar ba la ro mnyam/ bying na 'og rlung bsdams la rlung dang shes pa sbags te nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phang*/

rgod na sgyu ma'i dkyil du sba/ ma dbde chen la sogs pa'i sgregs pa 'byung*/ lus chad por song ba snyam byed/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba snyam byed/ kha zas kyi 'dod pa chung*/ chu shas che na chu kha snyi/ lus grang rngul 'byung*/ shes pa 'bying bde ba shas chung*/ thig le 'dzag bde ba gtang ba dla gsal na mkhal sked 'khor zhi na/ de ltar ro bzhi'i nad shes pa dang*/ bcos pa'i thabs ni gus stobs dang*/ mos pa'i dchos thams cad la stobs drag tu bskyed// de la sa shas che na phyag rgya ma yid la byas la/ shes dyum bdag med ma dang zhal sbyar na bde ba skye bar bsam pa sprul pa'i 'khor lor gtad/ des ma phan na bde chen gyi 'khor lor gtad/ des ma phan na mda' ltar srang ste/ sna nas rlung sems phyir phyung la rgyang grags dang dpag tshad tsam du btang*/ yang lcags kyu ltar bzung ste sna bug nas rlung sems bcug la/ bde chen 'khor lor gtad/ rtsub pa'i zas bza'/ zas rjes gcag chu shas che na chu la me btang ste/ shes pa sprul pa'i 'khor lo nas yar drang*/ srin po'i zhal nas yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pas mar me'i rtse mo tsam 'bar bas skra'i nyag ma'i khyon tsam gyis lus bsro/ 'khor lo bzhir thig les dgang*/ srin po'i zhal bsdam/ shes pa mgrin par gtad/ me logs pa med/ phul du gdon/ kha zas bcud cher gtad/ me shas che na me la chu btang ste/ phyag rgya dgong dang 'dra / rgyu ma'i dkyil du dgod pa'i 'doms sor rtsa lcags kyu ltar rlung dang bcas pa gzung*/ phyag rgya dchags can yin dthun mong gi bcos thabs steng nas mnan/ sa rlung shas che na 'og nas sbar/ 'di ni kun la snyoms par btang*/ sa la rlung gtang*/ rlung la sa gtang*/ chu la me gtang*/ me la chu btang*/ rlung la skye med gtang*/ bde ba la stong ba gtang*/ stong pa la bde ba dnang gi nyams dang phyi rol yul bde stong du btung gtang*/ gnyis med dblo gzhag gis d'di yang thun mong gi bcos thabs

bsam/ lte bar gtum mo'i me bsam/ de gnyis kyi bar du nad kyi rnam pa'am na bun gyi rnam par bsam/ yid kyis bla ma la nad mi bde ba 'di sol cig pa'i gsol ba gdab/ de rnams ni gnad bsdu ba'o// de nas rlung rngubs te me sbar bas nad kyi rnam pa dsa de rnams bla ma'i skyil krung la lhan gyis bsregs pa ni nad gsod pa'o// de nas rlung mi rgyu ba'i ngos bkag ste/ rgyu ngos na phar shin tu drag par gtang ste/ sems ma zin na ni bcos thabs so// phyir 'gro na 'gro ba'i dod po khang po na na c ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang nad thams cad phyi rol tu sha shwa btang ba ni song bar bsam pa ni nad gtong ba'o// de nas blo bzhag gis stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni nad 'od gsal du dengs su bzhugs pa'o// gong gi rnam shes rlung bzhon gyi man ngag gi lus zo zhabs med pa bzhin bsgoms la/ 'og rlung bsdams te rlung yar thal mar thal bsgom pa'o// sna khrag byung na gang byung ba'i ngos kyi lag pa bskyang ste sprugs nas so shing gi rgyab tu slebs tshad du brgyag de lta bu lan gsum du bya/ lus yang dang yang du rngul na phye zhib mos byug ste bsgom 'phro mi gcad/ thig le rtag tu 'dzag na rlung brdigs te byang sems thams cad ba spu nas nyi rdul bzhin du spro/ zas yi gar mi 'o'abyung bzhi ro snyoms kyi man ngag zab mo// 123) ༄// na tsha bogs dbyung ba'i gzer/ nyams dang*/ phan gnod med pa'i nyams so// dang po la thabs shes rab gnyis med kyi nyams gsum mo// gnod pa'i nyams rtsub chos su skyes pa las bzhi las/ zug gi rgyu ni rtsa rlung thig le'o// rtsa ba gsum las/ pho rtsa drag la spangs mtho/ mo rtsa 'jam la spangs dma'/ ma ning rtsa ni mnyam pa'o// rlung la yang gsum las/ pho rlung drag la rtsub/ mo rlung 'jam la dal/ ma ning gi rlung de gnyis kyi bar ma'o// thig le las byung ba'i bde ba la yang gsum las/

pho bde ni bde shas che mi rtog pa shas chung ba'o// mo bde stong shas che la bde shas chung ba'o/ ma ning gi bde ba ni de gnyis snyoms par 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa zug gi dbye ba ni/ rtsa zug dang*/ rlung zug dang*/ thig le'i zug go /gsum pa zug gi mtshan nyid la gsum las/ rtsa zug ni lhag par zug gzer che ba 'ong*/ rlung zug ni zug gzer med par zas mi len cing snyoms se ba 'ong*/ thig le'i zug ni zug gzer dang bde ba 'dres nas 'ong*/ de la rtsa pho rtsar rlung mo rlung bzhugs na zug gzer bsal sla/ pho rtsar mo rlung bzhugs na zug gzer nyung ste byung na bcos dka'/ pho rtsar ma ning gi rlung tshud na zug mang nyung dang bcos dka' sla 'bring ngo*// mo rtsar rlung gsum po gang chud kyang zug gzer mi 'ong ngo*// ma ning gi rtsa ni rlung gis bsgyur te/ rlung yang ma ning gi rlung nyid du gnas na zug mi 'ong*/ ma ning gi rtsar mo rlung tshud na zug cung zad 'byung la bcos sla'o// rtsa ma ning du rlung pho rlung tshud na zug cung zad 'byung bcos cung zad dka'o// bzhi pa zug de bcos pa'i thabs ni/ rnal 'byor pa la zug gcig byung ba'i dus su rtog pa gsum 'byung ste/ nad yin nam snyam pa dang gcig 'dre yin mos pa byed dgos pa'o// khyad par du nyams su blangs nas bsgoms pa'i gang zag gcig gi na tsha la sogs pa byung ba'i dus su kha zas sha chang dang sgog pa dang sngo dang chang la sogs pa bcad la/ phye thug dang zan dron gtang*/ des lto rjes pa dang*/ dri chu lcags kong ngam rdza gsar par btsags la/ rlangs pa yal tsam na btung*/ dri chen yang 'go mjug gnyis langs pa'i sa nas rim gyis tshud tshad du gtang*/ de ltar zhag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa nad tsha grang la sogs pa ro snyoms nas gsal te yar skyug yang na mar 'byam mo// rtsa nang na yod na chu'i snga la yong bar 'gyur ro// rjes de nyid kyis tshod 'dzin pa'o// nang sems kyi la gsum las/

phyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang lung tsam sgo bstun na/ smon 'jug gnyis su sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad mar gyur pa las ma gtogs pa'i gnod byed kyi 'dre med do// nang smin byed dbang bzhi las bum dbang thob nas/ grol byed bskyed rim sgom pa'i gang zag la/ bde mchog las/ gang na gnas kyang gzhal yas khang*// su dang phrad kyang yi dam lha// zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lha'i gzhal yas khang du snang bas gnod byed kyi 'dre med do// gsang ba smin byed dbang bzhi rdzogs nas/ grol byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i dbang du byas nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las ma 'das pa ste/ de skad du yang he badzra las/ bde ba gnag cing bde ba ser// bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar// bde ba ljang khu bde ba sngo// bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu kun// bde ba shes rab bde ba thabs// de bzhin kun tu rgyu skyes bde// bde ba dngos dang dngos med de// rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar brjod/ ces pa dang*/ nga las 'gro ba thams cad byung*// la sogs pa dang*/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// la sogs pa gsungs pas/ thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas gnod byed kyi 'dre med do// de gsum rgyud la gang 'byar gcig gam/ yang na gsum ga'i sgo nas ro snyom mo// de ltar rnal 'byor pa yin na 'dre med la/ 'dre yod na rnal 'byor pa min no// de la gsang ba nyams kyi ro snyoms ni/ de ltar 'dre med par thag chod na/ da zug ci las byung na sgom nyams rtsub chos su skyes pa yin no// de gang gis 'chos na/ gsang ba nyams kyi ro snyoms kyis 'chos/ de la nā ro pan chen gyi gdams ngag las/ bcos thabs bsam gyis mi khyab kyis stong pa'i go cha gtsigs su khyer gsungs pas/ go cha rnam pa gsum mamadang skar khung dang zang thal la sogs pa'o// gnyis po des ma sol na bde ba'i go cha ni/

gnad bzhi la brten pa las gsum gong dang mthun/ shes pa'i gnad stong par bsgoms pa'i shul du kun rdzob byang chub sems thig le rngul chu lta bus gang nas bde phril phril gang nas bde stong mi phyed par bsgom mo// gal te des kyang ma sel na gtum mo'i go cha ni/ gnas gsum sngar dang 'dra/ shes pa'i gnad stong par bsgoms pa'i nang der gtum mo'i me dmar gyi rnam pa mtshan nyid bzhi ldan sbom phra ci rigs pa zhig bsgom mo// gal te shin tu zug gzer che nas go cha rnam gsum la dmigs pa gtad ma tshugs na/ sems kyi go cha ni gnad gsum sngar dang mthun/ stong pa'i rjes la na dang de nyid shes pa bsdus kyis bsgom mo// des kyang ma sel na bsod nams 'gribs pa'i dam tshig nyams chag la sogs pa yin srid pas/ bla ma'i go cha ni/ gnad gsum sngar dang mthun/ shes pa'i gnad stong par bsgoms pa'i nang 'dir nad tsha grang brtags la tshad pa la zla ba'i rten/ grang ba la nyi ma'i rten gyi steng rdo rje bla mar bsgom la/ de la snying gi dkyil rus pa'i gting nas mos gus sing sing pa byas pas/ bsod nams 'gribs pa dang dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa sor chud nas/ sdug bsngal gyi zug gzer zhi ste bde ba'i bogs su 'char ba'o// de ltar na tsha de nyid sgom gyis bogs su dbyungs pas na na tsha bogs su dbyung ba zhes bya'o// de rnams gang la yang rlung rtsol snga ma bas bogs dbyung ba shug drag tu bya'o// //na tsha bogs su dbyung ba'i gzer//

´/124) ༄// 'chi ba grogs su 'khyer ba'i gzer/ ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs de dag gis ma yol na rnal 'byor pa dus la thug pa yin pas/ 'chi ba grogs su 'khyer bar byas te/ de la 'jig rten pa 'chi ba la dgrar 'dzin la/ rnal 'byor pa bla ma'i gdams ngag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'chi ba'i dus nyid dam/ bar dor phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par byed pa'i grogs su 'khyer ba'o// de la 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang nas khyad par du mi la 'chi ba'i dus su smig rgyu la sogs pa'i rtags lnga mi 'byung mi srid pas/ de lam du 'khyer ba la gnyis te/ rang bzhin 'byung tshul dang*/ lam du slong tshul lo// dang po ni rim gyis 'chi ba dang*/ cig car 'chi ba gnyis ka la rtags 'di dag 'byung ste/ sa chu la thim pa'i dus su phyi rtags lus lci ba 'byung*/ nang rtags su du ba lta bu 'byung*/ me rlung la thim pa'i dus su phyi rtags su lus kyi mtha' nas drod 'chor/ nang rtags su srin bu me khyer lta bu'i snang ba 'byung*/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i dus su phyi rtags dbugs shwa shwa lta bu 'byung*/ nang rtags phyi rol gyi snang ba nub ste/ rnam par shes pa bum nang gi mar me ltar gsal ba 'byung*/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal ba la thim pa'i dus su phyi rtags nad pa shor zer/ nang rtags 'chi ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'od gsal chos kyi sku ji lta bu gcig dus der 'byung ngo*// de lta bu de lam du slong pa la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po thun mong gi yan lag tu bla ma'am grogs gdams ngag gso nus pa la bsten/ hu gad dang g.yeng ba 'byung ba'i rgyu yang*/ rdzas dang yo byad tshogs gsog tu btang*/ yi dam gyi thang sku bkram/ mchod pa la sogs pa bshams/ chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du bsgom/ sgyu ma tsam du bdag gis ji ltar bsam pa'i don de mi grub mi srid snyam du sems kyi gdeng chen po bya/

sbyor ba bdag gis 'od gsal chos kyi sku thob par bya'o snyam du bsam/ de ma thob na bar dor sgyu ma'i lus la sgyu ma'i lus su ngo shes par bya'o// snyam pa'i 'phen pa yang dang yang du bya'o// de nas rang yi dam lhar bsgoms la tsaṇḍa li la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong gang skyes pa gcig la blo bzhag go /dngos gzhi la 'od gsal du bsgoms pas chu sna dang be'u ma phrad pa bzhin du ma bcos pa'i shes pa ma dang bu ru brda 'byor te/ rang gi 'od gsal nyams su myong ba dang bar do'i 'od gsal mtshan nyid pa gnyis phrad nas/ rjes la 'chi ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'od gsal chos kyi sku thob pa'o// de ma thob na bar dor sgyu ma'i lus su zhag bdun nam bdun phrag bdun sdod pa las/ bdun tsho re la rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal re 'byung ste/ de'i dus kyi 'od gsal dang sgyu ma'i lus la der ngo shes pa med pas khams gsum du 'khor ro// rnal 'byor ba sngar gyi 'phen pa'i stobs kyis de'i dus kyi 'od gsal dang sgyu ma'i lus la der ngo shes pa'i rtog pa mi 'byung mi srid do// de 'byung ba'i stobs dang*/ lus kyi rten bzang po'i stobs kyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku thob pa'o// //'chi ba grogs su 'khyer ba'i gzer/ ´/ 125) ༄// nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i gzer la/ ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i gzer la/ nyon mongs pa la mang yang 'dir 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags kho na la bya ste/ bde ba gsum las pho bde skye ste nyon mongs pa rang ka mar song nas dge sbyor byar ma btub na/ skyes bu 'dod chags can don du// de yi byed pa rdo rje sems// zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar me yis tshig pa la// me de nyid kyis gdung pa ltar// de bzhin nyon mongs kyis gdungs pa// nyon mongs nyid kyis grol bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ de nyid lam du slong ba la/

bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa gnyis so// de la bsnyen pa ni gnad bzhi la brten pa las/ dus gnad bde ba nam skyes kyis lus gnad gtum mo dang mthun/ ngag gnadar te/ nyon mongs pa rang ka ma zhi'o// der zag bcas kyi bde ba 'gags nas zag med kyi bde bar 'gyur ro// de nas rtsa mig tu gdab pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag la lus kyi ljid phab la/ rlung rtsol byas pas thebs par 'gyur ro// rlung dang bsre ba ni/ rlung bum pa can du bcug pa'i sbyor ba bya/ de nas rtsol med du bya/ des mi rtog par gyur nas lam du slong ba'o// //nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i gzer// ´/126) ༄// rnam rtog rang sar grol ba'i gzer/ ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog rang sar grol ba'i gzer la gnyis te/ phyi yi yul la rtog pa'i rnam rtog dang*/ nang sems la rtog pa'i kun rtog go /dang po la gnad bzhi las/ dus gnad ni phyi'i snang ba dkar dmar la brten nas sems gnas su ma btub pa'i dus su/ lus gnad gzhan dang mthun/ yul gyi gnad phyi'i snang ba dkar dmar gnyis te/ snang ba dkar dmar yul gyi gnad ces so// shes pa'i gnad ni snang ba dkar dmar gang la rnam rtog skyes pa de rang la shes pa hur phyung nas 'bri tshugs su blta'o// de ltar bltas pas dang po dngos po la der 'dzin gyi shes pa skyes nas de nyid mi rtog par 'gyur nas rang sar grol ba'o// gnyis pa nang sems las byung ba'i kun rtog rang sar grol ba'i thabs ni/ dus kyi gnad ni yul med kyang dmigs pa mi gnas bar pur pur byung ba'i dus su/ lus gnad ni tsaṇḍa li bzhin du/ yul gyi gnad rtog pa gang skyes pa de la/ shes pa'i gnad ni mig nang du bzlog la/ phyi'i yul mi mthong bar byas la/ mig dang shes pa gnyis nang du bsdebs nas gtad pas/ rjes la mi rtog par mi 'gro mi srid/ mig dang shes pa 'ben la gtad ces so// zhar la nyams su blang ba ni rjes thob kyi dus su rang sar grol ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blang ngo*//

//rnam rtog rang sar grol ba'i gzer// ´/ 127) ༄// bar chad g.yang du blan pa'i gzer/ mtho dman du gyur nas na ba yin la/ de 'byung ba ro snyoms kyis g.yang du blan no// nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gnyis nyon mongs lam slong dang rnam rtog rang sar grol bas g.yang du blan/ de bzhin du phyi'i mi ma yin sems kyis ro snyoms kyi sgo nas g.yang du blan no// de la 'dir mi'i bar chod kyi dbang du byas pa ste/ de la sde tshan gsum las/ tha mal pas bar chad mi byed de/ dgras bar chad byed pas/ rnal 'byor pa drod thob par tshar gcod rjes gzung gi phrin las bya ste/ de ma byas na sems can blos spangs pa'i nyes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yal bar dor ba'i nyes pa yong ngo*// rnal 'byor pa drod ma thob na bzod pa'i bla mar bzung la g.yang du blan no// gnyen gyis mdza' bar byed pa'i sgo nas chos kyis bar du gcod pa la/ khong gi dbang du bdag mi 'gro bar thag gcad pa'i sgo nas g.yang du blan no// gal te mi ma yin gyi bar chod rtsub chos su ma tshugs te/ mi dad du bcug nas g.yo ba'i dbang du song nas bar chod 'jam chos su byung bar shes bya ste/ de dbang du mi gtang bar g.yang du blan no// lam gyi bar chod sel bar byed pa'i gzer gdams ngag nā ro pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs sel lo// rnal 'byor ba'i nad thams cad sgom gyis 'joms par rigs te/ sman dpyad kyis bcos na skye bo phal pa dang khyad med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// rnal 'byor pa'i phyi nang gi bar chad sel bar byed pa'o rdzogs so// // dgu ba/ rgyud 'grel gyi chos skor/ 128) ༄// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim lnga/ ༈ rgya gar skad du/ hri sa ma dzā ghu hā u pa Zེ sha pa kra ma na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim pa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dbskyed phyag dang ni yi dam lha/ ji ltar chu dang

dchu bzhag dang mar dla mar bzhin du// gnyis med d bden pa drgyud phyi ma'i don gzhi'i gnas lugs bstan// gnyis pa 'khor bar 'khrul lugs bstan// gsum pa drnam dag sbyang gzhi'i gnas thabs d bstan// bzhi pa dnyams su blang thabs lam gyi rim lnga bstan// lnga pa 'bras bu'i dsku gsum thob tshul dle'u dang po dang rgyab nas bstan// drug pa dbrod pa bskyed pa phan yon bstan pa'o// gzhi yi gnas lugs/dang po drang bzhin lhun grub de gzhi'i gnas lugs ni// lam gsum gyi mthar c gzhi yis 'bras bu byed pa yin// sems can sangs rgyas mnyam dngo bo nyid la tha dad med pa med mnyam// chos thams cad c gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// bden pa gnyis med c de la 'khor dang myang 'das med/ 'od gsal ba ngo bo nyid kyi sku de c rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa de// gdod nas dstong pa 'gro 'ong med par thams cad rnam dag ngo bo nyid rang la gnas pa yin// gzhi dang rang bzhin dlam skye med bud Z'i rgyu yin te// lam ni thabs zhes bya ba yin// de bzhin ddri ma gzhom du med pas mi 'phrogs 'bras bu d'dus ma byas yin// thog ma tha ma med ddus gsum mnyam nyid du zhi ba// rnam par d'od gsal chos dbyings mi 'gyur mtshan ma med// mi 'jig skye ba med d'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid ces gang yin// rgyu yis dskye 'gag med pas 'bras bu rgyas gdab bo dmthar chos sku // rgyu nyid 'bras bu d'od gsal ba nyid dag ste// skye 'gag rtog med dsems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid lhun gyis ddbyer med sku gsum ngo bo rang bzhin gcig tu grub// dge sdig dthams cad nye bar zhi bas te rang bzhin gyis mtshan ma mi dmigs pa sems kyis de ma bskyed// ma skyes pa'i ngo bo d'od gsal sku nyid// dngos po kun la d'gro kun snying po yongs la khyab par gnas// nam mkha' lta bur 'pho 'gyur

dmtha' las 'das pa med// 'khor bar 'khrul lugs/༈ gnyis pa dla lugs 'byung lugs ldog gnyis po 'khrul lugs bstan pa ni// chos kun drgyud phyi ma nas gnyis su med pa la// dngos po drlung sems gnyis su dgzung 'dzin brtag pa yin// don dam mi 'gyur dgang zag dang chos kyi bdag nyid 'gyur// kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel c 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba rlung dang sems// de las drang bzhin stong pas ma rig 'khor bar 'khrul// 'khor ba thog ma dgser med g.ya'i tshul du med pa nas// rlung sems rang bzhin dgzung 'dzin dge mi dge las bsag 'khor d'gro ba lngar // 'khrul ba'i dlas 'bras rdo rje rab tu gsungs// de la sems nyid ngo bo de// don dam dmigs med drlung sems chos nyid stong*// kun rdzob dsnang ba tsam sems nyid gsal dstong pa'am rig tsam// rlung sems dthog ma med pa nas lhan cig skyes par 'byung*// rlung gi dbem po ngo bo ddang po 'khor ba nas tha ma pa gcig tshun chod yod pas gsal la phra// rlung gi tshogs drug c bem po'i rang bzhin rnam shes g.yo// rlung sems dbtags med gcig la gcig ltos drten 'brel tshul// rlung sems drten 'brel rlung la zhon pas gnyis kyis 'khor 'das bskyed// 'khor dspang bya yin ba'i rlung sems dstong zhing ma 'khrul bas ma rig 'khrul// de las kun rdzob drmi lam sgyu ma lta bur las sgrib byung*// rlung sems d'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin mi shigs thig le ste// snang stong ngo bo dag par gnas// rnal 'byor pas lam du d lus ngag sems ddben pa gsum dang sgyu ma sbyor// 'od gsal mthong dang dgnyis med zung 'jug bsgom// dug lnga'i c rlung sems dri ma zad pa na// mya ngan 'das pas thig le dskye ba dag /thig le drlung sems dag pa skye ba ma rtogs rnam shes rlung*// bskyod pas dgzung 'dzin ma rig phyi yul shar// gzung yul

dtshogs drug rnam pa dkar dmar sna tshogs zhen// nang du shes bya dtshogs drug nang du bdag tu 'dzin par skyes// gzung 'dzin dbdag dang bdag gir gnyis la gcig ltos pas// bag chags dlas dang las nyon 'khor ba rgyas// 'dus byas thams cad med pa'i chos c mi bden bzhin du kun rdzob dtha snyad du snang*// phyi'i drlung gis snod kyi 'jig rten kyang*// 'byung bzhi la sogs sna tshogs snang*// nang gi bcud kyi sems can drlung gis kyang*// 'gro drug skye rga na 'chir snang*// snod bcud thams cad rlung gis c skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa drten 'brel tsam dang*// srid pa bar mar dlongs sku'i tshul du ngo bo nyid kyis rdzogs gnas pa dang*// de las skye ba len pa yang*// mngal skyes sgong skyes drod rdzus skyes// de la ma las skyes pa yang*// bar do'i shes pa rlung dang bcas// pho mo'i 'du 'phrod sa bon gnyis// bar do'i c rnam shes rlung gis dma'i mngal du 'phangs// skyed pa'i tshe nam mkha' las rlung me chu sa chags zer c dang po rlung la byang sems brten dchu ba chags pa zer // mngal du d thig le mi 'gyur d rtsa rnams chags// de la dgnas skabs lnga rgyu tshogs pas yan lag lus ngag rgyas// zla bcu skye rga na 'chi d'chi ba'i tshe sa chu me rlung nam mkhar thim 'khrul// rnam dag sbyang gzhi/༈ gsum pa sbyang gzhi'i gnas lugs ni// rgyud phyi ma nas c tha mal lus kyi chos la ni// 'dod 'dun gnod sems gnyid rmugs rgod 'gyod the tshom c dri ma lnga rnams gnas pa ni// rnal 'byor pa'i lam dus na// dri ma ye shes dum bur dkhyi gur gnas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni// chos dsku gzugs sku gnyis chos nyid ye shes thugs rjer gnas drnam pa thams cad mkhyen zer // dang po skye gnas 'khor ba nas// tha ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar// lus dang ngag sems dchos thams cad spros dang bral// 'od gsal zung 'jug rang bzhin

drang la tshang bar gnas // de las dre shig kun rdzob lus 'di la// rtsa rnams brten nas gnas pa dbrten bya rten byed kyis stong bzhin du sgyu ma rmi lam 'am ngo bo dag par gnas yin// rtsa yi nang du thig le ddkar dmar brten// thig le rnams la rlung sems dskye med de brten// rlung gis sems bskyod pas gzung 'dzin skye 'gag med c gsal rig kun rdzob ngo bo stong*// lus la c sems kyi chos nyid dstong pa nyid bsam du med// 'khrul yang rang bzhin dkun rdzob snod bcud thams cad rten 'brel dang dag par gnas// sems can drang byung stong par gnas nam mkha'i khams la gnas// ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas dgzod nas spros pa zhi bar gnas pas kun rdzob tsam du yin no// rang bzhin skye ba med par gnas pas c kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lus ngag sems ddug lnga'i snang ba // rgyu lnga dang dlam rim lnga ye shes lnga sku lnga'i rang bzhin du ni 'bras bu lnga drgyud phyi ma nas // sbyang gzhi'i rang bzhin dlus ngag sems mnyam pa nyid snang yang yang dgos pas lngar gnas te// du ma 'dus pa'i lus 'di la// rtsa ba'i

drlung lnga dang yan lag rlung dlnga // de la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni dchos kyi dbyings ye shes // srog 'dzin dchu rlung snying khar ma shi bar du gnas de bzhin drlung gis rlung mgrin par gyen rgyu dang*// bya grub me rlung d me dang mnyam dnyid sa rlung mnyam gnas d thur sel d'doms nas snyigs ma phyir 'dor dang*// nam mkha'i rlung c khyab byed rlung dlus 'gro 'dug nyal ba skad 'don kun lus dmnyam nyid ye shes tshigs kun la'o// c yan lag rlung gi dbye ba yang*// mig dgzugs dang sna dsgra ba sna ddri dag dang lce cro myong // de bzhin lus kyi reg dang lnga'o// rlung ni bcu po de rnams kyis// las rnams thams cad byed pa yin cskye rgas sogs 'khor ba myang 'das thams cad rlung gis byed pa yin na ོ// rlung bcu bsdus na 'gro dgnas pa 'ong gsum d'bru gsum // a thung dzhig ral med mi shigs thig le dmi 'gyur chos nyid yin// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba dkhos bskyed pa yin// rlung sems 'dus pa'i dngag dben a thung de// ngag c ngo bo smra brjod bral dspros bral nam mkha' ltar bar gnas// ngo bo cra nga la ye nas rang chas gnas// de ni ngag dben dngag ma dag par bcings grol med par sbyang gzhi yin// tha mal dbang po'i snang ba dgsal ba rab 'bring rnam pa gsum// de las rtog pa dsems byung brgyad cur dgzung 'dzin skyes// lus ngag yid la chags gnas pa// gnad c ngo bo bde gsal mi rtog ddbang po gnyis sbyor dus su 'dus ma byas yin// thabs c ma shes 'khrul rtog sdug bsngal yin// 'khrul yang c sems nyid ye nas dri med stong*// de ni sems drnam dag dben sbyang gzhi yin// ིra na 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun// thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin// khyad par 'gro ba mi'i lus dla ye shes chen po gnas // rten 'brel dstong pa snying po med pa'i lus// khyad par

drang bzhin ye nas dag cing 'dus ma byas ye shes re snang tsam sgyu ma dngos rmi lam bar do'i lus// so sor btags min d'dus ma byas 'gog pa dang*/ so sor btags pa'i d'dus ma byas 'gog pa dang*/ nam mkha' d'dus ma byas dang chos nyid de bzhin nyid do// de la 'dus pa csa chu me rlung yid khams chos khams yid rnam shes kyi khams so chos kyi skye mched do// ces so// phung po khams dang skyed mched rnams// rang bzhin med bzhin sna tshogs dkun rdzob snang*// de ni sgyu lus sbyang gzhi drnam dag yin// snang ba lugs 'jug rgyal dus drtog 'gag dang*// pho mo'i 'khrig mngal dgnas dus g.yas g.yon dbu ma la sgom rlung 'pho dus// khyad par dbsgom dus 'chi ba'i dus nyid du// snang gsum rang bzhin rtog pa rnams// stong dang dsa chu me rlung shin tu stong pa dang*// gsum pa stong pa chen por 'dud// phung khams skye mched rlung rnams thim// 'od gsal chos nyid dlugs zlog gnyis snang gis stong par gnas// kun la dbcings grol med gnas pas ngo ma dbsgoms pa nas shes// de ni 'od gsal drnam dag sbyang gzhi yin// chos rnams thams cad gnyis su med// bar do'i rlung gis sems bskyod pa// grib ma gzha' tshon lta bu'i dlus sku// snang stong bden pa gnyis su med// de ni sems can dbcings grol med ye nas kun la gnas// zung du 'jug pa'i dgnyis med sbyang gzhi drnam dag yin// de la sbyong byed bstan pa ni// bzhi pa lam gyi rim pa yis// 'khrul ba dskyon thams cad spangs pa lam du bzlog pa dye shes kyi sku dang 'dra'o/ ni// dus gsum dag gi lam du dlnga ru 'byung*// smin grol gnyis su shes par bya// de la skye shi'i 'jigs pa dphyi rol pa nyan rang logs pa yin kun// rang rgyud dbang gis dle'u bzhi pa brgyad pa bcu bzhi pa bzhin smin par byas// de nas bsrung ba'i dam tshig

dle'u dgu pa sogs la// bya ba ma yin dsku'i dam tshig mi dge bsdam// gsung gi c sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yang bza'// srog gcod pa dang ma byin len dthugs kyi gnyis med ye shes bsgom // mi tshangs ོda rdzun dang dsgyu ma brdzun du smra'o dsems can gyi don du 'gro na bzhi kar bya mi 'gro na bsdam pa gces so// lam rim lnga/༈ gnyis pa grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis// de la re shig rdzogs rim la// ི don gsum du bstan par bya// dang po gang zag dbye ba bstan// gnyis pa rgyud don mdo ru bstan// gsum pa rim lnga rgyas par bshad// gang zag tha ma 'bring gnyis ni// dper na skas kyi rim pa ltar// ngag gis c dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas// bskyed pa'i ddpa' bo gcig pa la sogs pa rim nas zung 'jug par// theg dchen du pa rim gyis sbyangs nas su// mthar gyis skad cig dzung 'jug mi slob pa'i chos sku thob// cig char lam ddon grub lta bu ni chos sku thob// tshogs dsngon sbyangs rdzogs mi rtog dmtshan ma rang grol blo chen dshes rab stong pa'i gyis// skad cig dla 'bad med skye med rtogs// yod med dmtha' gnyis smra bsam spros pa dbden pa gsum med// lus c sgyu ma lta bur sgrib pa dnyon mongs spangs// gang zag c bdag med dchos kyi bdag med 'od gsal stong nyid rtogs// gnyis med ddbyings ye shes ting 'dzin dri ma ddug lnga phra rags zad// chos sku dgsum thob nas rdzogs sangs rgyas// rim lnga mdor bstan brgyud nas ni// rdo rje bzlas pa ye shes che// yid 'ong sngags rnams kun bsdus pa'o// sems can dmigs pa bdag med pa'o// chos rnams sgyu ma lta bus te// thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// gnyis med gnyis su med min zhing*// de skad gsungs pa'i rim lnga ni// rlung bzung 'gro 'ong gnas gsum po// 'bru gsum a thung thig ler bsgom// gzung 'dzin gnyis med dmigs pa zhi// mthar bral gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// ngag gi brjod bral skye med bsgom// sems ni bde gsal stong pas zhi// rlung dang sems kyi rnam 'phrul las// thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgom// phyi nang bsdus la stong par bsgom// 'od gsal stong pa chos sku las// zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bur langs// thams cad zung 'jug sgyu ma ro gcig las// snying rje stong pas 'gro don byas// stan// bzhi pa gsal ba'i rlung la bsgom// lnga pa 'bras bu bstan pa yin// dang po kun rdzob khams gsum rlung*// 'gro 'ong gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum// a thung skye med stong par bsgom/

/don gyi ngo bo dmigs su med// brjod dang dmigs par bshad pa dang*// brdar gyur dang ni don dam mo// ngag gi sgra yang rlung sems sbyangs// rlung la ngo bo dbye ba dang*// dang po kun rdzob khams gsum rlung*// nges pa'i khyad par las dang ni// rgyu tshul g.yas g.yon dril ba dang*// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i grangs// sbyang thebs gsum du shes par bya// gnyis pa bem po'i rlung la sbyangs// dngos med rten 'brel las byung ba'i// dbugs ni nang du rngubs gyur pa// oṃ dang rnam snang skye med gnas// khog pa'i rlung la sems nyid gzung*// rlung de khong na gnas pa ni// a thung skye med snang mtha' yas// rlung ni phyir 'gro hūṃ du bsam// sgyu ma lta bu'i mi bskyod spro// rlung ni 'byung 'jug gnas gsum mo// rang bzhin lhun grub bzlas pa yin// sngags la rnam shes bsdus bsgom pas// sems nyid mi rtog bzlas pa yin// rtags su rlung rgyu'i grangs shes shing*// me dang rlung dang sa chu'i rlung*// nang nas rgyu ba'i kha dog shes// gsum pa rtsa rlung sgom thabs ni// myur dang rnam sdud dal bas sbyangs// myur ba'i rlung sems phyir spros pas// khru gang tsam nas rlung rngubs pa// 'og rlung 'then la steng rlung mnan// de ltar rlung sngags byang chub sems// mi rtog pa la rab sbyar bas// nang du stong nyid ye shes 'phel// pho rlung gdul la mo rlung sbyang*// ma ning rlung la sta stangs bya// bzhi pa gsal ba'i rlung la ni// mig gi lam nas rgyu ba'i rlung*// hūṃ sems phyi rol rgyu rnams kun// mi bskyod sgyu ma'i rnam shes kun// gzung bas rang bzhin med par bsgom// nang du log pas oṃ sems bsdus// sgyu ma'i rnam snang 'dzin med bsgom// sems nyid gnas pa skye med ā// sgyu ma'i snang mtha' gzung 'dzin stong*// de bzhin sna dang lce lus bsgre// lus ngag bya bral zhi gnas ni// bstan pa je che je che gnas// de ltar nyin zhag phrugs gcig la// nyi khri chig stong drug rgya'i rlung*// nyin mtshan 'gro 'ong gnas gsum 'gag

/de ltar yan lag rlung lnga yang*// thig le mi shigs stong par gnas// dmigs med chos nyid rtag tu bsgom// de yi 'bras bu bstan pa ni// ngag dben rlung sems sbyangs pa yis// zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi yang 'grub// ye shes rgyud la skye bar byed// mi rtog pa yi chos nyid do// dmigs pa med pa'i a thung de// bde ba lhan cig g.yos pa spangs// gdod nas zhi zhing dri med stong*// chos rnams de lta bur shes pas// smra bar byed pa'i brjod dang bral// 'gro 'ong gnas med rlung sems stong*// rjes shes bde gsal rgya yis gdab// sgra rnams brag cha lta bur shes// lus ngag dregs pa las sgrib spong*// zhi gnas nam mkha' lta bur rtogs// snod bcud thams cad sgyu mar 'char// rang bzhin rtog pa rnam rtog 'gyur// thams cad snang stong gnyis med sbyangs// de ni ngag dben slab bya yin// gnyis pa sems dben bslab bya la// ི don rnam pa bzhi yin te// dang po sems dben rnam rtog bstan// gnyis pa sgrub thabs gsum gyi lam// gsum pa dag pa che 'bring bstan// bzhi ba zhar 'byung grol lam mo// de la sems kyi rnam pa de// ngo bo spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// nam mkha' lta bur mtshan ma med// kun rdzob snang tsam gsal rig tsam// de la brten nas snang gsum 'byung*// dper na gnyid log sad pa ltar// yid kyi rnam shes de nyid ni// gsal dang shin tu gsal ba dang*// gsal ba bya ba rdzogs dang gsum// snang ba gsum po de nyid las// dpe ni nyi zla mtshams gsum yin// snang ba gsum po de rnams las// gzung 'dzin rtog pa brgyad cur 'byung*// nyin mtshan mtshams gsum rtog pa yis// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par byed// de nyid thabs kyis bzang rtog ni// snang ba gsum dang stong pa gsum// chos dbyings stong par sbyar la bsgom// ji srid rlung ni mi rgyu na// snang gsum rtog pas mi g.yo bas// gnyis pa sgrub thabs gsum la bslabs// rtog pa chung bas mu tra la// dngos su brten la sems dben sbyangs// bdag dang mu tra sgyu mar bsgom// mkha' gsangag

/yid la 'gro zhing 'ong ba dang*// mya ngan la sogs gsum de bzhin// zhi dang rnam rtog 'jigs pa dang*// 'jigs pa bar dang shin tu 'jigs// sred dang sred pa bar ma dang*// shin tu sred dang nyer len dang*// mi dge bkres dang skom pa dang*// tshor dang tshor ba bar ma dang*// shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang*// rig pa po dang rig 'dzin bzhi// so sor rtog dang ngo tsha shes// snying rje dang ni brtse ba gsum// dogs dang bsags pa nyid dang ni// phrag dog ces ni bya bar grags// rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum gang*// lus can rnams kyis rang rig ste// kun rdzob tha mal sems 'byung rnams// gnyis pa stong nyid skad cig 'gag /dga' bde mi rtog stong nyid thim// nyams shes zla ba lta bur snang*// de bzhin ting 'dzin snyoms zhugs pas// byang sems snying khar babs tsa na// mched pa shin tu stong par zhugs// rang bzhin rtog pa 'di rnams 'gag /'dod chags chags dang de bzhin 'gag /dga' ba bar dang shin tu dga'// rab dang rab tu mgu ba dang*// ngo mtshar de bzhin rgod pa dang*// tshim dang de bzhin 'khyud pa dang*// 'o byed de bzhin 'jibs pa dang*// brtan dang rtsod dang nga rgyal dang*// byang dang 'grogs dang stobs dag dang*// spro dang dka' la sbyor ba dang*// de bzhin rkang sbyor bar ma dang*// shin tu dka' la sbyor ba dang*// rnam par sgeg dang zhe 'dras nyid// dge dang tshig gsal bden pa dang*// mi bden pa dang de bzhin nges// nye bar mi len sbyin pa po// skul dang de bzhin dpa' bo dang*// ngo tsha med dang rgyu dang sdug /mi bsrun pa dang gya gyu nyid// rang bzhin bzhi bcu tham pa yis// skad cig gnyis pa mchog dga' bde// shin tu stong nyid gsal snang rgyas// nyams snang nyi ma shar ba 'dra// snang stong dbyer med sbyor ba yis// byang sems dbyer med rdo rjer 'dud// thob pa stong nyid chen por skye// rtog pa 'di rnams chos dbyings thim// chags pa bar ma'i skad cig dang*// brjed nges pa dang 'khrul pa dang*// mi smrar gyur dang skyo ba dang*// le lo de bzhin the tshom bdun// ma rig bdun po 'di rnams ni// phra mo'i rnal 'byor pas shes bya// skad cig gsum la khyad dga' bde// stong chen mun pa lta bu'i nyams// bzhi pa nye bar zhi ba ni// rtog pa thams cad kyis stong ngo*// gzung rtog yul dang yul zhen spangs// 'dzin rtog sems kyi chags sdang spangs// byang sems rtog pas dben pa'o// stong pa gsum gyis rgyas btabs pas// sems dang sems 'byung dmigs su med// rang bzhin 'od gsal thim gyur pas// bzhi pa dga' bral lhan cig skyes// thams cad stong pas ye shes dag

/byang sems bzung bzlog dgram gnas bskyal// rjes shes gzugs sogs rab 'bring rnams// bde stong nang du mnyam par bzhag /phyag rgya'i bsam gtan 'byongs pa dang*// 'dra 'bags lan gcig myong la sbyangs// sngar bzhin ye shes dmigs la bsgom// snang ba mched thob lugs zhugs te// rtog pa sum cu bzhi bcu bdun// skad cig bzhi dang dga' bde bzhi// stong pa bzhi yis rnam dag pa// rtag tu rnal 'byor pas mtshon bsgom// gnyis med gnyis su med par gnas// mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu las// rjes shes sgyu ma'i tshogs drug po// bde stong yul du mnyam par bzhag /dper na mkha' la sprin byung yang*// de nyid du ni thim pa ltar// de bzhin rnam rtog stong par thim// de nyid shes na ye shes can// spros pa'i mtshan ma rnam par spangs// de ltar sgrub pa gsum po la// sems ni de ltar bsgom pa las// gsum pa sems nyid dag par 'gyur// rab ni tshe 'dir zung 'jug rtogs// dbang dang ngo sprod bla mas byas// stong pa gsum dang rnam dag pas// 'od gsal bar ni de gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing*// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// thams cad mkhyen par de nas 'gyur// 'bring ni bar dor zung 'jug rtogs// 'chi khar sgyu lus bsgom pa de// mtshams med lnga yis las can dang*// mi gang bsod nams dman pa yang*// yid sbyin nor dang 'dra bar bzhag /bla ma'i drin gyis thob 'gyur te// 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas// chags min chags dang bral ba min// dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so// ye shes gsum bral de nyid gang*// thams cad stong par gsungs pa yin// dbang po tha ma skye ba'i rgyu// ngag dben sems dben bsgom pa de// bar dor sgyu lus ting 'dzin sbyangs// skye ba brgyud nas zung 'jug rtogs// de ni rim gyis sa zhes bya// bzhi pa grol lam sems dben ni// sku ni drang po ma yin zhing*// mi drang ba yang ma yin zhing*// lta stangs ldan pas rlung bcings bya// sems ni bde gsal stong pa nyid// sgyu ma'i lus kyi snying kha ru// 'khor lo stong pa nyid du bsdu// thams cad stong pa rmad po che// ngas zhing gsal ba'i ye shes che// lnga pa phan yon ོda pa ni// mngon shes lnga dang 'gro don byed// 'dod yon lnga la ci bder ོda// srid pa'i gzeb las grol bar 'gyur// ye shes me chen nyon mongs sreg

/gsum pa sgyu lus bslabs pa ni// sa mtshams rnam pa lngar zhes bya// dang po rang bzhin sgyu mar bstan// gnyis pa sgyu lus dpe la sbyar// gsum pa dpe don sbyar la bsgom// bzhi pa de nyid bsgom par 'byung*// rlung dang sems kyi rnam 'phrul las// rnam shes lus grub sgyu ma'i gzugs// 'gro ba thams cad sgyu ma yin// phyi nang thams cad sgyu ma yin// srid gsum sgyu ma snying po med// de ni rang bzhin sgyu lus so// gnyis pa dpe yi sgyu lus ni// me long g.ya' dag gsal ba la// yi dam gzugs brnyan 'char du bzhug /bstod dman rtog pa de la med// snang la rang bzhin med par 'dug /gsal la rtog pa med par 'dug /kha 'dra// kun la khyab pas chu zla 'dra// rgyu rkyen bcas pas sgyu ma 'dra// sems dang bcas pa'i rmi lam 'dra// gsum pa dpe don bcas la bsgom// sgyu ma'i dpe ni de rnams dang*// rnal 'byor dbang pos gang dmigs pa// de de sgyu ma bzhin du bsgom// snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang*// phung khams skye mched sgyu ma dang*// sems dang chos nyid sgyu ma dang*// dbyer med gnyis gcig stong par bsgom// bzhi pa sgyu ma'i de nyid ni// chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma la// dgag sgrub med par mnyam gnas pa// sgyu ma'i snang ba gsum po dang*// sgyu ma'i rang bzhin rtogs pa rnams// khams gsum phyi nang snod bcud kun// ci snang sgyu ma'i lus la bsdus// sgyu ma'i lus kyang stong par bsgom// rnam par dag pa nam mkha' bzhin// bsam du med pa'i ngang la bzhag /sgyu mas sgyu mar rloms sems med// sgyu ma tsam du ting 'dzin la// zhen par gyur na de yang spangs// sgyu ma 'od gsal me yis sbyang*// dngos dang dngos med las grol te// bden brdzun dag pas don dam yin// chos rnams kun la gnas pa med// 'od gsal thams cad stong pa'o// chos rnams ngo bo med pa la// yang dag rtogs na stong nyid grol// dngos dag kun las rnam par grol// gzugs sgra la sogs sgyu mar ོda// sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin brtag pa na// ngan song mi 'gro sdug bsngal zhig

/nyon mongs rags pa'i cha bri nas// 'od gsal bden pa mthong bar 'gyur// sgyu lus nyin par sbyang thabs so// da ni mtshan mo'i sgyu lus sbyangs// mtshan mo'i rmi lam sgyu lus bzung*// de la 'dun pa drag po bya// rmi lam na ni chos rnams kun// rmi lam 'khrul pa sgyu mar bsgom// de la spro bsdu du ma bya// rnam pa sna tshogs rmi lam na// snang yang de nyid stong par bsgom// log rtog sgyu mar snang ba de// ye shes sgyu mar snang ba byas// nyams nga bag tsha med pa'i sems// rmi lam sgyu ma ltar zhi zhing*// de nyid ye shes slebs pa yin// 'khrul snang byung na yang yang sbyangs// dmigs med stong pa'i rgya yis gdab// rmi lam snang ba lugs zhugs nas// rmi lam dus na 'od gsal rtogs// de nyid bar do 'byongs pa yin// gnyid log sad par gyur pa des// sngar gyi rmi lam zin pa dang*// sad pa'i 'khrul snang khyad med bsgom// chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste// ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing*// 'od gsal stong par rang bzhin gnas// khams gsum 'khor 'das mkha' bzhin

£ེ// sgyu lus nyin mtshan gnyis la sbyangs// 'chi khar sgyu lus 'od gsal bsgom// des ni bar dor sgyu mar 'dra// rmi lam ji bzhin ye shes lus// bar dor 'od gsal chosin chen la// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon lnga// ci 'byor pas ni mchod byas la// tshogs kyi dal du snyoms 'jug pa'i// mu tra phul nas gsang dbang zhu// bla mas sgyu lus ngo sprad pas// yang na nam gyi tho rangs dus// mchod dang gsol btab gzhung bzhin bya// gnyis pa phyi nang byang chub ni// bla mas 'di skad bshad cing bstan// dper na mtshan mo zla ba de// sems nyid snang ba'i dpe yin no// nyi ma ches gsal mched pa'i dpe// nyi zla med pa mtshams kyi smag /mi gsal mun pa thob pa'i dpe// nam langs nyi ma shar ba ltar// sprin med nam mkha' 'od gsal dpe// de bzhin nang gi byang chub la// bsgom pas snang gsum lugs zhugs pas// rang bzhin brgyad cu stong par thim// rang bzhin dag na 'od gsal mchog /thams cad ma skyes zag pa med// zad 'phel yod med tha snyad bral// dge dang sdig pa'i gzugs med pas// ngo bo nyid dag gos pa med// thams cad stong par sangs rgyas gsungs// de nyid nyams su len pa la// gsum pa bla ma'i ngo sprod bya// dbang ni gsum pa'i dus 'di ru// ye shes gnyis med don la blta// spros pa mtha' bral stong pa nyid// grol lam zung 'jug rba rlabs mnan// chags lam mu tra gtad nas su// de nas snyoms 'jug bsam gtan la// snod bcud phung khams skye mched bsdu// sku gsung thugs dang thig ler bsdu// dga' ba bzhi dang stong nyid bzhi// dpe don 'od gsal skad cig thong*// lugs bzlog rjes shes sgyu mar langs// bla mas gdams pa sbyin pa nie// dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing// phung po khams dang skye mched ni// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// chos bdag med dang mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gzod nas ma skyes pas// stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma'i drin thob bsgom bya ba// gsal dag phra ba mchog tu zhi// rang bzhin sangs rgyas myang 'das khams// gnyis med rtog bral rtag tu bde// rang bzhin de bzhin nyid la ni// rtag par rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya// bzhi ba nyams blang rgyas par bshad// de la nang ses gsum yod de// ril 'dzin rjes gzhig rnam gnyis dang*// gsum pa rgyu dag ldang ba'o// de la ril por 'dzin pa ni// dper na me long has btab bzhin// bdag dang phyi nang snod bcud kun// sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam snang du// rang bzhin med par wal 'tsher bsgom// de yang spros med hūṃ du bsdus// de yang thig le na dar bsdus// na da rtog med stong par bsgom// stong pa'i ngang la mnyam gnas pa// snang ba mched par lugs zhugs pas// rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum thim// mnyam nyid stong pa'i zhi gnas so// nyams myong zla ba lta bur 'char// sa rlung chu la thim pa yis// nyams su smig rgyu lta bu la// 'od zer lnga yi tshogs 'byung ngo// de las snang ba thob pa dang*// chu rlung me la thim pa yis// snang ba du ba ltar snang ngo// de nas phyi nang khams gsum po// mtha' yas sgyu mar bsdus la bsgom// de yang skye med a la bsdus// shin tu stong pa dmigs med pas// mched pa thob par zhugs zhugs te// rang bzhin rtog pa bzhi bcu thim// mchog tu bde chen dmigs su med// mched pa nyi ma lta bu'i nyams// me rlung rlung la thim pa yis// srin bu me khyer ltar snang ngo*// nam mkha'i glog ltar dmar khyug 'od// yang ni khams gsum snod bcud rnams// mi bskyod sgyu mar bsdus la bsgom// de yang rtog med hūṃ la bsdus// hūṃ yang thig le stong chen bsgom// thob pa lugs su zhugs pa yis// rang bzhin rtog pa bdun thim nas// shes pa mi gsal mun pa bzhin// rlung ni rnam shes la thim pas// snang ba mar me lta bur dmar// thob pa yang na skad cig dran rdzogs la// lus ngag yid gsum stong par bsgom// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// blo btags rags phra'i rtog pa rnams// 'od gsal stong pa chos kyi sku// gsal dag mchog zhi rnal 'byor yul// smra bsam brjod bral skye ba med// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis su med// dper na sprin med nam mkha' bzhin// 'od gsal rang bzhin dri ma med// zag med zil gyis mi gnon pa// thams cad yod med phyogs las 'das// stong nyid brjod las 'das pa las// yi ge med par yi ge bstan// de nyid rgyu dang zung du 'gyur// dbang po rab kyis de bzhin bsgom// rjes gzhig dbang po 'bring gis bsgom// dpe ni chu yi paV bzhin// rim gyis sa khams stong pa gsum// 'od gsal stong par lugs su gzhugs// de nas bdag nyid sku gsung thugs// sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom la bsdu// rtog pa sum cu bzhi bcu bdun// rim bzhin stong dang shin tu stong*// stong chen bzhi pa thams cad stong*// zla nyi mun dang sa chu me// rlung dang rnam shes thim pa'i rtags// 'od gsal la sogs gong dang 'dra// rjes su gzhig pa'i bsam gtan yin// mnyam gzhag 'od gsal rtogs pa yis// lugs bzlog sgyu ma dag pa'i sku// zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bur bzhengs// dbang po yul snang gang byung yang*// sgyu mar snang yang gzung 'dzin med// rlung sems dag pas zhing rnams sbyangs// snang stong gnyis med ro gcig bsgom// ye shes sgyu 'dra dag pa yis// rang sems skye med rnam dag pas// ta tha'i zhal mthong chos nyan dang*// nam mkha' mdzod kyi sbyin pa gtong*// sems can don du 'phrin las bzhi// dag pa'i chu rlung nyis brgya dang*// nyer lnga'i bar du 'od gsal bsgom// sems can nad gdon zhi bar 'gyur// de bzhin sa me rlung gi rlung*// ser dmar ljang ba dbang rgyas drag

/sems can don du thogs med 'grub/ ba gang zhig gnyid log pa// snang gsum ngang gis lugs su 'jug /shes pa gnyid du 'gro dus su// phung khams skye mched dbang sogs rnams// shes pa gnyis po de ni thob par legs 'dus nas// stong chen gyur la 'gro ba gang zhig gnyid log pa// gnyid du 'gro khar 'di bzhin bsgom// sems kyi phyi rol mtshan ma med// phung khams skye mched snying gar bsdu// mi rtog stong la lhan tser gzhag /phyi nang rtog pas rnam par dben// blo ni stong par dmigs med bzhag /gnyid dang stong nyid bsre la nyal// gnyid de stong nyid 'od gsal 'gyur// chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin// gzung 'dzin med pa'i ting 'dzin nyid// thob chen phra mos rmi lam snang*// rmi lam rab tu 'od gsal bsgom// thob pa gnyid kyi ngang nyid las// rmi lam lugs zhugs 'od gsal rtogs// rang rig 'od gsal de bzhin nyid// gnas med gsal la 'od gsal ba// rang bzhin rnam dag rtog med sku// 'dzin med de bzhin sa ler mkhyen// gnyid kyi 'od gsal zung 'jug yin// ma zhen rnal 'byor sgyu mar sbyangs// nam mkha' lta bur skye 'gag med// nyin dang mtshan du yang yang bsgom// lung ston pa dang 'od gsal mthong*// gnyid kyi 'od gsal rtogs pa na// rnal 'byor pa de 'chi ba'i tshe// snang gsum rang bzhin lugs su 'jug /phung khams skye mched rlung rnams 'du// de tshe 'od gsal bsgom par bya'o// zhen rtog stong par btsanug ni// gaṅga'i klung gi bye snyed kyi// sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di nyid dag /thugs chud yod med phyogs spangs pa// phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid 'grub// lta ba thams cad rab spangs pa'o// blta bya lta byed gnyis su med// dngos po 'di rnams ma skyes pas// chos dang chos min rnam rtog med// chos med chos nyid med pas te// nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa// chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing*// chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs// rnam par mi rtog don dam la// byang chub med cing bsgom pa med// gnyis med ye shes chos nyid la// mtshan mar slob pa zad pa yin// chos nyid nam mkha' smra bsam med// rang bzhin dag pas chos nyid la// gnyis med blo ni dbyer mi phyed// chos kyi dbyings ni gnas med pa// nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' gnas// dmigs pa'i mtshan ma bsgom mi byed// stong dang nyon mongs stong pas 'joms// stong pa yod med mngon zhen na// dri ma chen por de nyid 'gyur// stong dang mi stong bsam du med// ngo bo gnyis med ye shes nyid// spangs thob rnam dag sangs rgyas med// rtag chad skye 'gag mtha' dang bral// skye med nam mkha' khas len bral// £ེཾ pa zung 'jug bstan pa ni// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// rtog pa gnyis po rnam spangs pa// gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa// zung du 'jug ces de la bshad// kun nyon mongs dang rnam par byang*// don dam nyid du shes nas ni// gang gis gcig tu shes gyur pa// de ni zung du 'jug par shes// dngos po rnam bcas kun rtoblo dag ni// gang gis spangs nas rab gnas pa'i// zung du 'jug pa'i rim 'di yi// de nyid shes te mkhas pa yin// lhag bcas lhag med rtog med zung*// bdag med rtog gnyis rnam grol zung*// ngag sems sgyu ma 'od gsal ba// zung 'jug gnyis med bsam gtan gnas// thams cad mnyam gyur zung 'jug pas// gnyen po bsgoms pas rtog pa dag

/kun rdzob don dam 'dres gyur zung*// de bzhin nyid dang ldan gyur zung*// ma skyes pa'i chos rnams la// ngo bo med de bsgom pa med// ngo bo nyid ni zhi ba la// gnyen po mi rtog mi dmigs pa// nam mkha'i lam la mnyam gnas pa// zung 'jug bsgom pa'i sgom zhes brjod// mnyam nyid rnam dag zad pa med// dngos dang dngos med rnams spangs pa'i// dmigs pa med ces rab tu zhi// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong gis// thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid la// bsgom bya sgom byed dmigs su med// chos nyid ye shes chung 'bring che// khams gsum dri rtog che 'bring 'joms// ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pas// sa bcu la ni gnas par 'gyur// lhan skyes dri ma rim bzhin spong*// gsum pa 'brel pa'i zung 'jug ni// stong pa snying rje dbyer med zung*// chos nyid spros med ma skyes las// thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug zung*// thams cad rnal 'byor stong par gnas// gnyid log pa dang rnam 'brel zung*// mnyam par gzhag dang ma gzhag med// dngos dang dngos med rnal 'byor zung*// dran dang mi dran las grol bas// chags dang chags med las grol zhing*// mchog tu bde chen lus dang ldan// bya dang mi byed rnal 'byor pas// bskyed rdzogs gnyis med gcig gyur zung*// dag dang ma dag lta med de// gzugs can gzugs med gnyis spangs nas// gang zhig zhi rtog rnal 'byor dbang*// de ni zung 'jug thob pa'o// de ltar gang nga*// thams cad nam mkha' lta bur mtshungs// dkar po'i chos rnams khong du chud// mu mtha' med pa'i ting 'dzin rgyas// nyon mongs ma yin ma rig phra// slob pa'i zung 'jug mthar spangs pas// lnga ba 'bras bu'i zung 'jug ni// skad cig chos dbyings de nyid mthong*// rlung sems lugs 'byung lugs bzlog zad// snang ba gsum pa rnam dag pa// rtog dang nyon sgrib chos dbyings grol// skye 'gag chos nyid yang dag dag

/spros med rang bzhin ro gcig zhi// ye shes dag pas 'od gsal dang*// sku dang gsung thugs mkha' mnyam dag /nyon mongs las rnams grol ba yi// spangs thob rtag chad skye 'gag med// yod med gnyis ka gnyis med min// 'khor 'das gnyis med dmigs spros shing*// mya ngan 'das med myang 'das zhes// nam mkha' lta bur bcings las grol// sna tshogs 'dzin ces brjod pa yin// sgyu 'phrul dra ba sngon sangs rgyas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor pha rol son// bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor che// bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas// de nyid gnyis med ye shes te// chos nyid smra bsam brjod las 'das// 'di la bsam du ci yang med// thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid la// bstan par bya ba cung zad med// lam gyi chos rnams zad pas te// slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo// blang dor med cing sangs rgyas med// chos kyi sku zhes ming du brjod// thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas yin// 'bras bu thob tshul/ ༈ da ni 'bras bu'i thob tshul bstan// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa de// chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i dbyings// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di// gnyis med rnam dag ye shes sku// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med// dag pa gnyis med ye shes sku// sku ni mi 'gyur ma skyes pa// gsung dang thugs kyang mtshan ma med// sangs rgyas rnams ni chos skur bzhugs// de'i rnam 'phrul gzugs sku gnyis// chos nyid 'grib pa med par dag /nam mkha' lta bur 'pho 'gyur med// chos sku skye med sku de ni// gnyis med ye shes stong pa rnams// sangs rgyas rnams la chos sku de// nam mkha' khyab par gnas pa yin// chos nyid rnam par dag pa la/po dri med dang*// sngon gyi smon lam stobs dag gis// gdul bya byang chub sems dpa' la// longs sku gzha' tshon lta bu de// stong gsum khyab par gnas nas su// 'og min chos kyi pho brang de// rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa des// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni// rgyun mi 'chad pa'i chos gsungs so// longs sku de yi phrin las las// da'o// dper na sbrul gyi shun brjes ltar// skye ba gcig la mchog 'grub yin// tshe 'dir mnyam par gzhag pa la// ngag dben sems dben sgyu lus bsgom// mnyam par gzhag pa'i dus nyid du// 'od gsal mthong la ma goms na// rnal 'byor pa de g.yengs pas khyer// sgom dang ོda pa ma khom pas// nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus nyid du// snang gsum lugs su 'jug pa dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched sogs// rnam shes rlung dang bcas pa thim// phyi dbugs chad de nang dbugs gnas// sngar gyi sgom pa'i 'od gsal dang*// shi ba stong pa'i 'od gsal gnyis// chu la chu bzhin gnyis med 'dres// bar dor 'od gsal skye med rtogs// bar dor sgyu ma dag pa langs// gzha' tshon lta bu'i ye shes sku// zung du 'jug pa de langs nas// bar do'i yul lnga stong par bsgoms// 'dzam bu gling ni phrag brgya ru// sprul pa bye brag phrag brgya yis// gdul bya gang mos bsam pa la// de dang mthun pa'i chos ston no// sku gsum don dam ro gcig yin// kun rdzob tsam du sangs rgyas de// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du// ji ltar mkhyen pa'i ye shes la// gang gi rlung gi sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor// phrin las sprul sku sgyu 'dra las// ji snyed pa yi ye shes kyis// kun la khyab cing sprul pa 'gyed// gdul bya dag pa gzhan snang la// 'khor dang myang 'das mkhyen bzhin du// de yi chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/

dper na 'dam gyi pa V bzhin// chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos so// dper na yid bzhin nor bu bzhin// 'bad pa med par 'gro ba 'dren// ye shes sprul sku longs sku rnams// chos kyi sku la brten nas su// chos sku gang la'ang mi gnas so// mthar thug pa la brjod du med// bar dor zung 'jug mi slob thob// bar dor rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// tshe 'dir sgyu lus rtogs pa na// nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus nyid du// snang gsum ngang gis lugs su 'jug /'chi ba shes rab pha rol phyin// 'dun pa drag pos rjes dran bya// phung khams skye mched yul dbang 'dus/ snang gsum 'od gsal rtogs na rab// 'od gsal rtogs par ma gyur na// tshe 'dir sgyu lus bsgom pa de// bar dor sgyu lus ngos zin te// bar dor sgyu lus 'od gsal sbyangs// gal te skye ba len na yang*// rang dbang yod pas lus len no// 'gro ba'i don byed chos sgrub lus// de lta bu ru lus blangs la// 'gro don byas la mchog bsgrubs pas// mngon par byang chub thob 'gyur ro// skye ba brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas yin// de ltar rab kyi tshe 'dir thob// 'bring ni bar dor 'grub pa las// tha ma skye ba brgyud nas thob// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag kha che'i paṇḍi ta nā ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

rgya gar kha che'i paṇḍa a ha ri me tog brtsegs pa'i dgon par gus shing legs par bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o// sāo phag shi thaṃ/ rgya rgya rgya// ´/129) ༄// gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gdams ngag ༈ rim lnga'i gdams ngag sems la dmigs pa dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ zung du 'jug pa'o// sems la dmigs pa ni/ zung du 'jug pa'o// sems la dmigs pa ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po gling bzhi las gzhan du mi 'gro ba ltar/ rang gi sems nyid kyang*/ 'khor lo bzhi las gzhan du mi 'jug ste/ de yang gnyid kyi tshe mgrin pa na gnas/ rmi lam gyi tshe snying ga na gnas/ 'khrig pa'i tshe ི bo na gnas/ tha mal gyi tshe lte ba na gnas pa'o// de las lte ba'i 'og gi rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang gi sems nyid a thung du reg bya tsha ba rno ba gdung pa gcig yod pa la sems gtad la steng rlung mnan la bsgom mo// de ltar gnas pa'i tshe rnam rtog rags pa 'gags pas stong pa/ phra ba 'gags pas stong pa chen po/ shin tu phra ba 'gags pa shin tu stong pa'o// de nas dbugs phyir ma thub nas 'chor ba na/ phyir nar gyis rgyu tsam na āoṃ/ nang du gnas pa'i tshe yang āḥ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe hūm̐ la sems gtad pa'i ni rdo rje bzlas pa'o// snang srid kyi chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgyu lus so// 'od gsal ni sgyu ma de nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gsal ba'o// zung du 'jug pa ni de ltar sgyu ma dang stong pa dbyer med du gsam pa'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni rjes la brtags 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sa chu la thim pa'i rtags su snang la zhen pa med pa'i sprin ltar lang long du snang ba dang*/ chu me la thim pa'i rtags su du ba ltar lang long du snang ba dang*/ me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su srin bu me khyer ltar tshag ge tshig ge dang*/

rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags su shes pa rang rig rang gsal dang*/ rnam par shes pa nam mkha' la thim pa'i rtags su sprinas steng 'og spro bar bya ba yin gsung ste/ de'i dus su yang shes pa bsgrims pa las rlung gi rgyu ba mi dgag bkag na na tshar 'gra ba yin gsung zhes bla ma la dris pas gsung ngo*/ stod mi bde ba dtsog pu la bol du thig le dkar po lte ba drang smad kyis dtshangs pa'i lte bar drang bsal ba/ smad kyi stod kyis bsal ba/ rgyab kyi mdun du bsal ba dang*/ mdun du bsal ba dang*/ nang gi phyir bsal dlus drang la lte ba las phyir 'gro ba dang*/ phyi'i nang du dsnying gar gru gsum nang du a la gtad phyi'i nang du bsal ba'o// ´/130) ༄// rim lnga'i bsdus gsal/ ༈ rgya gar skad du/ pa kra ma saṃ gra ha pra £ wa/ bod skad du/ rim pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che// rim pa lnga la gnas pa po// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te// sems dang lus kyi gnas thabs las// rags dang phra dang shin tu phra// thun mong dbyer med rim zhes bya/ gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug pa// tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid kyis// rtsa dang thig le sems shes pa// lus dang dus dang yul gyi ni// gnad ni bzhi ru shes par bya// dran pa sna tshogs rnam rtog rnams// sems las yang dag 'byung bas na// rnam shes srog ni 'du ba'i rten// snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom// gzhi lam 'bras bu rab shes pas// lus dben sngags dang sems gsum gyi// sgyu ma mngon par byang chub pa// zung 'jug rim pa shes par 'gyur// sngags kyi yi ge'i 'khor lo ni// dang por chu skyes 'dab brgyad pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul gyis ni// rim pa ldan par bsam gtan bya// phyi rim shes rab dbyangs yig mtshan// bar ma gsal byed thabs bcas pa// gnyis su med par nang mar gnas// phyogs mtshams rim par ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba rnam pa gsum rang bzhin// dbus su mi shigs thig le ste// a dang bcas pa srog gyur gang*// kun gyi snying po spro zhing sdud// 'byung ba bzhi yi rlung rnams nyid// rlung dang sngags su rab sbyor bas// rdo rje bzlas pa sbyang bar bya// 'byung 'jug gnas pa nyi shu bshad/

tha mal rnam rtog bag chags rnams// sngags nyid sems su dmigs pas so// lus dag pas ni rtog pa dag /rlung dag pas ni dri med 'gyur// rlung dag pas ni ye shes kyi// kun rdzob sgyu ma mngon du byed// de nyid mngon par byang chub pas// zung 'jug ye shes thob par 'gyur// las rnams bya ba phrin las tshogs// rnam shes ye shes sbyor bas 'grub// rtags rnams rim par 'char ba'i dngos// ye shes lnga yi rgyu mthun nyams// gsal snang 'bar ba'i ngang du'o// yan lag rlung las mngon shes 'thob// rtog pa'i tshogs ni mar 'grib cing*// gnyen po ye shes yar 'phel du// ye shes rim pa rang las rnyed// gcig dang du mar dmigs mi phyed// dang po smig rgyu lta bu'i nyams// 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa 'char// gnyis pa zla ba lta bu dang*// gsum pa nyi ma'i 'od kyi 'khrigs// mtshams snang las ni thob pa ste// mtshams bral dus kyi ye shes che// mngon par byang chub tshul gnas pas// dri med ye shes mngon par rdzogs// rtags dang rtags can 'char tshul ni// ye shes 'bar dang rdzogs pa'i dus// rlung sems tsam las 'byung ba yi/ sgyu ma'i lus ni snang bar bcas// 'od gsal rgyun gyi bsam gtan gyis// las dang sgrib pa bag chags sbyangs// sa lam rtags kyi rim pa'i tshogs// 'di nyid thob pas myur du 'char// nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par// gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya// 'dab ma brgyad pa'i sa bon la// dbus su srog gi sa bon te// yi ge ka nas ha yig bar// kṣa ni spangs pa'i gzhi bcas pa// dbyangs ni phyi rim snang ba ste// gsal byed bar ma mched pa nyid// ma ning snang ba thob par brjod// bcu gnyis yi ge thig ler bcas// phreng ba lta bur gnas pa ni// rim pa lnga ldan bsam par bya// 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa// e waṃ thabs dang shes rab las// sdud cing spro bar mdzad pa yi// a zhes dbus su gnas par mdzad// mnyam pa nyid du sems bsdam ste// mnyam gzhag 'khor lo'i lte ba yis// ye shes mnyam par mthong gyur pa// nye bar thob pa stong pa che// 'od gsal ba yi gnas thob pa// 'khor ba las ni brgal bar 'gyur// thun gcig yang na nyin gcig gam// zla phyed zla ba lo yi dus// bskal pa'am bskal pa stong du yang*// skad cig re rer gnas pa ni// ye shes sbyor ba rtag tu 'byung*// rim pa gnyis pa la gnyis pa// mnyam par zung 'brel nyid bsgom pa// bskyed pa'i rim 'di lha yi sku// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor mchog

/rnam pa mngon du byed pa gang*// legs par bslabs pas mthar phyin 'gyur// lus dben snang ba sems dang lus/ rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten bcas// rim pas lha yi bdag nyid sbyor// rdo rje 'chang chen lam du byed// mos pa las byung ting nge 'dzin// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'o// rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas pa gsum// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las// rlung sngags mnyam par rab sbyor gang*// rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'o// gsang sngags las byung rnam par shes// snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid ni// ye shes 'jug ldog nges pa gang*// sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'o// rmi lam lus ni rnam sbyangs phyir// sgyu mar mtshon pa'i dus gang las// yul snang kun rdzob gang byung ba// sgyu ma lta bu'i rim pa'o// rang bzhin shes pa bsam gtan las// thabs las ma bskyed ting nge 'dzin// rang gsal ngo bo mi rtog pa// 'od gsal don dam rim pa'o// bsam gtan mes sbyangs lha yi sku// rang byung ye shes dag pa'i lus// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed bral bar gnas// zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// byang chub sems ldan bla ma dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor dang*// shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che// rjes su rnal 'byor bcas pa dang*// ting 'dzin rim pa ldan pa yis// bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa che// sgrub pa'i ngo bo khyad par du// so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// yan lag drug ldan khyad par ro// rim pa bzhi ldan phyag rgyar bcas// dbang bzhi sku bzhi rang 'byung bas// mngon par byang chub tshul lnga las// bskyed dang bskyed cing gnas pa dang*// lam gyur rim pa lnga ldan pas// byang chub phyogs chos mdo don dang*// sbas dang rnam gsum mthar thug bcas// sna tshogs sgra ni mtshon pa'o// gtum mo'i rnal 'byor rlung gis te// bde chen sems la dmigs pa'o// rmi lam sgyu ma gcig tu sbyangs// bar do rnam gsum bsre ba nyid// nyon mongs ye shes lam du 'gyur// lam myur gcod par 'pho ba ste// grong du 'jug pa yan lag go

/'od gsal gnas thob mngon sangs rgyas// brtson 'grus can ni tshe 'di nyid// le lo can ni 'chi kha ste// tha ma srid pa'i bar ma dor// mchog thob skus ni gzhan don byed// ngo bo rgyu tshul 'byung ba khams// las dang dbye ba de nyid rlung*// 'byung 'jug gnas pa rnam par brtags// 'bru gsum sngags kyi ngo bo nyid// ā li kā li sbyor dbus las// brtags pa grangs ldan bzlas pa nyid// sbyor dang khyad par thabs ldan pas/ ngag dben rlung gi rnal 'byor bstan// rgyu dang 'bras bu sbyor ba gang*// snang ba gsum gyi 'char tshul te// dus dang 'byung 'gyur thabs khyad par// dbyer med ye shes gnas thob pa// ོda pa ye shes mngon du byed// slob dang mi slob der ོda pa'o// rang bzhin shes pa'i lam gyur pa// rnam shes sgyu mar mtshon pa'i chos/ khyad par las dang ོda pa gang*// dngos grub thob phyir bdag byin rlabs// phyi nang mngon par byang chub tshul// rnal 'byor thob pasid par skye dang gnas la sogs// dus kyi dbye ba'i khyad par gyis/ stan gcig steng du bsgom par bya// 'di nyid yang dag rtogs pa 'dir// lam mchog rim pa lnga po nyid// pha rol phyin dang theg sna tshogs// srid pa skye dang nyin zhag gcig /stan gcig steng du sbyar te bshad// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa nyid// tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas te// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa ste// sku lnga rab rdzogs gyur pa'o// rim pa lnga'i don bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba dpal ldan nā ro pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya ba rdzogs so// // paṇḍa ta de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// 131) ༄// rgyud sde gcig dril gyi zhus lan/ ༄// na mo gu ru/ rje mar pas nā ro pa chen po la gsol ba/ rgyud sde so so'i man ngag de ltar te/
